Møt legen som skrev denne artikkelen til vår medisinske spalte. (Se lederen under seksjonen «fortsatte endringer» for flere detaljer.)

Hei,

Mitt fulle navn er Vincent «John» Bradford Waldron (jeg bruker John), og jeg er allmennlege i den sørlige sentrale delen av Virginia. Familien min og jeg går i Bethel Mennonite Church i Gladys, Virginia. Min kone Elaine og jeg har vært gift siden 2002 og har fem barn. Jeg har praktisert som lege i tjue år; de første sytten årene praktiserte jeg i det sørlige Indiana.

For tiden arbeider jeg poliklinisk og tar meg av pasienter i den lille byen Brookneal. Visjonen min er å ta meg av mennesker slik Jesus ville gjort. Jeg ønsker å dele evangeliet med dem som trenger det, og å tjene dem som har det vondt. Flertallet av pasientene mine har ikke bakgrunn fra konservative anabaptistiske miljøer, og kanskje er den eneste måten de får se Jesus på gjennom meg.

John

Redaktørens merknad:

For tiden endrer opplysningene seg, noen ganger fra dag til dag, når det gjelder vaksinene, de uventede problemene forbundet med å gi vaksinene til verdens enorme befolkning, og de potensielle bivirkningene som oppstår etter at man har fått vaksinen. Denne artikkelen ble først skrevet før de første vaksinene var tilgjengelige, og siden den gang har den blitt revidert minst to ganger.

Vi innser at det er mye vi ikke vet omkring hele denne saken. Med dette i tankene har vi forsøkt å være så balanserte som mulig når vi har vurdert informasjonen som var tilgjengelig da artikkelen ble skrevet. Vi vil følge nøye med på hvordan situasjonene utvikler seg. Og vi vil gjøre vårt beste for å fortsette å undersøke og vurdere bekymringer som blir brakt til vår oppmerksomhet. Om Herren vil, planlegger vi å trykke oppdatert informasjon om disse spørsmålene i kommende numre av bladet.

Kort sagt støtter vi som styre kommentarene i Larry Zooks artikkel (Formaning for usikre tider) i dette nummeret av bladet … «Informert samtykke og det å innhente en ny vurdering – begge deler har lenge vært det etiske grunnlaget for beslutninger når man velger medisinsk behandling. Jeg håper vi beholder begge.»

Koronavirusvaksiner er i nyhetene for tiden. Da de første vaksinene omsider ble vurdert som «trygge» for bruk av det medisinske fagmiljøet, var oppmerksomheten først rettet mot England, siden mange «briter» var blant de første som fikk vaksinen. Blant dem var én mann som, interessant nok, heter William Shakespeare. Da denne artikkelen ble skrevet, hadde FDA her i USA godkjent de første covid-19-vaksinene, utviklet av Moderna og Pfizer.

De første vaksinene

De to første vaksinene som kom på markedet og ble godkjent, var vaksiner som brukte syntetisk mRNA (budbringer-RNA). I cellene koder DNA for de ulike proteinene som cellene trenger å produsere for å fungere. Men proteinene blir faktisk ikke laget i cellekjernen; de blir laget i cellens ribosomer. Cellen trenger derfor en budbringer som kan gå fra cellekjernen til ribosomene og frakte disse instruksjonene. Denne budbringeren er mRNA.

mRNA frakter beskjedene fra cellekjernen til ribosomene. Etter en stund brytes beskjeden ned, og ribosomene slutter å lage det aktuelle proteinet.

I mRNA-vaksiner koder det syntetiske mRNA-et i vaksinen for et protein som ligner piggproteinet på covid-viruset. Når cellene lager dette proteinet, vil kroppens immunforsvar identifisere proteinene som fremmede og begynne å danne antistoffer mot dem.

Endrer mRNA DNA?

Jeg vet at mange frykter at disse vaksinene vil endre den genetiske koden vår. Dette kunne selvsagt være svært farlig. Heldigvis kommer ikke mRNA-et seg inn i cellekjernen, men er bare aktivt der proteiner blir laget. Denne teknologien (mRNA-vaksiner) er svært forskjellig fra genterapi med stamceller og ulike former for genredigering, som CRISPR. Begge disse behandlingsområdene påvirker en person på gennivå, men mRNA-vaksinen gjør ikke det.

Effektivitet

I studiene som undersøkte de to mRNA-vaksinene, fant vi at de var ganske effektive. Det ble påvist bare 8 tilfeller av covid hos pasientene sju dager etter den andre dosen av Pfizer-vaksinen, mens det blant dem som fikk placebovaksinen, var 162 tilfeller i den samme perioden. Når vi ser på alvorlige tilfeller, var det bare ett tilfelle i vaksinegruppen (dette skjedde mellom første og andre dose) og ni tilfeller av alvorlig covid i placebogruppen.1 Moderna-vaksinen viste tilsvarende effektivitet.2

Det er fortsatt et spørsmål som står åpent. Forhindrer disse vaksinene faktisk alle covid-infeksjoner, eller gjør de bare covid-infeksjoner om til infeksjoner med få eller ingen symptomer? For tiden pågår studier for å undersøke dette. Den eneste måten å finne det ut på er å teste antistoffer hos pasienter som har fått covid-vaksinen, for proteiner som ikke finnes i vaksinen. For eksempel finnes det et protein kalt «n»-proteinet i en annen del av viruset. En som har fått vaksinen, men ikke har hatt en covid-infeksjon, vil ikke ha antistoffer mot dette proteinet, mens en som faktisk har hatt covid, også vil ha slike antistoffer, i tillegg til antistoffer mot piggproteinet.

I mellomtiden må alle, også de som har fått vaksinen, fortsatt være ekstra forsiktige, for eksempel ved å bruke munnbind, vaske hendene og holde avstand, i hvert fall inntil vi med sikkerhet vet om det er mulig å bli smittet (selv etter vaksinasjon), og hvor smittsomme slike infeksjoner eventuelt kan være.

Bivirkninger av covid-vaksinen

De vanligste bivirkningene som er registrert så langt, har vært ømhet i armen. Dette varer vanligvis i én til tre dager og går så over. Mange føler seg også ofte trette og har verk i kroppen. De kan til og med få lett feber i én til to dager etter injeksjonene. Dette ser imidlertid ut til å være et større problem etter den andre injeksjonen.

Det har også forekommet enkelte isolerte allergiske reaksjoner på vaksinene. Andelen tilfeller av anafylaksi (alvorlig allergi) etter covid-vaksinen ser ut til å være noe høyere sammenlignet med andre vaksiner. Derfor anbefales det at folk vaksineres på steder der det finnes behandling for å håndtere en slik reaksjon, og at de blir værende i minst 15 minutter etter sprøyten (eller 30 minutter hvis de vanligvis har med seg en epinefrinpenn).3

Oppdaterte opplysninger om bivirkninger

De siste ukene har nesten 15 millioner mennesker i USA fått minst én dose av covid-vaksinene. Det er gitt langt flere doser rundt om i verden. Etter hvert som dette har skjedd, har enkelte forhold knyttet til bivirkningene blitt tydeligere.

Anafylaksi er den mest alvorlige «vanlige» bivirkningen. CDC oppgir at forekomsten av alvorlig allergi mot Moderna- og Pfizer-vaksinene er omtrent 11 per million gitte doser. Denne typen allergi krever medisiner som epinefrin for å reversere reaksjonen, og den forekommer også ved andre vaksiner og medisiner.

I Norge ble nesten alle pasientene på sykehjem vaksinert mot covid.4 I løpet av de påfølgende seks dagene døde 23 av de aller skrøpeligste. Nå undersøkes det om vaksinen på noen måte bidro til disse dødsfallene. Så vidt vi vet, var disse pasientene ikke ved god helse før vaksinen, men jeg tror nok jeg ville unngått å gi vaksinen til mennesker som er svært dårlige (selv om jeg forstår at de sannsynligvis heller ikke ville klart seg særlig godt dersom de fikk covid).

Mange har fått muskelsmerter, frysninger og til og med lett feber etter den andre vaksinedosen. Flere av kollegene mine hadde slike symptomer, og alle gikk over innen 48 timer etter at de fikk vaksinen.

Jeg tror det siste man bør huske, er at bare fordi noe skjer etter at du er vaksinert, betyr ikke det at vaksinen forårsaket det. Hvis du for eksempel får en sprøyte og deretter blir påkjørt av en bil, var det åpenbart ikke sprøyten som forårsaket ulykken. Et mulig eksempel på dette er en lege i Florida som fikk en covid-vaksine og deretter utviklet svært lavt antall blodplater, og som til slutt døde. Det er ingen indikasjoner på at vaksinasjonen forårsaket det lave blodplatetallet, og vi har ikke sett dette hos andre pasienter som er vaksinert mot covid. Man antar ganske enkelt at han sannsynligvis allerede var i ferd med å utvikle denne lidelsen, og at vaksinen verken forårsaket eller påvirket den.

Kort sagt vil det, når man gir millioner av doser av hva som helst, alltid være noen som utvikler andre sykdommer kort tid etter at de har fått medisinen eller vaksinen. Utfordringen er å finne ut hva som har sammenheng med behandlingen, og hva som bare er «støy».

Etiske spørsmål

Utover de to vaksinene som er nevnt ovenfor, forskes det på og utvikles mange andre. Noen av disse vaksinene dyrkes på cellelinjer som stammer fra fostre som ble abortert på 70- og 80-tallet. Jeg må gjøre det klart at ingen pågående aborter brukes til å lage vaksiner.

I lys av dette er én positiv ting at Pfizer- og Moderna-vaksinene ikke dyrkes på disse fostercellelinjene.

Andre vaksiner

Janssen (Johnson and Johnson) Pharmaceuticals og Astra Zeneca arbeider begge med vaksiner som er mer tradisjonelle – det vil si at de dyrker viruset, dreper det og deretter gir små doser av det drepte viruset for å utløse immunresponsen og skape immunitet. Astra Zeneca-vaksinen vil sannsynligvis bli tilgjengelig om ikke så lenge. Studiene av den er noe mer uklare når det gjelder effektiviteten.

Det viktige med disse vaksinene er at begge dyrkes på HEK293-fosterceller, som stammer fra et abortert foster.

Det finnes en rekke andre vaksiner som ligger litt lenger fram i tid før de blir tilgjengelige, men én fra Merck er en ikke-mRNA-vaksine som også har etisk akseptabelt opphav (den dyrkes ikke på aborterte fosterceller). Lozier Institute har en nettside som viser hvilke vaksiner som bruker fostercellelinjer, og hvilke som ikke gjør det.5

Andre spørsmål

Det har kommet en rekke spørsmål om hvem som står bak disse vaksinene, og ulike bekymringer knyttet til utviklingen av dem. Noen har til og med spekulert i om selskaper putter en «mikrobrikke» inn i vaksinene.

Nålene som brukes til å gi disse vaksinene, har svært liten diameter (21 gauge eller mindre), noe som gjør det usannsynlig at en mikrobrikke kan føres inn gjennom en slik nål. Det virker sannsynlig at det ville kreve en betydelig større nål enn de som anbefales, dersom man skulle sette inn en mikrobrikke (mikrobrikkene som vanligvis brukes på kjæledyr, er omtrent på størrelse med et riskorn).

Å ta en beslutning

Er det verdt å ta en av disse vaksinene, og i så fall hvilken?

Den viktigste grunnen til å ta en covid-vaksine er å unngå de mulige langtidsvirkningene av en covid-infeksjon. Hos noen fører covid til kronisk utmattelse, langvarig hoste og «hjernetåke». Å ta en av disse vaksinene vil helt sikkert bidra til å unngå slike sykdomsforårsakede problemer, i tillegg til muligheten for at covid også kan forårsake hjerteskade.6

Hva om du allerede har hatt covid?

Mange i våre miljøer har allerede hatt covid. Hvis du vet at du har hatt covid, er det sannsynligvis best å vente. Det er ingen spesiell grunn til å skynde seg ut og bli vaksinert, siden vi tror antistoffene dine bør forbli aktive i tre til seks måneder. I studier så det ut til at nivåene sank over tid, men folk som har hatt covid, bør være immune i minst 3 måneder og sannsynligvis lenger.

Det virker mest fornuftig å vente og se om en av vaksinene viser seg å være bedre enn de andre, enten når det gjelder effektivitet eller færre bivirkninger.

Hvem bør ikke vaksineres?

For tiden er det enkelte personer som ikke bør ta vaksinen. Den første kategorien er grupper som ikke var med i studiene. Barn under 16 år, gravide og ammende mødre bør derfor alle unngå covid-vaksinene foreløpig. Det kan hende at vaksinen ville vært trygg for personer i disse gruppene, men siden den ikke ble testet på dem, bør de ikke ta den nå.

For det andre bør du ikke ta vaksinen hvis du har covid nå, eller hvis du for tiden er i isolasjon fordi du har vært utsatt for smitte. Jeg antar at dette gir mening, ettersom vi vanligvis ikke vaksinerer folk som allerede er syke.

Til slutt bør du være forsiktig hvis du tidligere har hatt alvorlige reaksjoner på andre vaksiner.

Alle andre

Hvis noen ikke har hatt en covid-infeksjon, ville jeg absolutt helle mot å ta vaksinen. Personlig har jeg begynt å vaksinere meg med Pfizer-vaksinen, og jeg føler meg trygg på det. For dem som arbeider i helsevesenet, ville jeg helle mot å ta en av vaksinene. For meg handler ikke spørsmålet om risikoen for at jeg blir smittet, men om bekymringen jeg har som kristen lege for at jeg kan smitte en av pasientene mine med covid.

Hvis du tar deg av eldre mennesker og ikke har hatt en covid-infeksjon, ville jeg også tenkt grundig over å bli vaksinert. Igjen bør hovedbekymringen ikke være hvordan du selv vil håndtere infeksjonen, men hvem du kan komme til å smitte.

Konklusjon

Jeg forstår at andre kan føle seg mindre trygge på disse nye vaksinene, og hvis det er tilfellet, ville jeg ventet. Disse vaksinene gis til millioner av mennesker, og hvis det er problemer, vil de bli tydelige ganske raskt.

Til slutt er jeg glad for at det vil bli tilgjengelig flere vaksiner med etisk akseptabelt opphav for dem som ønsker det.

Greetings of Christian love to each one. Hopefully, you have found Christ as the anchor for your soul and the solution to your difficulties. Another year is past and gone, and what a year it was… An unseen virus encircling the world, unsettling cultures from third-world countries to the most advanced and industrialized. World leaders blaming each other for the ever-increasing pandemic as their country’s economies continued to spiral downward. And churches struggling to maintain unity in the midst of their various government’s mandates regarding social distancing, mask wearing, and limits on the size of gatherings.

For many, the year 2020 has destroyed or radically altered that which used to be considered normal and has begun establishing new norms and many things may never be the same again. ‘Six feet’ has become a well-recognized unit of measurement. The sound of coughing draws glances from those within hearing distance. Mask wearing has become the focus of jokes and endless arguments regarding the pros and cons.

Through it all, many have suffered in various ways. Most importantly, I wonder if we have considered the spiritual fallout happening to those around us?

I have heard numerous reports of folks who couldn’t handle the loss of fellowship when their local church completely stopped having in-person worship services. Some silently pined away, growing increasingly disillusioned with Christianity. Others, deciding this was ‘the straw that broke their camel’s back’, took action and left their old church, then joined a new group that was more supportive of their views. There were, however, many churches that chose to “obey God rather than man” and continued to quietly meet for worship.

Conscience in Crisis

This issue alone (governments telling churches how and when to worship) has been the cause of much discussion, disorder, and even dissension in many churches. We are facing unprecedented times. For most of us, we don’t have any experience in our past to fall back on which will help us make a clear decision. Some Christians’ consciences will not allow them peace while ‘disobeying the civil authorities’, while other Christians’ consciences will not allow them peace while ‘forsaking the assembling of themselves together’. Somehow, this “intrusion” of government into the everyday life of the church just hasn’t seemed quite right.

During the 1600s and the 1700s, our Anabaptist forefathers emigrated from Europe to foreign countries in search of a new home where they were free to worship as their conscience directed. Ever since, one of the key aspects of living in America has been that of the “separation of church and state”. So, it was with uncertainty and trepidation that we, conservative Anabaptists, have considered that which our local, state, or federal governments have asked of us. One thing that I am extremely grateful for is that the leaders of our local fellowship have maintained very strong admonishment throughout this time, that: “As we sort through each new challenge that comes our way, we must ALWAYS exhibit a godly respect (in thought, in word, and in action) for our civil authorities”, especially if we find it necessary to “obey God rather than man”.

Another major point of concern was that of the United States elections at the end of 2020. Somehow, this country has become more and more polarized over the last four years, (maybe it has been longer). I heard a report of one man from the world who said that if Trump doesn’t win the election then he sees no hope to continue living and he is contemplating whether he should just take his own life and end it all. Sure, a man of the world may not have the hope of a better life to come since he probably doesn’t see himself as a “stranger and a pilgrim” here on this earth and most likely he doesn’t believe in life eternal. But what about those of us who claim to be Christians, are we doing any better? Are we responding to each situation in fear or in faith?

All of this upheaval in our ‘normal’ way of life, has brought uncertainty. Uncertainty about jobs. Uncertainty about our future. Uncertainty about our families. Uncertainty about the end of time. And the list could go on with each person filling in the blanks for him or herself.

The Vaccines

The most recent issue of upheaval that is taking front stage both in our minds and in our conversations is that of the vaccine. Will it be “forced” upon us? Are there properties included in this new type of vaccine that will enable others to ‘track’ us and listen in to all our private conversations? Is it true that there is somehow a microchip, or a multitude of nano robots immersed in that small volume of liquid? Will this new technology that has been manufactured as a synthetic mRNA vaccine somehow change my DNA if I allow them to prick my skin? Is this vaccine the mark of the beast? All these, and more, are questions which I have been hearing with ever-increasing frequency and urgency.

Conspiracy Theories

The uncertainty of it all (the virus, the election, and the vaccine) has spawned many, many conspiracy theories. Usually, if there is a negative connotation surrounding something, then we tend to close ourselves to the possibility that we may be involved. “Surely, the ideas that I am passing on are not a conspiracy theory!”

Or are they? Let’s stop and think about this a minute. Conspiracy = a secret plan by a group to do something unlawful or harmful. Theory = a supposition or a system of ideas intended to explain something. Doesn’t this fit most of the allegations and claims that have been circulated among us? Almost every new ‘story’ will claim that ‘certain’ people are secretly involved in an all-encompassing agenda to use this certain negative issue of upheaval to bring about a specific negative change that will harm the masses. Most often these ‘stories’ are designed to play on our emotions, triggering a response rooted in fear, that is ultimately designed to protect myself from the alleged personal harm—that of being personally controlled by others, loss of personal rights, loss of personal privacy, etc., etc.

If we are honest about the actual definition of ‘conspiracy’ and of ‘theory’, then we would also need to admit that many, if not most, of the ‘stories’ that are spreading through the rumor-mill are indeed conspiracy theories. I am not suggesting that we bury our heads in the sand, or that we shouldn’t be a prepared people. I am simply cautioning against being sucked into the emotional rhetoric of the many ‘stories’ that are continually being promoted.

There are some questions we can ask ourselves that will help to sort through the confusion of all the various claims or allegations being made. Am I being asked to join the fight to protect the Constitution of the United States? Am I being advised to join others in standing up for our ‘rights’? If I stop and consider what’s happening in my heart, what is motivating me to action—Faith? or Fear? If there is any truth in that which is being alleged, is there anything that I can do about it?

Like I said before, we are facing unprecedented times. Let’s face our future with faith—our God is sovereignly in control. Let’s not lose sight of our future home in heaven—we are called to be strangers and pilgrims in this world. Let’s always remember the promises of God—that He will be with us always even unto the end of the world, and that He will NOT allow us to be tempted above that which we are able to bear. These promises and many, many more are clearly specified in the Scriptures.

The virus hits home

My (Curvin’s) family contracted the Covid-19 virus in the middle of October 2020. It affected each of our family members in slightly different ways, which was interesting to observe. One of the intriguing aspects was that most of us lost our sense of taste and smell. Most of our family didn’t suffer more than we normally would with the normal flu. However, my mother, who lives with us, ended up on the very verge of needing to be hospitalized due to low oxygen levels in her blood. Thankfully, this was averted through a doctor prescribing some potent drugs which had an almost immediate effect on reversing this.

For myself, I was so sick from the virus that I wasn’t able to work for over two months. The only thing that kept me out of the hospital was a daily intake of one restricted drug and double the recommended dose of steroids through nebulizer treatments. This went on for over six weeks. It is now almost two months since I finally started to recover and yet I am still not fully back to where I was prior to contracting Covid-19.

On a side note, we have included an article bringing recognition to the life of Mose Stoltzfus, an older brother from one of our sister churches who died after contracting Covid-19. Considering these two situations, I can say of a surety that the virus is real and not a hoax; that the virus affects everybody in slightly different ways; that some people have hardly any ill effects even though they do contract the virus; and that there are some who do become very ill indeed.

The Vaccine booklet

Back a number of issues we ran a number of articles written by a doctor on the whole issue of vaccines. Our goal was to try to present as balanced of a view as possible. We had numerous requests to have those articles compiled into a booklet format, which we had announced previously that we were planning to do. We encountered a number of practical issues that needed to be sorted through, which took time (much longer than we had anticipated). Finally, we have now arrived at the point of being ready to compile and publish this booklet.

If you want to receive one or more copies of this booklet, we ask that you contact us with your contact information and the number of booklets desired, even if you have previously done so. This will help us gauge the interest level to know how many we should print. We can be reached by mail, phone, or email, each of which can be found inside the front cover of each issue of our magazine, The Heartbeat of the Remnant.

Continued Changes

Over the last year or two we have pursued various ways of streamlining our production efforts. One of these, which we have mentioned before is that of working towards having multiple authors write articles for the various specific columns, such as the Children’s Corner, Sister to Sister, A Word from The Doctor, etc. One of the changes you will see is that we will have more than one doctor writing articles for the medical column.

Finances

As you will notice, we have included a financial report in this issue for the year of 2020. A year ago, we had made known through our annual newsletter that things were quite desperate for us financially and that we needed funds if we were going to keep going forward. The response was overwhelming, and we have been blessed by all who decided to partner with us in this need. However, as you can see by the financial report, there is a need for continued financial support since our expenses are ongoing. For those of you who are actively involved in this way, we say thank you and may God richly bless your generosity.

A Point of Interest

The children’s story in this issue of the magazine holds special interest for me. While the details of the story may not all be according to fact, there was a John M. and Catharine Kurtz family that lost five children in infancy and then years later they lost six children to diphtheria. Only John S. Kurtz survived, but was joined by two younger siblings later on. John was ordained to the ministry at the age of 27 and married Maria Horning almost two years later.

John S. and Maria (Horning) Kurtz were my great, great grandparents. So, that line of my ancestry can be traced back through the time of another pandemic and tremendous upheaval in people’s lives, through that of the only surviving child out of a family of 12. For me, this brings personal interest and perspective to some of the situations we are facing today.

May God bless and keep each one. As the world becomes ever darker and more chaotic, let us as Christians draw ever closer to our Lord. In this, He has given a command containing a promise for each of us to: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded –James 4:8.

Curvin L Wenger

Kristen kjærlighetshilsen til hver og én. Jeg håper du har funnet Kristus som ankeret for din sjel og løsningen på dine vanskeligheter. Enda et år er forbi, og for et år det var … Et usynlig virus som omkranset verden og skapte uro i samfunn fra land i den tredje verden til de mest avanserte og industrialiserte landene. Verdensledere som skyldte på hverandre for den stadig voksende pandemien, mens økonomiene i landene deres fortsatte å gå nedover. Og kirker som strevde med å bevare enheten midt i de ulike myndighetenes påbud om sosial avstand, bruk av munnbind og begrensninger på størrelsen på forsamlinger.

For mange har året 2020 ødelagt eller radikalt endret det som tidligere ble regnet som normalt, og begynt å etablere nye normer; mye blir kanskje aldri det samme igjen. «To meter» er blitt en velkjent måleenhet. Lyden av hoste får folk innen hørevidde til å kaste blikk i retning av den som hoster. Bruk av munnbind er blitt gjenstand for vitser og endeløse diskusjoner om fordeler og ulemper.

Gjennom alt dette har mange lidd på forskjellige måter. Viktigst av alt: Jeg lurer på om vi har tenkt over de åndelige følgene for dem rundt oss?

Jeg har hørt mange fortellinger om folk som ikke klarte å håndtere tapet av fellesskap da den lokale kirken deres helt sluttet å holde gudstjenester med fysisk oppmøte. Noen visnet stille hen og ble stadig mer desillusjonert over kristendommen. Andre bestemte seg for at dette var «dråpen som fikk begeret til å renne over», tok affære og forlot den gamle kirken sin for så å slutte seg til en ny gruppe som støttet synspunktene deres bedre. Det var imidlertid mange kirker som valgte å «adlyde Gud mer enn mennesker» og fortsatte å møtes stille til gudstjeneste.

Samvittigheten i krise

Dette ene spørsmålet (at myndighetene forteller kirkene hvordan og når de skal holde gudstjeneste) har ført til mye diskusjon, uro og til og med splid i mange kirker. Vi står overfor en tid uten sidestykke. De fleste av oss har ingen tidligere erfaring å støtte oss på som kan hjelpe oss med å ta en klar beslutning. Noen kristnes samvittighet lar dem ikke finne ro når de «ulydiger de sivile myndighetene», mens andre kristnes samvittighet ikke lar dem finne ro når de «forsømmer å komme sammen». På et vis har dette «inngrepet» fra myndighetenes side i kirkens daglige liv bare ikke føltes helt riktig.

På 1600- og 1700-tallet utvandret våre anabaptistiske forfedre fra Europa til fremmede land på leting etter et nytt hjem der de kunne tilbe slik samvittigheten ledet dem. Helt siden den gang har et av de viktigste kjennetegnene ved livet i Amerika vært «skillet mellom kirke og stat». Derfor har vi konservative anabaptister vurdert det våre lokale, delstatlige eller føderale myndigheter har bedt oss om, med usikkerhet og uro. Noe jeg er svært takknemlig for, er at lederne i vårt lokale fellesskap gjennom hele denne tiden har kommet med en sterk og gjentatt formaning om at «når vi går gjennom hver nye utfordring som møter oss, må vi ALLTID vise gudfryktig respekt (i tanke, ord og handling) for våre sivile myndigheter», særlig dersom vi finner det nødvendig å «adlyde Gud mer enn mennesker».

En annen stor bekymring var valget i USA ved utgangen av 2020. På et vis er landet blitt stadig mer polarisert de siste fire årene (kanskje har det vart lenger). Jeg hørte en beretning om en mann fra verden som sa at hvis Trump ikke vinner valget, ser han ikke noe håp om å fortsette å leve, og han overveier om han bare burde ta sitt eget liv og gjøre slutt på alt. Ja, en mann av verden har kanskje ikke håp om et bedre liv som kommer, siden han sannsynligvis ikke ser på seg selv som en «fremmed og pilegrim» her på jorden, og mest sannsynlig ikke tror på evig liv. Men hva med oss som hevder å være kristne – gjør vi det noe bedre? Reagerer vi på hver situasjon i frykt eller i tro?

All denne omveltningen i vår «normale» livsførsel har ført med seg usikkerhet. Usikkerhet om arbeid. Usikkerhet om framtiden. Usikkerhet om familiene våre. Usikkerhet om endetiden. Og listen kunne fortsette, med hver enkelt som fylte inn det som manglet for sin egen del.

Vaksinene

Det siste omveltende spørsmålet som står sentralt både i tankene våre og i samtalene våre, er vaksinen. Vil den bli «tvunget» på oss? Finnes det egenskaper ved denne nye typen vaksine som gjør det mulig for andre å «spore» oss og lytte til alle våre private samtaler? Stemmer det at det på en eller annen måte finnes en mikrobrikke, eller en mengde nanoroboter, i denne lille mengden væske? Vil denne nye teknologien, som er produsert som en syntetisk mRNA-vaksine, på en eller annen måte endre DNA-et mitt hvis jeg lar dem stikke hull i huden min? Er denne vaksinen dyrets merke? Dette er noen av spørsmålene, blant flere, som jeg har hørt med stadig større hyppighet og alvor.

Konspirasjonsteorier

Usikkerheten rundt alt dette (viruset, valget og vaksinen) har ført til svært mange konspirasjonsteorier. Vanligvis har vi en tendens til å lukke oss for muligheten for at vi kan være involvert hvis noe forbindes med noe negativt. «Det jeg videreformidler, er vel ikke en konspirasjonsteori!»

Eller er det det? La oss stanse opp og tenke over dette et øyeblikk. Konspirasjon = en hemmelig plan som en gruppe har om å gjøre noe ulovlig eller skadelig. Teori = en antakelse eller et system av ideer som skal forklare noe. Passer ikke dette på de fleste påstandene og anklagene som er blitt spredt blant oss? Nesten hver nye «historie» hevder at «visse» personer i hemmelighet er involvert i en omfattende plan om å bruke nettopp dette negative omveltende forholdet til å få til en bestemt negativ endring som vil skade massene. Som oftest er disse «historiene» laget for å spille på følelsene våre og utløse en reaksjon rotfestet i frykt, med det endelige formålet å beskytte meg selv mot den påståtte personlige skaden – det å bli kontrollert av andre, å miste personlige rettigheter, å miste privatliv, og så videre.

Hvis vi er ærlige om den egentlige definisjonen av «konspirasjon» og «teori», må vi også innrømme at mange, om ikke de fleste, av «historiene» som sprer seg gjennom ryktemølla, faktisk er konspirasjonsteorier. Jeg foreslår ikke at vi skal stikke hodet i sanden, eller at vi ikke bør være et forberedt folk. Jeg advarer ganske enkelt mot å bli dratt inn i den følelsesladde retorikken i de mange «historiene» som stadig blir fremmet.

Vi kan stille oss selv noen spørsmål som kan hjelpe oss med å sortere i forvirringen rundt alle de ulike påstandene og anklagene. Blir jeg bedt om å slutte meg til kampen for å beskytte USAs grunnlov? Blir jeg rådet til å stå sammen med andre for våre «rettigheter»? Hvis jeg stanser opp og tenker over hva som skjer i hjertet mitt, hva er det som motiverer meg til å handle – tro eller frykt? Hvis det finnes noe sant i det som påstås, er det noe jeg kan gjøre med det?

Som jeg sa tidligere, står vi overfor en tid uten sidestykke. La oss møte framtiden med tro – vår Gud har suveren kontroll. La oss ikke miste framtidshjemmet vårt i himmelen av syne – vi er kalt til å være fremmede og pilegrimer i denne verden. La oss alltid huske Guds løfter – at han vil være med oss alltid, helt til verdens ende, og at han IKKE vil la oss bli fristet mer enn vi kan tåle. Disse løftene og mange, mange flere er tydelig angitt i Skriften.

Viruset rammer oss

Min (Curvins) familie ble smittet av covid-19-viruset midt i oktober 2020. Det påvirket hvert familiemedlem på litt ulike måter, noe som var interessant å observere. Et av de fascinerende trekkene var at de fleste av oss mistet smaks- og luktesansen. De fleste i familien vår ble ikke sykere enn vi vanligvis ville blitt av vanlig influensa. Moren min, som bor sammen med oss, var imidlertid helt på grensen til å måtte legges inn på sykehus på grunn av lavt oksygennivå i blodet. Heldigvis ble dette avverget da en lege foreskrev noen sterke medisiner, som nesten umiddelbart bidro til å snu utviklingen.

Jeg var selv så syk av viruset at jeg ikke kunne arbeide på over to måneder. Det eneste som holdt meg unna sykehuset, var at jeg daglig tok ett legemiddel som er underlagt restriksjoner, og fikk dobbel anbefalt dose steroider gjennom forstøverbehandlinger. Dette pågikk i over seks uker. Det er nå nesten to måneder siden jeg endelig begynte å bli bedre, og likevel er jeg fortsatt ikke helt tilbake til slik jeg var før jeg fikk covid-19.

Som en liten tilleggsopplysning har vi tatt med en artikkel som hedrer Mose Stoltzfus, en eldre bror fra en av søsterkirkene våre, som døde etter å ha fått covid-19. Når jeg ser disse to situasjonene under ett, kan jeg si med sikkerhet at viruset er reelt og ikke en bløff; at viruset påvirker alle litt forskjellig; at noen nesten ikke får noen uheldige virkninger selv om de blir smittet; og at noen faktisk blir svært syke.

Vaksineheftet

For noen utgaver siden publiserte vi flere artikler skrevet av en lege om vaksiner generelt. Målet vårt var å prøve å presentere et så balansert syn som mulig. Vi fikk mange forespørsler om å samle artiklene i et hefte, noe vi tidligere hadde kunngjort at vi planla å gjøre. Vi støtte på flere praktiske spørsmål som måtte avklares, og det tok tid (mye lenger enn vi hadde regnet med). Nå er vi endelig kommet dit at vi er klare til å sette sammen og utgi dette heftet.

Hvis du ønsker å få ett eller flere eksemplarer av dette heftet, ber vi deg kontakte oss med kontaktinformasjonen din og oppgi hvor mange hefter du ønsker, selv om du allerede har gjort det. Dette vil hjelpe oss med å vurdere interessen og finne ut hvor mange vi bør trykke. Du kan nå oss per post, telefon eller e-post; kontaktopplysningene finnes på innsiden av forsiden i hvert nummer av magasinet vårt, The Heartbeat of the Remnant.

Flere endringer

Det siste året eller de siste to årene har vi arbeidet med ulike måter å effektivisere produksjonsarbeidet på. Et av tiltakene, som vi har nevnt før, er å arbeide mot å få flere skribenter til å skrive artikler til de ulike faste spaltene, som Barnehjørnet, Søster til søster, Et ord fra legen og så videre. En av endringene du vil merke, er at mer enn én lege vil skrive artikler til den medisinske spalten.

Økonomi

Som du vil se, har vi tatt med en økonomisk rapport for året 2020 i dette nummeret. For et år siden gjorde vi kjent gjennom vårt årlige nyhetsbrev at den økonomiske situasjonen vår var svært vanskelig, og at vi trengte midler for å kunne fortsette. Responsen var overveldende, og vi er blitt velsignet av alle som bestemte seg for å støtte oss i dette behovet. Men som du kan se av den økonomiske rapporten, trenger vi fortsatt økonomisk støtte, siden utgiftene våre fortsetter. Til dere som aktivt bidrar på denne måten, sier vi takk, og må Gud rikt velsigne deres gavmildhet.

Noe interessant

Barnefortellingen i dette nummeret av magasinet er av spesiell interesse for meg. Selv om alle detaljene i fortellingen kanskje ikke stemmer med virkeligheten, var det en familie med John M. og Catharine Kurtz som mistet fem barn i spedbarnsalderen, og flere år senere mistet seks barn av difteri. Bare John S. Kurtz overlevde, men senere fikk han følge av to yngre søsken. John ble ordinert til tjeneste som 27-åring og giftet seg med Maria Horning nesten to år senere.

John S. og Maria (Horning) Kurtz var mine tipp-tipp-oldeforeldre. Dermed kan denne grenen av slekten min følges tilbake gjennom tiden med en annen pandemi og store omveltninger i folks liv, til det eneste barnet som overlevde i en familie på 12. For meg gir dette en personlig interesse for og et perspektiv på noen av situasjonene vi står overfor i dag.

Må Gud velsigne og bevare hver og én. Etter hvert som verden blir stadig mørkere og mer kaotisk, la oss som kristne komme stadig nærmere vår Herre. I dette har han gitt en befaling som inneholder et løfte til hver enkelt av oss: Kom nær til Gud, så skal han komme nær til dere. Rens hendene, dere syndere, og rens hjertene, dere tvesinnede – Jakob 4:8.

Curvin L Wenger

The last several years God has been leading me through a valley, a long and seemingly unending one. It seems as soon as one situation resolves; another one pops up. These difficulties demand a response. Many times, it’s not so much a response of physical action as it is a response of the spirit. For me, it took about two years before I came to a place of beginning to learn healthy and, even more importantly, Biblical emotional choices.

“Spirit” in this article is defined as “a temper or disposition of the mind or outlook.” The Bible mentions several types of spirits that God has been teaching me. Two are more general for everyone and two are specifically given for us ladies.

Before it is of any value to discuss what a Biblical and healthy spirit is, it is essential that we understand that it is a choice. It is not a result of circumstances. It will not come upon us on a whim. As young ladies, especially, we find it very easy to be driven by emotions. But most emotions that “drive” us are not healthy. A Biblical spirit is a result of conscious—not emotional, circumstance-driven—choices. If we let them, unhealthy emotions can become monstrous and pull us downward to many undesirable places such as depression, bitterness, and immorality. In response, God calls us to intentionally choose the type of spirit that is defined in the Bible.

A Broken Spirit

For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite [crushed] and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones –Isaiah 57:15.

Above all else, it is essential that we choose to become broken. It is hard to stress the importance of this enough. If we do not allow ourselves to become broken, we are opening the door for all manner of negative emotions, reactions, and, especially, sin.

Brokenness is a difficult, almost impossible choice to make on our own. Often God leads us into difficult situations where we must make a choice—either godly brokenness, or something unhealthy like anger or discouragement. Brokenness strips everything away. It requires us to surrender our control over bad things such as sickness or disappointment and over good things like our desires for the future. Brokenness means we give God control of everything; we keep nothing. Most times deep brokenness doesn’t happen all at once; it’s a painful journey in which we give up, and give up, and give up again. Without becoming bitter. Without losing faith in God. In fact, the times of crushing are when we choose to believe good things of God even if there seems to be no good reason to.

Brokenness is a choice—a very difficult one which paves the way for God to receive glory, since it is the process of eliminating self. It also makes it possible for other finer qualities to reveal themselves.

A Sober Spirit

Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, [and] be sober… –1 Peter 1:13.

The definition of “sober” in this verse is “to be calm and collected in spirit; to be temperate, dispassionate.” This is an intriguing word. According to this verse, we are commanded to be calm and collected in spirit. As young ladies, we know how easy and even automatic it is to let our feelings about situations and circumstances spiral out of control.

For myself, I was at a place of limbo and uncertainty, and I was so discouraged that I could hardly go on. I could not focus on important things like work and reaching out to others. While studying this verse, God convicted me that, yes, even though I was in a very dark time, His command to me was to be calm and not let my raging emotions control. He brought me to a place where I had to choose, moment by moment, to take control of my spirit. I found that as I chose God’s way, He gave me the grace to live accordingly, resulting in a much more stable and restful spirit.

So, take heart in the dark times! Choose to respond to circumstances in God’s way. As He refines your spirit and your character, He also wants to receive the glory for it. This is a journey God is taking me on, and I’m thankful to Him for continuing to patiently break and shape my spirit for His glory.

A Meek Spirit

But let it be … the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit… –1 Peter 3:4.

In many ways a meek spirit is a yielded spirit. It is a spirit that is totally under the control of Almighty God. It does not fight unpleasant circumstances or strive to make life “better.” But neither is it a passive, “roll with punches”, cowering attitude. Actually, this spirit denotes someone who has gifts and abilities, is trained and effective, and could be very useful to the work of the church, yet is in complete subjection to God, moving only at His will.

A Quiet Spirit

But let it be … the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit… –1 Peter 3:4.

A quiet and restful spirit is an amazing quality. It is not humanly possible to achieve. When you see this spirit in someone, you can know it comes from a heart of brokenness. According to Isaiah, it is a choice: …In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not –Isaiah 30:15.

A quiet spirit and a meek spirit go hand in hand. It is an attitude of sitting back and letting God lead—whether exciting or boring, whether easy or difficult—and not resisting Him in any way.

There are times when we feel very disquieted in spirit, and it’s not possible to pull ourselves out of it by sheer willpower. But the Word of God is life-giving, and by studying the promises of God we can receive peace and rest for our spirits, as well as courage and grace to go on. I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved. Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope –Psalms 16:8, 9.

Beberapa tahun terakhir ini, Allah telah menuntun saya melewati sebuah lembah, lembah yang panjang dan seolah tak berujung. Rasanya, begitu satu keadaan terselesaikan, keadaan lain muncul. Kesulitan-kesulitan ini menuntut tanggapan. Sering kali, tanggapan itu bukan terutama berupa tindakan fisik, melainkan tanggapan batin. Bagi saya, dibutuhkan sekitar dua tahun sebelum saya mulai belajar membuat pilihan emosional yang sehat dan, yang lebih penting lagi, alkitabiah.

Dalam artikel ini, “roh” didefinisikan sebagai “watak atau kecenderungan pikiran maupun pandangan.” Alkitab menyebutkan beberapa jenis roh yang sedang Allah ajarkan kepada saya. Dua di antaranya lebih umum bagi semua orang, dan dua lainnya secara khusus diberikan bagi kita para perempuan.

Sebelum membahas apa itu roh yang alkitabiah dan sehat, penting bagi kita untuk memahami bahwa hal itu merupakan pilihan. Itu bukan akibat keadaan. Itu tidak akan datang begitu saja. Khususnya sebagai perempuan muda, kita merasa sangat mudah digerakkan oleh emosi. Namun, sebagian besar emosi yang “menggerakkan” kita tidaklah sehat. Roh yang alkitabiah merupakan hasil pilihan yang disengaja—bukan pilihan yang didasarkan pada emosi atau keadaan. Jika kita membiarkannya, emosi yang tidak sehat dapat menjadi monster dan menyeret kita ke berbagai keadaan yang tidak diinginkan, seperti depresi, kepahitan, dan amoralitas. Sebagai tanggapan, Allah memanggil kita untuk dengan sengaja memilih jenis roh yang didefinisikan dalam Alkitab.

Roh yang Remuk

Sebab beginilah firman Dia yang Mahatinggi dan Mahamulia, yang bersemayam dalam kekekalan, dan yang nama-Nya Kudus: “Aku bersemayam di tempat yang tinggi dan kudus, tetapi juga bersama orang yang remuk [hancur] dan rendah hati, untuk menghidupkan kembali roh orang-orang yang rendah hati, dan untuk menghidupkan kembali hati orang-orang yang remuk” –Yesaya 57:15.

Di atas segalanya, penting bagi kita untuk memilih menjadi remuk. Sulit rasanya untuk cukup menekankan betapa pentingnya hal ini. Jika kita tidak membiarkan diri kita diremukkan, kita membuka pintu bagi segala macam emosi negatif, reaksi negatif, dan terutama dosa.

Menjadi remuk adalah pilihan yang sulit, hampir mustahil untuk dilakukan sendiri. Sering kali Allah menuntun kita ke dalam situasi sulit, ketika kita harus memilih—antara keremukan hati yang saleh atau sesuatu yang tidak sehat seperti kemarahan atau patah semangat. Keremukan hati menanggalkan segala sesuatu. Kita harus menyerahkan kendali atas hal-hal buruk seperti penyakit atau kekecewaan, dan atas hal-hal baik seperti keinginan kita untuk masa depan. Menjadi remuk berarti kita menyerahkan kendali atas segala sesuatu kepada Allah; tidak ada yang kita pertahankan. Sering kali, keremukan hati yang mendalam tidak terjadi sekaligus; ini adalah perjalanan menyakitkan ketika kita menyerah, lalu menyerah lagi, dan lagi. Tanpa menjadi pahit. Tanpa kehilangan iman kepada Allah. Sebenarnya, pada saat-saat kita dihancurkan, kita memilih untuk percaya bahwa Allah itu baik, bahkan ketika tampaknya tidak ada alasan baik untuk melakukannya.

Keremukan hati adalah sebuah pilihan—pilihan yang sangat sulit, yang membuka jalan bagi Allah untuk menerima kemuliaan, karena proses ini menyingkirkan diri sendiri. Keremukan hati juga memungkinkan sifat-sifat lain yang lebih luhur untuk tampak.

Roh yang Tenang dan Terkendali

Karena itu, siapkanlah pikiranmu untuk bertindak, [dan] hendaklah kamu tenang dan menguasai diri… –1 Petrus 1:13.

Arti “tenang dan menguasai diri” dalam ayat ini adalah “bersikap tenang dan terkendali dalam roh; bersikap sederhana dan tidak dikuasai perasaan.” Ini kata yang menarik. Menurut ayat ini, kita diperintahkan untuk tenang dan terkendali dalam roh. Sebagai perempuan muda, kita tahu betapa mudahnya, bahkan otomatisnya, membiarkan perasaan kita mengenai situasi dan keadaan menjadi tak terkendali.

Saya sendiri pernah berada dalam keadaan yang serba tidak menentu dan tidak pasti, serta begitu patah semangat sampai-sampai hampir tidak sanggup melanjutkan hidup. Saya tidak dapat berkonsentrasi pada hal-hal penting seperti pekerjaan dan menjangkau orang lain. Saat mempelajari ayat ini, Allah menyadarkan saya bahwa, ya, sekalipun saya sedang berada dalam masa yang sangat kelam, perintah-Nya kepada saya adalah untuk tenang dan tidak membiarkan emosi saya yang berkecamuk menguasai diri. Dia membawa saya ke keadaan ketika saya harus memilih, dari saat ke saat, untuk mengendalikan roh saya. Saya mendapati bahwa ketika saya memilih jalan Allah, Dia memberi saya anugerah untuk hidup sesuai dengan pilihan itu, sehingga roh saya jauh lebih stabil dan tenteram.

Jadi, kuatkanlah hati pada masa-masa kelam! Pilihlah untuk menanggapi keadaan dengan cara Allah. Saat Dia memurnikan roh dan karakter Anda, Dia juga ingin menerima kemuliaan karenanya. Inilah perjalanan yang sedang Allah tuntun saya jalani, dan saya bersyukur kepada-Nya karena terus dengan sabar meremukkan dan membentuk roh saya demi kemuliaan-Nya.

Roh yang Lemah Lembut

Hendaklah itu … menjadi perhiasan berupa roh yang lemah lembut dan tenteram… –1 Petrus 3:4.

Dalam banyak hal, roh yang lemah lembut adalah roh yang berserah. Roh itu sepenuhnya berada di bawah kendali Allah Yang Mahakuasa. Roh itu tidak melawan keadaan yang tidak menyenangkan atau berusaha menjadikan hidup “lebih baik.” Namun, roh itu juga bukan sikap pasif yang hanya “menerima apa pun yang terjadi” dan meringkuk ketakutan. Sebenarnya, roh ini menggambarkan seseorang yang memiliki karunia dan kemampuan, terlatih dan cakap, serta dapat sangat berguna bagi pekerjaan gereja, tetapi sepenuhnya tunduk kepada Allah, bergerak hanya atas kehendak-Nya.

Roh yang Tenteram

Hendaklah itu … menjadi perhiasan berupa roh yang lemah lembut dan tenteram… –1 Petrus 3:4.

Roh yang tenteram dan tenang adalah sifat yang luar biasa. Sifat ini tidak mungkin dicapai dengan kemampuan manusia. Ketika Anda melihat roh seperti ini pada seseorang, Anda dapat mengetahui bahwa roh itu berasal dari hati yang remuk. Menurut Yesaya, itu adalah sebuah pilihan: …Dengan bertobat dan tinggal diam kamu akan diselamatkan; dalam ketenangan dan kepercayaan terletak kekuatanmu: tetapi kamu tidak mau –Yesaya 30:15.

Roh yang tenteram dan roh yang lemah lembut berjalan beriringan. Ini adalah sikap berdiam diri dan membiarkan Allah menuntun—entah menyenangkan atau membosankan, entah mudah atau sulit—serta tidak melawan-Nya dengan cara apa pun.

Ada kalanya kita merasa sangat gelisah dalam roh, dan kita tidak dapat keluar darinya hanya dengan mengandalkan tekad. Namun, Firman Allah memberi hidup, dan dengan mempelajari janji-janji Allah, kita dapat menerima damai dan ketenteraman bagi roh kita, serta keberanian dan anugerah untuk terus melangkah. Aku senantiasa memandang kepada TUHAN; karena Ia berdiri di sebelah kananku, aku tidak goyah. Sebab itu hatiku bersukacita, dan kemuliaanku bersorak-sorai; tubuhku pun akan beristirahat dengan tenteram –Mazmur 16:8, 9.

Death seemed certain, the doctors all said.
Was it really true “That in days he’d be dead”?
He didn’t want to admit, yet he was driven by fear.
He broadened his shoulders, hid every tear.
Before he knew when his end might be,
He boldly proclaimed his own sovereignty.
To admit his fear of what is unknown,
Would be worse than death and eternity alone.

“No one can know my anguish inside!
I’ll act like I’m fine, my feelings I’ll hide.
People speak of God, oh the anger that brings!
Please go away, or talk of other things!”
Alone on the bed, his mind starts to race.
“I’m tired of bondage; could there be grace?
No, it will never work, for me it’s too late.”
With his back turned on God, he awaited his fate.

The preacher knew not what exactly to say,
At the funeral of the man who had gone his own way.
All that he knew, was that he’d made a bad choice,
Hardening his heart and blocking God’s voice.
There’s no changing it now, he must pay the cost.
Death swallowed its victim—his soul eternally lost.

Смерть казалась неизбежной, твердили врачи.
Неужто и вправду «дни его сочтены»?
Признаться он не хотел, но страх им владел.
Он расправил плечи, скрыв каждую слезу.
Не зная, когда наступит конец,
Он смело провозгласил собственную власть над собой.
Признать, что страшит неизвестность,
Было хуже, чем смерть и вечное одиночество.

«Никто не узнает, как больно внутри!
Я буду казаться в порядке — чувства сокрою свои.
Люди говорят о Боге — как это меня злит!
Уйдите, прошу, или о чём-то другом поговорим!»
Один на постели, он мысли не мог удержать.
«Устал я в неволе. Неужели есть благодать?
Нет, это не сработает, для меня уже слишком поздно».
Отвернувшись от Бога, он ждал своей участи безмолвно.

Проповедник не знал, что именно сказать
На похоронах человека, избравшего свой путь.
Он знал лишь, что тот сделал неверный выбор,
Ожесточил сердце и заглушил Божий голос.
Теперь уже ничего не изменить — ему придётся заплатить.
Смерть поглотила свою жертву — его душа навеки потеряна.

Editor’s Note:

Normally, we haven’t used our magazine to bring focus to any specific individual. However, in regard to Mose, we felt it would be fitting to provide a small tribute. Mose was instrumental in helping to get The Heartbeat of the Remnant magazine started way back over twenty years ago when it was first begun. Then years later when several churches divided some of the various aspects of ministry between themselves, Ephrata Christian Fellowship with Mose as one of its leaders, took on the publishing of the magazine as their own effort. They continued this for a number of years until it eventually went out of print temporarily due to their editors moving out of the area. Fast forward to 2016, when we (The Berean Voice) wanted to begin publishing a newsletter/magazine. When Mose realized what we were about to do, he requested that we take over the publication of their magazine since he and his fellow laborers wished to see it continue in print. In short, this is how we ended up publishing a magazine that had originally been published by another church in another state. Thus, it seems fitting to give recognition to the life Mose has lived and the path he has endeavored to blaze for others. It is with gratefulness that we remember the life and example Mose has left us with. And it is with humility that we will persevere in our efforts to keep this torch (the magazine) burning for Truth.

Mose S. Stoltzfus entered into his eternal rest on December 6, 2020, following a brief battle with Covid-19. The testimony of his life was that of a race well run, leaving a legacy of godly faithfulness to the end which others can follow. Brother Mose, as he was often referred to by his church brethren, will be greatly missed. Family, friends, business associates, and church brethren remember with gratitude how his life was a blessing to them. Most of all, he will be missed by his beloved wife, Rhoda.

Mose grew up in a home where he was taught the “fear of the Lord” and had a new birth into the Kingdom of God at the age of 15. This was the beginning of his love for God and His Word, the Holy Scriptures. This was a love which he pursued for the rest of his life, and which in time enabled him to be mighty in word and deed.

It has been my privilege to have known Brother Mose for nearly 30 years. Most of the fellowship we had together was related to the work of the Church, and of the Kingdom of God. What I want to share here concerning Brother Mose is largely related to his ministry in the Gospel.

One of the prominent gifts the Lord gave to Brother Mose was the gift of preaching. It was a gift that he pursued with zeal, not by constraint, but willingly. Whether it was just a few gathered in a living room or hundreds gathered in a community hall, he loved to preach the Gospel of Jesus Christ. He often preached to men and women who had troubled souls and were seeking a Savior. He preached to small assemblies of believers where new churches were beginning, helping them to be established in the faith. He preached in large churches and fellowship gatherings of saints encouraging and exhorting them to follow Christ.

Those who were around Brother Mose during his years of ministry know that he loved singing. He encouraged believers to open their mouth and praise the Lord in song, both individually and in the church assembly. Between 2010 and 2015, he took a small choir with him on several trips to Canada, singing and preaching as they visited various churches. He also made at least two trips to Germany during those years as well. The choir of youth that traveled with him would sing, and then he would preach in the German language. They visited about a dozen churches over the course of each three-week trip. On one trip, they also included a stop in a city for street witnessing and passing out tracts. Here again, Brother Mose preached in the German language to those under the sound of his voice.

When I consider the spirit and zeal of Brother Mose, the words of the Apostle Paul to the Romans seem very fitting: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise. So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also –Romans 1:14-15. Brother Mose saw himself as a debtor to make Christ known to many and was ready to preach wherever there was an open door. His ‘Rome’ was across America, Canada, and beyond. He was …not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: boldly proclaiming it to be …the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek –Romans 1:16.

For nearly two decades, from the late 1980’s and onward, Brother Mose frequently teamed up with Denny Kenaston, and they would travel to communities where they had an invitation to preach. Often, this would be a weekend event, starting Friday evening, going all day Saturday, and Sunday morning and afternoon. Sometimes it was a whole week or more of evening messages. One of them would preach one night, and the other the next night throughout the week. With much unction from the Holy One, they would preach the Gospel. There are many testimonies of new conversions, of repentance from sin, of revival, and of straying souls returning to the Savior.

Brother Mose sought the lost from any background and any place where they would come to listen. He even preached on city streets to those who never went to church. When he held meetings, many evangelical, protestant denominations were represented in those who came to hear him preach. But it was the various conservative, Anabaptist groups toward which his heart was especially drawn, since this was his own background. His specific concern was regarding those who had backslidden or strayed from the way of Truth. Whether those he encountered were Mennonite, Amish, or Hutterite, he could relate to their background and was well versed in the history of each group. He was able to preach in a powerful way to expose sin and error, while warning of judgment to come. He preached the cross of Christ as the hope of salvation to all who would believe.

Another gift Brother Mose had was in speaking with individuals one-on-one. It could be a middle-aged person on a hospital bed, a youth in a living room, or a young adult who had responded to the Holy Spirit’s moving after a preaching service. He had a way of gently asking them about the needs in their life, and then explaining clearly what needed to be done in order for them to be reconciled to God.

Throughout his ministry, Brother Mose labored much to establish churches on a right foundation. He was directly involved in the formation of a number of new churches, as well as advising and helping already established groups. He ordained men for the ministry in many churches, often with the assistance of elders from his own fellowship or those of a sister church. Issues such as brotherhood, unity, and proper leadership were important to him.

Brother Mose was often the watchman on the wall for the church in this generation. He would frequently warn against false doctrines that threatened to creep into churches. He was on guard against false teachers, false prophets, and even false brethren. In the face of these dangers to the church, he gave much attention to teaching sound doctrine. The Word of God was lifted up as the safe and sure foundation by which to judge what is true and what is false.

Brother Mose was a true leader. He led by direct action and by example. One thing that seemed to make him restless in spirit was to observe a situation where there was lack of leadership, for want of a man to stand in the gap. He was ready to step forward and serve when occasion called for it. But even as a strong leader, he surrounded himself with men who would labor with him. Throughout his years of ministry, he worked as a member of the body. Many of his preaching events across the country would be with fellow ministers preaching alongside him. When dealing with church problems, he would frequently seek out the council of fellow ministers. In the last handful of years, he was actively involved in the annual ministers’ meetings held in Indiana as the “Agape Christian Fellowship” group was being formulated and established. He would express, sometimes with tears, his rejoicing in the fellowship and council of his brethren who were laboring with him for the welfare of the various churches represented. There was also humility of mind in looking back over the years at those things that should have been done differently, whether errors or omissions, and acknowledging them as such. His passion was to see the church endure faithful unto the end.

And now Brother Mose has entered into his eternal rest. To those of us who knew him and labored with him remains the responsibility of carrying on the work of the Kingdom until Christ returns for His Church. May we be found of Him in peace, without spot and blameless.

সম্পাদকের বক্তব্য:

সাধারণত, আমাদের পত্রিকায় কোনো নির্দিষ্ট ব্যক্তিকে বিশেষভাবে তুলে ধরিনি। তবে মোজের ক্ষেত্রে আমরা মনে করেছি, তাঁকে সামান্য শ্রদ্ধা জানানো যথার্থ হবে। বিশ বছরেরও বেশি আগে, যখন দ্য হার্টবিট অব দ্য রেমন্যান্ট পত্রিকাটি প্রথম প্রকাশিত হয়, তখন সেটি শুরু করতে মোজ গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা পালন করেছিলেন। পরে, কয়েকটি মণ্ডলী পরিচর্যার বিভিন্ন দিক নিজেদের মধ্যে ভাগ করে নেওয়ার সময়, মোজ তাঁদের নেতাদের একজন হিসেবে ইফ্রাটা খ্রিস্টীয় ফেলোশিপ পত্রিকাটির প্রকাশনার দায়িত্ব নিজেদের উদ্যোগে গ্রহণ করে। সম্পাদকমণ্ডলীর সদস্যরা এলাকা ছেড়ে চলে যাওয়ায় সাময়িকভাবে পত্রিকাটির প্রকাশনা বন্ধ হওয়ার আগে পর্যন্ত তারা বেশ কয়েক বছর এটি চালিয়ে যায়। এরপর ২০১৬ সালে, আমরা (দ্য বেরিয়ান ভয়েস) একটি সংবাদপত্রিকা/পত্রিকা প্রকাশ শুরু করতে চাইলাম। আমরা কী করতে যাচ্ছি তা বুঝতে পেরে মোজ অনুরোধ করলেন, আমরা যেন তাঁদের পত্রিকাটির প্রকাশনার দায়িত্ব নিই, কারণ তিনি ও তাঁর সহকর্মীরা পত্রিকাটির প্রকাশনা অব্যাহত দেখতে চেয়েছিলেন। সংক্ষেপে, এভাবেই আমরা অন্য একটি অঙ্গরাজ্যের অন্য একটি মণ্ডলী দ্বারা প্রথম প্রকাশিত একটি পত্রিকার প্রকাশক হলাম। তাই মোজ যে জীবন যাপন করেছেন এবং অন্যদের জন্য পথ নির্মাণে যে প্রচেষ্টা করেছেন, তার স্বীকৃতি জানানো যথার্থ বলেই মনে হয়। মোজের জীবন ও তাঁর রেখে যাওয়া দৃষ্টান্ত আমরা কৃতজ্ঞতার সঙ্গে স্মরণ করি। আর সত্যের এই মশাল—পত্রিকাটি—জ্বালিয়ে রাখতে আমাদের প্রচেষ্টা অব্যাহত রাখব বিনয়ের সঙ্গে।

মোজ এস. স্টল্টজফাস কোভিড-১৯-এর সঙ্গে সংক্ষিপ্ত লড়াইয়ের পর ২০২০ সালের ৬ ডিসেম্বর তাঁর চিরন্তন বিশ্রামে প্রবেশ করেন। তাঁর জীবনের সাক্ষ্য ছিল—তিনি দৌড়টি ভালোভাবে শেষ করেছেন এবং শেষ পর্যন্ত ঈশ্বরভক্ত বিশ্বস্ততার এমন এক উত্তরাধিকার রেখে গেছেন, যা অন্যরা অনুসরণ করতে পারে। মণ্ডলীর ভাইয়েরা প্রায়ই তাঁকে ভাই মোজ বলে উল্লেখ করতেন; তাঁকে ভীষণভাবে মিস করবেন তাঁরা। পরিবার, বন্ধুবান্ধব, ব্যবসায়িক সহযোগী এবং মণ্ডলীর ভাইয়েরা কৃতজ্ঞতার সঙ্গে স্মরণ করেন, কীভাবে তাঁর জীবন তাঁদের আশীর্বাদ হয়েছিল। সর্বোপরি, তাঁর প্রিয় স্ত্রী, রোডা, তাঁকে মিস করবেন।

মোজ এমন এক পরিবারে বড় হয়েছিলেন, যেখানে তাঁকে “প্রভুর ভয়” শিক্ষা দেওয়া হয়েছিল; ১৫ বছর বয়সে তিনি ঈশ্বরের রাজ্যে নতুন জন্ম লাভ করেন। এটাই ছিল ঈশ্বর এবং তাঁর বাক্য, পবিত্র শাস্ত্রের প্রতি তাঁর ভালোবাসার শুরু। এই ভালোবাসার অনুগামী তিনি সারা জীবন ছিলেন, আর সময়ের সঙ্গে তা তাঁকে বাক্যে ও কাজে পরাক্রমী করে তোলে।

প্রায় ৩০ বছর ধরে ভাই মোজকে জানার সুযোগ আমার হয়েছে। আমাদের একসঙ্গে অধিকাংশ সহভাগিতাই মণ্ডলীর কাজ ও ঈশ্বরের রাজ্যের সঙ্গে সম্পর্কিত ছিল। ভাই মোজের বিষয়ে এখানে যা বলতে চাই, তা মূলত সুসমাচারে তাঁর পরিচর্যার সঙ্গে সম্পর্কিত।

প্রভু ভাই মোজকে যে উল্লেখযোগ্য দানগুলো দিয়েছিলেন, তার একটি ছিল প্রচার করার দান। তিনি উৎসাহের সঙ্গে এই দানের চর্চা করতেন—বাধ্য হয়ে নয়, স্বেচ্ছায়। বসার ঘরে অল্প কয়েকজন জড়ো হোক কিংবা কমিউনিটি হলে শত শত মানুষ—তিনি যিশু খ্রিস্টের সুসমাচার প্রচার করতে ভালোবাসতেন। প্রায়ই তিনি সেই নারী-পুরুষদের কাছে প্রচার করতেন, যাদের অন্তর ছিল বিপর্যস্ত এবং যারা একজন ত্রাণকর্তার খোঁজ করছিলেন। নতুন মণ্ডলী গড়ে উঠছিল এমন বিশ্বাসীদের ছোট সমাবেশে তিনি প্রচার করতেন এবং তাদের বিশ্বাসে প্রতিষ্ঠিত হতে সাহায্য করতেন। সাধুদের বড় মণ্ডলী ও সহভাগিতার সমাবেশে তিনি খ্রিস্টকে অনুসরণ করতে উৎসাহ ও উদ্দীপনা দিতেন।

পরিচর্যার বছরগুলোতে যারা ভাই মোজের আশেপাশে ছিলেন, তাঁরা জানেন যে তিনি গান গাইতে ভালোবাসতেন। তিনি বিশ্বাসীদের একাকী এবং মণ্ডলীর সমাবেশে—উভয় ক্ষেত্রেই—মুখ খুলে গান গেয়ে প্রভুর প্রশংসা করতে উৎসাহিত করতেন। ২০১০ থেকে ২০১৫ সালের মধ্যে তিনি কয়েকটি সফরে একটি ছোট গায়কদলকে সঙ্গে নিয়ে কানাডায় গিয়েছিলেন; বিভিন্ন মণ্ডলী পরিদর্শনের সময় তারা গান গাইত এবং তিনি প্রচার করতেন। সেই বছরগুলোতে তিনি অন্তত দুবার জার্মানিতেও গিয়েছিলেন। তাঁর সঙ্গে সফর করা যুবকদের গায়কদল গান গাইত, তারপর তিনি জার্মান ভাষায় প্রচার করতেন। প্রতিটি তিন সপ্তাহের সফরে তারা প্রায় এক ডজন মণ্ডলী পরিদর্শন করত। একটি সফরে তারা পথচারীদের কাছে সাক্ষ্য দেওয়া ও প্রচারপত্র বিলি করার জন্য একটি শহরেও থেমেছিল। সেখানেও ভাই মোজ তাঁর কণ্ঠস্বরের আওতায় যারা ছিলেন, তাদের কাছে জার্মান ভাষায় প্রচার করেছিলেন।

ভাই মোজের মনোভাব ও উৎসাহের কথা ভাবলে, রোমীয়দের প্রতি প্রেরিত পৌলের কথাগুলো খুবই যথোপযুক্ত মনে হয়: “আমি গ্রিক ও বর্বর—উভয়েরই ঋণী; জ্ঞানী ও অজ্ঞান—উভয়েরই ঋণী। অতএব, আমার সাধ্য অনুযায়ী রোমে তোমাদের কাছেও সুসমাচার প্রচার করতে আমি প্রস্তুত।” –রোমীয় ১:১৪-১৫। ভাই মোজ নিজেকে অনেকের কাছে খ্রিস্টকে পরিচিত করানোর দায়ে ঋণী বলে মনে করতেন এবং যেখানে দরজা খোলা থাকত, সেখানেই প্রচার করতে প্রস্তুত থাকতেন। তাঁর ‘রোম’ ছিল আমেরিকা, কানাডা এবং তারও বাইরে। তিনি “…খ্রিস্টের সুসমাচারে লজ্জিত ছিলেন না;” সাহসের সঙ্গে ঘোষণা করতেন যে তা “…বিশ্বাস করে এমন প্রত্যেকের পরিত্রাণের জন্য ঈশ্বরের শক্তি—প্রথমে ইহুদির, পরে গ্রিকেরও।” –রোমীয় ১:১৬।

প্রায় দুই দশক ধরে, ১৯৮০-এর দশকের শেষভাগ থেকে, ভাই মোজ প্রায়ই ডেনি কেনাস্টনের সঙ্গে দল বেঁধে এমন সব জনপদে যেতেন, যেখানে প্রচার করার আমন্ত্রণ পেয়েছিলেন। প্রায়ই তা হতো সপ্তাহান্তের অনুষ্ঠান—শুক্রবার সন্ধ্যায় শুরু হয়ে শনিবার সারাদিন এবং রবিবার সকাল ও বিকেল পর্যন্ত চলত। কখনো কখনো তা সন্ধ্যার বাণীসহ পুরো এক সপ্তাহ বা তারও বেশি সময় ধরে চলত। সপ্তাহজুড়ে এক রাতে একজন প্রচার করতেন, পরের রাতে অন্যজন। পবিত্রজনের কাছ থেকে প্রচুর অভিষেক নিয়ে তাঁরা সুসমাচার প্রচার করতেন। নতুন করে বিশ্বাসে আসা, পাপ থেকে মন ফেরানো, পুনর্জাগরণ এবং পথভ্রষ্ট আত্মাদের ত্রাণকর্তার কাছে ফিরে আসার বহু সাক্ষ্য রয়েছে।

ভাই মোজ যেকোনো পটভূমির ও যেকোনো স্থানের হারানো মানুষদের খুঁজতেন, যেখানে তারা তাঁর কথা শুনতে আসত। যারা কখনো মণ্ডলীতে যেত না, তাদের কাছেও তিনি শহরের রাস্তায় প্রচার করতেন। তাঁর সভাগুলোতে প্রচুর ইভানজেলিক্যাল ও প্রোটেস্ট্যান্ট সম্প্রদায়ের লোকেরা তাঁকে শুনতে আসতেন। তবে রক্ষণশীল অ্যানাব্যাপ্টিস্ট গোষ্ঠীগুলোর প্রতি তাঁর হৃদয়ের আকর্ষণ ছিল বিশেষভাবে, কারণ সেটিই ছিল তাঁর নিজের পটভূমি। যারা পশ্চাদপসরণ করেছিল বা সত্যের পথ থেকে সরে গিয়েছিল, তাদের নিয়ে তিনি বিশেষভাবে উদ্বিগ্ন ছিলেন। যাদের সঙ্গেই তাঁর দেখা হতো—মেনোনাইট, আমিশ কিংবা হাটেরাইট—তাদের পটভূমির সঙ্গে তিনি নিজেকে মেলাতে পারতেন এবং প্রতিটি গোষ্ঠীর ইতিহাস সম্পর্কে তাঁর ভালো জ্ঞান ছিল। পাপ ও ভ্রান্তি প্রকাশ করে আসন্ন বিচারের বিষয়ে সতর্ক করতে তিনি শক্তিশালীভাবে প্রচার করতে পারতেন। যারা বিশ্বাস করবে, তাদের সকলের পরিত্রাণের আশা হিসেবে তিনি খ্রিস্টের ক্রুশ প্রচার করতেন।

ভাই মোজের আরেকটি দান ছিল ব্যক্তির সঙ্গে একান্তে কথা বলা। সেই ব্যক্তি হতে পারতেন হাসপাতালের বিছানায় থাকা একজন মধ্যবয়সী মানুষ, বসার ঘরে থাকা কোনো কিশোর-কিশোরী, কিংবা প্রচারসভার পর পবিত্র আত্মার অনুপ্রেরণায় সাড়া দেওয়া কোনো তরুণ প্রাপ্তবয়স্ক। তাদের জীবনের প্রয়োজনগুলো নিয়ে কোমলভাবে প্রশ্ন করার এবং ঈশ্বরের সঙ্গে পুনর্মিলিত হতে তাদের কী করা প্রয়োজন তা স্পষ্টভাবে ব্যাখ্যা করার এক বিশেষ ভঙ্গি তাঁর ছিল।

তাঁর পরিচর্যার পুরো সময় জুড়ে ভাই মোজ সঠিক ভিত্তির ওপর মণ্ডলী প্রতিষ্ঠা করতে অক্লান্ত পরিশ্রম করেছেন। তিনি সরাসরি অনেক নতুন মণ্ডলী গঠনে যুক্ত ছিলেন, পাশাপাশি আগে থেকেই প্রতিষ্ঠিত গোষ্ঠীগুলোকে পরামর্শ ও সাহায্য করেছেন। বহু মণ্ডলীতে তিনি পরিচর্যার জন্য পুরুষদের অভিষিক্ত করেছেন, প্রায়ই নিজের সহভাগিতার প্রবীণদের অথবা কোনো ভগিনী মণ্ডলীর প্রবীণদের সহায়তায়। ভ্রাতৃত্ব, ঐক্য এবং যথাযথ নেতৃত্বের মতো বিষয়গুলো তাঁর কাছে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ছিল।

এই প্রজন্মে মণ্ডলীর জন্য ভাই মোজ প্রায়ই প্রাচীরের ওপর প্রহরীর ভূমিকা পালন করতেন। মণ্ডলীতে অনুপ্রবেশের হুমকি হয়ে ওঠা ভ্রান্ত মতবাদের বিরুদ্ধে তিনি প্রায়ই সতর্ক করতেন। ভণ্ড শিক্ষক, ভণ্ড ভাববাদী, এমনকি ভণ্ড ভাইদের বিষয়েও তিনি সতর্ক থাকতেন। মণ্ডলীর জন্য এসব বিপদের মুখে তিনি বিশুদ্ধ মতবাদ শেখানোর ওপর অনেক গুরুত্ব দিতেন। কোনটি সত্য আর কোনটি মিথ্যা তা বিচার করার নিরাপদ ও নিশ্চিত ভিত্তি হিসেবে ঈশ্বরের বাক্যকে তুলে ধরা হতো।

ভাই মোজ ছিলেন একজন প্রকৃত নেতা। সরাসরি কাজ করে এবং উদাহরণের মাধ্যমে তিনি নেতৃত্ব দিতেন। নেতৃত্বের অভাব আছে—কারণ ফাঁকে দাঁড়ানোর মতো কোনো পুরুষ নেই—এমন পরিস্থিতি দেখলে তাঁর মনে অস্থিরতা দেখা দিত বলে মনে হতো। প্রয়োজন দেখা দিলে তিনি এগিয়ে এসে সেবা করতে প্রস্তুত থাকতেন। কিন্তু শক্তিশালী নেতা হয়েও তিনি এমন পুরুষদের পাশে রাখতেন, যারা তাঁর সঙ্গে পরিশ্রম করবে। পরিচর্যার বছরগুলোতে তিনি দেহের একজন সদস্য হিসেবে কাজ করেছেন। সারা দেশে তাঁর প্রচার-অনুষ্ঠানগুলোর অনেকগুলোতেই সহপরিচারকেরা তাঁর পাশাপাশি প্রচার করতেন। মণ্ডলীর সমস্যা মোকাবিলা করার সময় তিনি প্রায়ই সহপরিচারকদের পরামর্শ নিতেন। শেষ কয়েক বছরে, “আগাপে খ্রিস্টীয় সহভাগিতা” গোষ্ঠী গঠিত ও প্রতিষ্ঠিত হওয়ার সময়, ইন্ডিয়ানায় অনুষ্ঠিত বার্ষিক পরিচারক-সমাবেশগুলোতে তিনি সক্রিয়ভাবে যুক্ত ছিলেন। তাঁর সঙ্গে বিভিন্ন মণ্ডলীর কল্যাণে কাজ করা ভাইদের সহভাগিতা ও পরামর্শে তিনি আনন্দ প্রকাশ করতেন—কখনো কখনো চোখের জলে। অতীতের দিকে ফিরে তাকিয়ে যেসব কাজ অন্যভাবে করা উচিত ছিল—ভুল বা বাদ পড়া বিষয়—সেগুলোকে সেভাবে স্বীকার করার মধ্যেও তাঁর বিনয়ী মনোভাব প্রকাশ পেত। শেষ পর্যন্ত বিশ্বস্ত থেকে মণ্ডলীর টিকে থাকা দেখাই ছিল তাঁর প্রবল আকাঙ্ক্ষা।

এখন ভাই মোজ তাঁর চিরন্তন বিশ্রামে প্রবেশ করেছেন। যারা তাঁকে চিনতাম এবং তাঁর সঙ্গে কাজ করেছি, খ্রিস্ট তাঁর মণ্ডলীর জন্য ফিরে না আসা পর্যন্ত রাজ্যের কাজ চালিয়ে যাওয়ার দায়িত্ব আমাদের ওপর রয়ে গেছে। তিনি যেন আমাদের শান্তিতে, নিষ্কলঙ্ক ও নির্দোষ অবস্থায় পান।
