Proprio nel punto di svolta della nostra linea temporale, misurata in anni, si trova la nascita incarnata del nostro Signore Gesù Cristo. Egli occupa giustamente questo posto, perché nessun altro avvento avrebbe potuto incidere sull’umanità in modo così profondo. Gli anni che precedono la sua nascita sono indicati con a.C., cioè «avanti Cristo», mentre quelli successivi sono indicati con d.C. (Anno Domini, in latino «nell’anno del Signore»). Sebbene la sua nascita sia stata del tutto ingarbugliata e confusa da influenze pagane e dall’indulgenza personale, la semplice e radiosa bellezza dell’evento è ancora accessibile a chiunque voglia contemplare con sincerità la scena nella sua purezza.

Sebbene il calendario abbia collocato la nascita di Cristo il 25 dicembre, la maggior parte degli studiosi ha concluso che questa data non è esatta. È stato inoltre stabilito che anche l’anno effettivo attribuito alla sua nascita è errato di 4-6 anni. La data fu fissata dal vescovo di Roma in accordo con una popolare festa pagana chiamata Saturnalia. I romani pagani adoravano Saturno come dio dell’agricoltura, celebrando banchetti e feste, decorando le case con sempreverdi, scambiandosi doni e dando libero sfogo all’allegria. Il vescovo si proponeva di esercitare un’influenza santificatrice sui festeggiamenti e di distogliere i pensieri della popolazione dall’indulgenza egoistica per rivolgerli a Dio incarnato. Come è facile aspettarsi, i festeggiamenti pagani non persero il ritmo e proseguirono come prima. La chiesa, che inizialmente aveva guardato con disapprovazione alla proposta, alla fine accettò l’idea e, nel quarto secolo, si era pienamente adattata e assuefatta alla mescolanza ibrida di elementi cristiani e pagani.

Oggi, dunque, ci troviamo davanti a un dilemma. Come dovrebbe considerare un cristiano la nascita di Cristo? Dovremmo cercare di mantenere Cristo nel Natale o di toglierlo? A prescindere dalla nostra opinione, ciascuno di noi deve davvero risolversi a comprendere il significato della nascita verginale, prescindendo dai legami emotivi con la celebrazione ibrida, e a riconoscere la nascita nel modo stabilito da Dio. In contrasto con i milioni di persone che oggi ne celebrano la nascita, furono soltanto una manciata di persone, insignificanti, quelle in grado e degne di assistere all’evento vero e proprio.

In quella stessa regione c’erano dei pastori che stavano nei campi e di notte vegliavano sul loro gregge. Ed ecco, un angelo del Signore si presentò a loro e la gloria del Signore risplendé intorno a loro, e furono presi da grande spavento. L’angelo disse loro: «Non temete, perché ecco, vi porto la buona notizia di una grande gioia che tutto il popolo avrà: oggi, nella città di Davide, è nato per voi un Salvatore, che è Cristo, il Signore. E questo vi servirà di segno: troverete un bambino avvolto in fasce e coricato in una mangiatoia». E a un tratto si unì all’angelo una moltitudine dell’esercito celeste, che lodava Dio e diceva: «Gloria a Dio nei luoghi altissimi, e pace in terra, benevolenza verso gli uomini» –Luca 2:8-14.

Fu un gruppo di umili pastori a ricevere il primo annuncio della nascita. Persino questi uomini rozzi e ignoranti conoscevano il Messia atteso e lo desideravano ardentemente. Ma tu, Betlemme Efrata, piccola per essere fra le migliaia di Giuda, da te uscirà per me colui che sarà dominatore in Israele; le sue origini risalgono ai tempi antichi, ai giorni eterni –Michea 5:2.

Mentre i cieli stellati esplodevano di vita, i pastori contemplarono con stupore rapito la scena davanti a loro e un nuovo giorno cominciò ad albeggiare all’orizzonte delle loro anime. Le schiere angeliche proclamarono il loro messaggio ai pastori, poi svanirono presto; ma la buona notizia rimase. L’incontro fu soltanto un breve soffio, eppure nei cuori ardenti di quegli uomini persistette una fragranza triplice: un Salvatore… un Segno… e un Canto…

…Un Salvatore

Il fatto stesso che sia promesso un Salvatore implica che ci sia qualcosa da cui abbiamo bisogno di essere salvati. Qualunque sia la nostra condizione fisica, lo stato spirituale dell’uomo è sull’orlo della disperazione sin dalla caduta nell’Eden. Per quattro millenni, la razza umana era rimasta rannicchiata sotto la nube diabolica del peccato, e molti erano caduti preda delle sue minacciose tenebre. Il peccato può prendere una candela di speranza e spegnerla in un istante. Può soffiare il suo gelido alito sui fiori più belli e farli appassire in un istante. Prende matrimoni amorevoli e li trascina nelle convulsioni della guerra interna. Prende il sincero sbocciare della giovinezza e lo priva del profumo della sua innocenza. Coloro che sono riusciti a liberarsi dalla schiavitù della sua soggezione personale possono vedere facilmente quanto sia stata angusta la loro fuga dalla società folle che li circonda. Perciò, gli umili pastori si rallegrarono per l’avvento di un Salvatore.

Tutti hanno peccato e sono ricaduti sotto la sua condanna. Il solo pensiero di essere liberati dalla giurisdizione incombente della giusta punizione è una boccata d’aria fresca. Dio infatti non ha mandato suo Figlio nel mondo per condannare il mondo, ma perché il mondo sia salvato per mezzo di lui –Giovanni 3:17. Coloro che si sono convertiti davvero portano nell’anima la speranza della vita eterna e la promessa del cielo. Diventano nuove creature quando lo Spirito Santo prende dimora nei loro cuori. Sebbene ciò abbia un effetto profondo sulla vita del credente, questi non sono gli unici aspetti della salvezza. Questo Salvatore è anche un Signore.

Come il titolo di «Salvatore» implica un bisogno disperato, così il nome di «Cristo, il Signore» implica una vittoria assoluta. Chi persiste nel peccare è dal diavolo, perché il diavolo pecca fin dal principio. Per questo è stato manifestato il Figlio di Dio: per distruggere le opere del diavolo –1 Giovanni 3:8. Non solo saremo liberati dalla condanna del peccato, ma dobbiamo anche essere salvati dal suo potere e dalla sua influenza. Le abitudini debilitanti che abbiamo accumulato nella nostra natura peccaminosa devono ricevere un colpo mortale. Le passioni e le concupiscenze che ci dominavano prima che la sua influenza entrasse nella nostra vita devono essere sottomesse a lui. Anche l’orgoglio egoistico e il temperamento irruento dell’uomo, che hanno distrutto relazioni e ferito le persone che amiamo, devono essere inghiottiti da questa vittoria. Se Cristo non è il nostro Signore, allora non è neppure il nostro Salvatore.

Che bambino è questo, che giace addormentato,
sul grembo di Maria?
Gli angeli lo salutano con dolci inni,
mentre i pastori vegliano.
Questo, questo è Cristo Re,
che i pastori custodiscono e gli angeli cantano.
Presto, presto, rendetegli onore,
al Bambino, Figlio di Maria.

…Un Segno

Si potrebbe ben pensare che la visita angelica fosse un segno assai più grande del bambino nella mangiatoia. Chi di noi ha mai provato la gioia di udire un coro così celeste? Leggendo il racconto, non si può che immaginare la bellezza rapitrice di miriadi di voci celesti che risuonano insieme e riempiono il fianco della montagna di un barlume di cielo quale la terra non ha più conosciuto dal giorno della creazione: Quando le stelle del mattino cantavano tutte insieme, e tutti i figli di Dio mandavano grida di gioia –Giobbe 38:7. Eppure gli angeli non erano il segno.

Il fatto che questo bambino fosse stato concepito per opera dello Spirito Santo, come descritto in Matteo 1:20, deve essere accolto per fede e difficilmente può essere considerato un segno terreno. Il fatto che il bambino fosse avvolto in fasce non aveva nulla di straordinario, perché tutte le madri di quei tempi facevano così. In uno dei capitoli più espliciti sulla nascita di un bambino, Dio dice che nessuno si prese cura di Israele alla sua nascita: Quanto alla tua nascita, il giorno che nascesti, il tuo cordone ombelicale non fu tagliato, non fosti lavata con acqua per renderti morbida; non fosti affatto salata né avvolta in fasce –Ezechiele 16:4. Questi indizi sarebbero inutili per cercare il bambino. Il segno rivelatore di questo evento è la culla del bambino. Nessuna madre sceglierebbe un ricovero per il bestiame come sala parto e deporrebbe il neonato in una mangiatoia, se non costretta dalla necessità.

Il segno della mangiatoia, insieme alla conoscenza che i pastori avevano delle Scritture riguardo a Betlemme, era tutto ciò che occorreva loro per trovare il bambino. Le Scritture non menzionano affatto le comodità di una stalla. I pastori conoscevano bene le zone della città destinate agli animali, e il loro viaggio ebbe inizio.

Perciò anche Gesù, per santificare il popolo con il proprio sangue, soffrì fuori della porta. Usciamo dunque fuori dell’accampamento e andiamo a lui, portando il suo obbrobrio –Ebrei 13:12-13. Questo segno richiede una partecipazione personale. Chiunque abbia un cuore fedele a questa scena deve anche andare ad accompagnarlo. Non lo si adempirà partecipando a una rappresentazione di un presepe vivente, a uno spettacolo del «Messia» o andando a casa della nonna per il pranzo di Natale. Dobbiamo prendere parte alle sue sofferenze, come fece Tommaso quando disse …agli altri discepoli: «Andiamo anche noi, per morire con lui» –Giovanni 11:16.

Per visitare il bambino Cristo dovremo aggirarci fuori dalla locanda. La folla della locanda è il luogo dell’accoglienza popolare, della comprensione popolare e del comportamento popolare. Lì ci attendono le comodità degli amici, della famiglia e della compagnia, mentre ci offre un senso di appartenenza e di accettazione. Cristo non conobbe un lusso simile né alla nascita né alla morte, e scelse di stare fuori dalla folla della locanda.

Chi ha creduto a quel che abbiamo annunciato? A chi è stato rivelato il braccio del Signore? Egli è cresciuto davanti a lui come una pianticella, come una radice da un arido suolo. Non aveva forma né bellezza da attirare i nostri sguardi, né aspetto tale da piacere. Disprezzato e abbandonato dagli uomini, uomo di dolore, familiare con la sofferenza, pari a colui davanti al quale ciascuno si nasconde la faccia, era spregiato, e noi non ne facemmo stima alcuna –Isaia 53:1-3.

I pastori disprezzati trascorrevano gran parte della loro vita fuori dalla folla della locanda e furono i primi a credere in lui e ad accoglierlo. La fedeltà a Cristo richiede di separarsi dalle fedeltà del mondo, compresa la maggior parte delle sue celebrazioni, sempre popolari, della nascita di Cristo. È una chiamata a seguire la sua scelta di uscire dall’accampamento. Questa è la differenza tra il culto di nome e la lode sentita dei suoi redenti, che non fanno che seguirlo fino alla mangiatoia.

Perché giace in una condizione così umile,
dove si nutrono il bue e l’asino?
Buoni cristiani, non temete: per i peccatori
la Parola silenziosa intercede.
Chiodi e lance lo trafiggeranno,
la croce che portò per me e per te.
Salute, salute alla Parola fatta carne,
al Bambino, Figlio di Maria.

…Un Canto

Coloro che desiderano conoscerlo devono avventurarsi fuori dalla locanda e prendere parte …alla comunione delle sue sofferenze, diventando conformi a lui nella sua morte –Filippesi 3:10. Mentre raccolgono scherni e disprezzo dalla folla della locanda, scopriranno anche di essere accolti da un canto celeste. Gloria a Dio nei luoghi altissimi, e pace in terra, benevolenza verso gli uomini –Luca 2:14.

Man mano che la nostra parte in questa vita terrena si riduce, cresce la misura della nostra gloriosa lode. Gli ebrei si scandalizzarono perché il Messia non era venuto a dare loro una parte più grande e la vittoria sul mondo romano. Gesù …guardò la città e pianse su di essa, dicendo: «Oh, se tu pure avessi conosciuto, in questo giorno, ciò che occorre per la tua pace! Ma ora è nascosto agli occhi tuoi» –Luca 19:41-42. La pace in terra non si raggiungerà mai grazie alla perfezione dell’ambiente. Chi alloggia alla locanda trova la pace nella compagnia pulita, comoda e cortese degli altri. Questa è la pace popolare e viziata che il mondo promuove e rappresenta, ma non coincide con quella del bambino nella misera mangiatoia. Eppure furono quelli fuori dalla locanda a imparare il canto.

E cantavano un cantico nuovo … e nessuno poteva imparare il cantico se non i centoquarantaquattromila, che sono stati riscattati dalla terra –Apocalisse 14:3. Sono coloro che sono in pace con la loro condizione terrena. Non si lasceranno turbare quando qualcun altro sarà promosso, possiederà più beni terreni o riceverà maggiore attenzione. Sono contenti di un cottage, mentre altri si rinchiudono in un castello. Non si lasciano persuadere a invidiare, anche se altri… vanno in quel posto, fanno quella cosa o ne possiedono uno. Altri …trovano strano che voi non corriate con loro agli stessi eccessi di dissolutezza, e parlano male di voi –1 Pietro 4:4.

La pace in terra non è altro che il grande guadagno che viene con la pietà e la contentezza. Alcuni si chiedono come Davide abbia potuto peccare con Bath-Sceba, pur avendo più mogli. Come avrebbe potuto non farlo? Un’abbondanza di possibilità non genera maggiore contentezza. Il bambino capriccioso nel negozio urla perché ha le mani piene e non può avere altro. Allo stesso modo, gli intenditori di motel dei nostri giorni deprezzano qualsiasi alloggio che non sia perfetto. Sanno cantare le lodi di un albergo e ristorante a cinque stelle, ma non si accorgono del canto presso la mangiatoia.

Coloro i cui cuori risuonano di benevolenza verso gli uomini provano una grande gioia, come gli abitanti più ricchi della terra. Possono rallegrarsi della promozione, della buona sorte e del successo altrui. Così facendo, ereditano la terra. Questo è il canto che Stefano intonò prima di lasciare la vita terrena. Parlò di Abramo che si allontanò dalla sua terra, Atti 7:3; di Giuseppe che fu venduto e allontanato dalla sua casa, v. 9; e di Mosè che fu cacciato e fuggì a Madian, v. 21. Questi è colui che era nella chiesa nel deserto, v. 38. Era la stessa chiesa disprezzata a cui Stefano si unì, e perciò ricevette lo stesso trattamento. Essi allora gridarono a gran voce, si turarono gli orecchi e si avventarono tutti insieme su di lui; poi lo cacciarono fuori della città e lo lapidarono… Egli si inginocchiò e gridò a gran voce: «Signore, non imputar loro questo peccato». E detto questo si addormentò –Atti 7:57-60.

Portategli dunque incenso, oro e mirra,
venite, povero e re, a riconoscerlo.
Il Re dei re porta la salvezza,
i cuori amorosi lo intronizzino.

Questa è gloria a Dio. Questa è pace in terra. Questa è benevolenza verso gli uomini.

I used to pray for sunshine,
No storms to mark the sky.
For cool breezes and flowers
To please and turn my eye.

I used to pray for happiness,
For smiles, joy, and peace.
That all things would be easy,
And all harsh things would cease.

I used to pray for someone,
To walk with in this life.
To love, laugh with, and cherish,
And dissipate all strife.

I used to pray that always
Life’s pathways would be clear.
That no unwanted circumstance
Would make existence drear.

But those prayers seemed to go unheeded,
For life didn’t flow that way.
The storms—they came uninvited,
Thick rains made many a dark day.

The flowers were not to be seen,
The wind did cut and slash.
No peace could be found about me;
Instead, the thunder did crash.

Not one was found to walk with me,
Alone, through rough ways I did roam.
Gone were the dreams of tranquility,
My soul cried with desire for a home.

Then, a rich voice spoke inside me,
“You’ve been seeking the things you can see.
The true prayers of your heart can be answered,
If you would only but look unto Me.

I have heard your needs and desires,
Your prayers did not fall unheard.
But I saw that your heart needed different
Than the way that ease had preferred.

You prayed for clear skies and sunshine,
For cool breezes and flowers to start.
But I saw that just these would not yield you
The real peace you sought in your heart.

I ordered the rough ways you have followed,
Not to disappoint, but to purge.
For I knew that true happiness begins only
In the heart that with Me does merge.”

So I fell at the feet of my Master
And yielded to His will and His plan.
No longer demanding my wants now,
But trusting He’d finish what He began.

Not long after, I found I was happy;
Not a cloud in my heart could prevail.
Even if my circumstances seemed weary,
No outer storm my inner Sunshine could pale.

The cool breezes of sweet rest in Him,
Did calm all my worries and fears.
And always the flowers of His promises,
Were visible when life brought me tears.

I found also, I no longer walked alone;
The Good Shepherd was there by my side!
With Him I could share my joys and sorrows,
And amidst any battle, in Him I could hide.

So now instead of praying
For things of earthly ease,
I thank the Lord for sending things
That brought me to my knees.

I pray instead for humility,
To lead me through the day.
For an eye to serve, and share the blessings,
That the Lord does send my way.

I pray that my heart would be yielded,
To the touch of the Master’s hand.
Allowing His will to change me,
Through everything He has planned.

For I’ve found that true happiness,
Is not in a smooth, perfect life.
But it’s found when in Christ we are rooted,
Not moved through fire or strife.

If He rules the inmost being,
Then nothing outside will disturb.
For He is the solid Foundation,
And the real source of True Life superb.

","section":"Poem","subtitle":null,"title":"I Used To Pray"},"source_context":{"byline":{"authors":[{"name":"Adrianna Fanton"}],"raw":"–By Adrianna Fanton"}},"target_language":"Russian","terminology_glossary":{},"translation":{"html":"

Прежде я молилась о солнце,
Чтоб тучи не омрачали небес.
О прохладном ветерке и цветах,
Что радовали бы взгляд.

Прежде я молилась о счастье,
Об улыбках, радости и покое.
Чтоб всё давалось легко,
А всё тягостное прекратилось.

Прежде я молилась о том,
Чтобы спутник шёл со мной по жизни,
Чтобы любить, смеяться вместе и дорожить им,
И чтобы исчезли все раздоры.

Прежде я молилась, чтобы всегда
Жизненные пути были ясны,
Чтобы никакие нежеланные обстоятельства
Не омрачали существования.

Но казалось, молитвы оставались без ответа,
Ведь жизнь текла совсем не так.
Бури приходили незваными,
Ливни делали многие дни мрачными.

Цветов не было видно,
Ветер хлестал и резал.
Вокруг меня не найти было покоя;
Вместо него гремел гром.

Не нашлось никого, кто шёл бы со мной;
Одна, трудными путями я бродила.
Исчезли мечты о безмятежности,
Душа взывала, жаждая дома.

И тогда внутри меня прозвучал звучный голос:
«Ты искала того, что можно увидеть.
На истинные молитвы твоего сердца может быть дан ответ,
Если только ты обратишь взор ко Мне.

Я слышал твои нужды и желания,
Твои молитвы не остались неуслышанными.
Но Я видел: твоему сердцу нужно было иное,
Не то, что предпочитала безмятежная жизнь.

Ты молилась о ясном небе и солнце,
О прохладном ветерке и первых цветах.
Но Я видел: лишь это не принесло бы тебе
Истинного покоя, которого искало твоё сердце.

Я направил тебя трудными путями,
Не чтобы разочаровать, а чтобы очистить.
Ведь Я знал: истинное счастье начинается лишь
В сердце, которое соединяется со Мной».

И я пала к ногам моего Владыки
И покорилась Его воле и замыслу.
Больше не требуя того, чего хотела,
А доверяя, что Он завершит начатое.

Вскоре я поняла, что счастлива;
Ни одно облако не могло омрачить моё сердце.
Даже если обстоятельства казались тягостными,
Ни одна внешняя буря не могла затмить внутреннее Солнце.

Прохладное дуновение сладкого покоя в Нём
Унимало все мои тревоги и страхи.
И цветы Его обетований всегда
Были видны, когда жизнь приносила мне слёзы.

Я также поняла, что больше не иду одна;
Добрый Пастырь был рядом со мной!
С Ним я могла делить радости и печали,
И среди любых битв укрыться в Нём.

Теперь вместо молитв
О земном благополучии
Я благодарю Господа за то, что Он послал мне то,
Что поставило меня на колени.

Теперь я молюсь о смирении,
Чтобы оно вело меня весь день;
Чтобы видеть, кому послужить и с кем разделить благословения,
Которые Господь посылает на моём пути.

Я молюсь, чтобы моё сердце покорилось
Прикосновению руки Владыки,
Позволяя Его воле менять меня
Через всё, что Он предназначил.

Ведь я поняла: истинное счастье —
Не в гладкой, безупречной жизни.
Оно обретается, когда мы укоренены во Христе
И не отступаем ни перед огнём, ни перед раздорами.

Если Он владычествует в глубине души,
Ничто внешнее не потревожит её.
Ведь Он — прочное Основание
И подлинный источник истинной, прекрасной Жизни.

The last several years God has been leading me through a valley, a long and seemingly unending one. It seems as soon as one situation resolves; another one pops up. These difficulties demand a response. Many times, it’s not so much a response of physical action as it is a response of the spirit. For me, it took about two years before I came to a place of beginning to learn healthy and, even more importantly, Biblical emotional choices.

“Spirit” in this article is defined as “a temper or disposition of the mind or outlook.” The Bible mentions several types of spirits that God has been teaching me. Two are more general for everyone and two are specifically given for us ladies.

Before it is of any value to discuss what a Biblical and healthy spirit is, it is essential that we understand that it is a choice. It is not a result of circumstances. It will not come upon us on a whim. As young ladies, especially, we find it very easy to be driven by emotions. But most emotions that “drive” us are not healthy. A Biblical spirit is a result of conscious—not emotional, circumstance-driven—choices. If we let them, unhealthy emotions can become monstrous and pull us downward to many undesirable places such as depression, bitterness, and immorality. In response, God calls us to intentionally choose the type of spirit that is defined in the Bible.

A Broken Spirit

For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite [crushed] and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones –Isaiah 57:15.

Above all else, it is essential that we choose to become broken. It is hard to stress the importance of this enough. If we do not allow ourselves to become broken, we are opening the door for all manner of negative emotions, reactions, and, especially, sin.

Brokenness is a difficult, almost impossible choice to make on our own. Often God leads us into difficult situations where we must make a choice—either godly brokenness, or something unhealthy like anger or discouragement. Brokenness strips everything away. It requires us to surrender our control over bad things such as sickness or disappointment and over good things like our desires for the future. Brokenness means we give God control of everything; we keep nothing. Most times deep brokenness doesn’t happen all at once; it’s a painful journey in which we give up, and give up, and give up again. Without becoming bitter. Without losing faith in God. In fact, the times of crushing are when we choose to believe good things of God even if there seems to be no good reason to.

Brokenness is a choice—a very difficult one which paves the way for God to receive glory, since it is the process of eliminating self. It also makes it possible for other finer qualities to reveal themselves.

A Sober Spirit

Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, [and] be sober… –1 Peter 1:13.

The definition of “sober” in this verse is “to be calm and collected in spirit; to be temperate, dispassionate.” This is an intriguing word. According to this verse, we are commanded to be calm and collected in spirit. As young ladies, we know how easy and even automatic it is to let our feelings about situations and circumstances spiral out of control.

For myself, I was at a place of limbo and uncertainty, and I was so discouraged that I could hardly go on. I could not focus on important things like work and reaching out to others. While studying this verse, God convicted me that, yes, even though I was in a very dark time, His command to me was to be calm and not let my raging emotions control. He brought me to a place where I had to choose, moment by moment, to take control of my spirit. I found that as I chose God’s way, He gave me the grace to live accordingly, resulting in a much more stable and restful spirit.

So, take heart in the dark times! Choose to respond to circumstances in God’s way. As He refines your spirit and your character, He also wants to receive the glory for it. This is a journey God is taking me on, and I’m thankful to Him for continuing to patiently break and shape my spirit for His glory.

A Meek Spirit

But let it be … the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit… –1 Peter 3:4.

In many ways a meek spirit is a yielded spirit. It is a spirit that is totally under the control of Almighty God. It does not fight unpleasant circumstances or strive to make life “better.” But neither is it a passive, “roll with punches”, cowering attitude. Actually, this spirit denotes someone who has gifts and abilities, is trained and effective, and could be very useful to the work of the church, yet is in complete subjection to God, moving only at His will.

A Quiet Spirit

But let it be … the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit… –1 Peter 3:4.

A quiet and restful spirit is an amazing quality. It is not humanly possible to achieve. When you see this spirit in someone, you can know it comes from a heart of brokenness. According to Isaiah, it is a choice: …In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not –Isaiah 30:15.

A quiet spirit and a meek spirit go hand in hand. It is an attitude of sitting back and letting God lead—whether exciting or boring, whether easy or difficult—and not resisting Him in any way.

There are times when we feel very disquieted in spirit, and it’s not possible to pull ourselves out of it by sheer willpower. But the Word of God is life-giving, and by studying the promises of God we can receive peace and rest for our spirits, as well as courage and grace to go on. I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved. Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope –Psalms 16:8, 9.

Katika miaka kadhaa iliyopita, Mungu amekuwa akinipitisha katika bonde, bonde refu na linaloonekana kutokuwa na mwisho. Inaonekana kwamba mara tu hali moja inapotatuliwa, nyingine hutokea. Magumu haya yanahitaji mwitikio. Mara nyingi, si mwitikio wa matendo ya kimwili bali wa roho. Kwangu, ilichukua takriban miaka miwili kufikia mahali pa kuanza kujifunza kuchagua hisia kwa njia yenye afya na, muhimu zaidi, inayotegemea Biblia.

Katika makala hii, “roho” inafafanuliwa kuwa “hali ya moyo au mwelekeo wa fikra.” Biblia inataja aina kadhaa za roho ambazo Mungu amekuwa akinifundisha kuzihusu. Mbili ni za jumla zaidi na zinawahusu wote, na mbili zimekusudiwa hasa kwa ajili yetu wanawake.

Kabla ya kujadili maana ya roho yenye afya na inayotegemea Biblia, ni muhimu tuelewe kwamba ni chaguo. Haitokani na hali tulizo nazo. Haitujii tu ghafla. Sisi wasichana, hasa, huona ni rahisi sana kuongozwa na hisia. Lakini hisia nyingi zinazotuongoza si zenye afya. Roho inayotegemea Biblia hutokana na maamuzi ya makusudi—si ya kihisia wala yanayoongozwa na hali. Tukiziruhusu, hisia zisizo na afya zinaweza kuwa za kutisha na kutuvuta chini hadi katika hali nyingi zisizotakiwa, kama vile mshuko wa moyo, uchungu na uasherati. Kwa hiyo, Mungu anatuita tuchague kwa makusudi aina ya roho inayofafanuliwa katika Biblia.

Roho Iliyovunjika

Maana yeye aliye juu na kutukuka, akaaye milele, ambaye jina lake ni Mtakatifu, asema hivi: Nakaa mahali palipo juu, na patakatifu; tena pamoja na yeye aliye na roho iliyopondeka [iliyovunjika] na kunyenyekea, ili kuzifufua roho za wanyenyekevu, na kuzifufua mioyo yao waliopondeka –Isaya 57:15.

Zaidi ya yote, ni muhimu tuchague kuvunjika. Haiwezekani kusisitiza vya kutosha umuhimu wa jambo hili. Tusipojiruhusu kuvunjika, tunafungua mlango kwa kila aina ya hisia na miitikio hasi, na hasa dhambi.

Kuvunjika ni chaguo gumu, karibu lisilowezekana kulifanya sisi wenyewe. Mara nyingi Mungu hutuongoza katika hali ngumu ambamo ni lazima tufanye uchaguzi—ama kuvunjika kwa kumcha Mungu, ama jambo lisilo na afya kama hasira au kuvunjika moyo. Kuvunjika huondoa kila kitu. Kunatutaka tusalimu amri na kuacha udhibiti wa mambo mabaya kama ugonjwa au kuvunjika moyo, na wa mambo mazuri kama vile matamanio yetu kuhusu wakati ujao. Kuvunjika kunamaanisha tunampa Mungu udhibiti wa kila kitu; hatubakizi chochote. Mara nyingi kuvunjika kwa ndani hakutokei mara moja; ni safari yenye uchungu ambamo tunajisalimisha, kisha tunajisalimisha tena na tena. Bila kuwa na uchungu. Bila kupoteza imani katika Mungu. Kwa kweli, nyakati za kupondwa ndizo tunazochagua kuamini kwamba Mungu ni mwema, hata kama hakuna sababu nzuri inayoonekana ya kufanya hivyo.

Kuvunjika ni chaguo—gumu sana, linalofungua njia ili Mungu apokee utukufu, kwa kuwa ni mchakato wa kuondoa ubinafsi. Pia huwezesha sifa nyingine bora zaidi kujidhihirisha.

Roho Yenye Kiasi

Basi, zifungeni viuno vya nia zenu, [na] mwe na kiasi… –1 Petro 1:13.

Maana ya “kuwa na kiasi” katika mstari huu ni “kuwa mtulivu na mwenye kujizuia rohoni; kuwa na kiasi na kutotawaliwa na hisia.” Hili ni neno la kuvutia. Kulingana na mstari huu, tumeamriwa kuwa watulivu na wenye kujizuia rohoni. Sisi wasichana tunajua jinsi ilivyo rahisi, na hata kuwa jambo la moja kwa moja, kuruhusu hisia zetu kuhusu hali na mazingira zitoke nje ya udhibiti.

Kwa upande wangu, nilikuwa katika hali ya sintofahamu na kutokuwa na uhakika, na nilivunjika moyo sana kiasi cha kushindwa kuendelea. Sikuweza kukazia fikira mambo muhimu kama kazi na kuwafikia wengine. Nilipokuwa nikijifunza mstari huu, Mungu alinisadikisha kwamba, ndiyo, ingawa nilikuwa katika kipindi kigumu sana, amri yake kwangu ilikuwa ni kuwa mtulivu na kutoruhusu hisia zangu kali zinidhibiti. Alinifikisha mahali ambapo ilinibidi nichague, dakika baada ya dakika, kuidhibiti roho yangu. Niligundua kwamba nilipochagua njia ya Mungu, alinipa neema ya kuishi kulingana nayo, na matokeo yake roho yangu ikawa imara zaidi na yenye utulivu.

Basi, jipe moyo katika nyakati za giza! Chagua kuitikia hali kwa njia ya Mungu. Anapoisafisha roho na tabia yako, anataka pia kupokea utukufu kwa ajili yake. Hii ni safari ambayo Mungu ananiongoza, nami ninamshukuru kwa kuendelea kuivunja na kuifinyanga roho yangu kwa subira, kwa utukufu wake.

Roho Mpole

Bali kuwe … pambo la roho ya upole na utulivu… –1 Petro 3:4.

Kwa namna nyingi, roho mpole ni roho iliyojisalimisha. Ni roho iliyo chini kabisa ya udhibiti wa Mungu Mwenyezi. Haipigani na hali zisizopendeza wala kujitahidi kufanya maisha yawe “bora.” Lakini pia si mtazamo wa kujiachilia tu mambo yatokee, wa “kuvumilia mapigo,” au wa woga. Kwa kweli, roho hii humwelezea mtu mwenye vipawa na uwezo, aliyefunzwa na mwenye ufanisi, na ambaye angeweza kuwa na manufaa sana katika kazi ya kanisa, lakini yuko chini kabisa ya Mungu na huenda tu anapotaka yeye.

Roho Tulivu

Bali kuwe … pambo la roho ya upole na utulivu… –1 Petro 3:4.

Roho tulivu na yenye utulivu wa ndani ni sifa ya ajabu. Haiwezekani kuipata kwa juhudi za kibinadamu. Unapoiona roho hii kwa mtu, unaweza kujua kwamba inatokana na moyo uliovunjika. Kulingana na Isaya, ni chaguo: …Katika kurudi na kustarehe mtaokolewa; katika utulivu na kutumaini zitakuwa nguvu zenu: lakini hamkutaka –Isaya 30:15.

Roho tulivu na roho mpole huenda pamoja. Ni mtazamo wa kukaa kimya na kumwacha Mungu akuongoze—iwe jambo la kusisimua au la kuchosha, liwe rahisi au gumu—bila kumpinga kwa namna yoyote.

Kuna nyakati tunapohisi kutotulia sana rohoni, na haiwezekani kujiondoa katika hali hiyo kwa kutumia nguvu ya nia peke yake. Lakini Neno la Mungu hutoa uzima, na kwa kujifunza ahadi za Mungu tunaweza kupata amani na utulivu kwa roho zetu, pamoja na ujasiri na neema ya kuendelea. Nimemtanguliza BWANA mbele yangu daima; kwa kuwa yuko mkono wangu wa kuume, sitaondoshwa. Kwa hiyo moyo wangu umefurahi, na utukufu wangu umeshangilia; mwili wangu nao utastarehe katika tumaini –Zaburi 16:8, 9.

The last several years God has been leading me through a valley, a long and seemingly unending one. It seems as soon as one situation resolves; another one pops up. These difficulties demand a response. Many times, it’s not so much a response of physical action as it is a response of the spirit. For me, it took about two years before I came to a place of beginning to learn healthy and, even more importantly, Biblical emotional choices.

“Spirit” in this article is defined as “a temper or disposition of the mind or outlook.” The Bible mentions several types of spirits that God has been teaching me. Two are more general for everyone and two are specifically given for us ladies.

Before it is of any value to discuss what a Biblical and healthy spirit is, it is essential that we understand that it is a choice. It is not a result of circumstances. It will not come upon us on a whim. As young ladies, especially, we find it very easy to be driven by emotions. But most emotions that “drive” us are not healthy. A Biblical spirit is a result of conscious—not emotional, circumstance-driven—choices. If we let them, unhealthy emotions can become monstrous and pull us downward to many undesirable places such as depression, bitterness, and immorality. In response, God calls us to intentionally choose the type of spirit that is defined in the Bible.

A Broken Spirit

For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite [crushed] and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones –Isaiah 57:15.

Above all else, it is essential that we choose to become broken. It is hard to stress the importance of this enough. If we do not allow ourselves to become broken, we are opening the door for all manner of negative emotions, reactions, and, especially, sin.

Brokenness is a difficult, almost impossible choice to make on our own. Often God leads us into difficult situations where we must make a choice—either godly brokenness, or something unhealthy like anger or discouragement. Brokenness strips everything away. It requires us to surrender our control over bad things such as sickness or disappointment and over good things like our desires for the future. Brokenness means we give God control of everything; we keep nothing. Most times deep brokenness doesn’t happen all at once; it’s a painful journey in which we give up, and give up, and give up again. Without becoming bitter. Without losing faith in God. In fact, the times of crushing are when we choose to believe good things of God even if there seems to be no good reason to.

Brokenness is a choice—a very difficult one which paves the way for God to receive glory, since it is the process of eliminating self. It also makes it possible for other finer qualities to reveal themselves.

A Sober Spirit

Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, [and] be sober… –1 Peter 1:13.

The definition of “sober” in this verse is “to be calm and collected in spirit; to be temperate, dispassionate.” This is an intriguing word. According to this verse, we are commanded to be calm and collected in spirit. As young ladies, we know how easy and even automatic it is to let our feelings about situations and circumstances spiral out of control.

For myself, I was at a place of limbo and uncertainty, and I was so discouraged that I could hardly go on. I could not focus on important things like work and reaching out to others. While studying this verse, God convicted me that, yes, even though I was in a very dark time, His command to me was to be calm and not let my raging emotions control. He brought me to a place where I had to choose, moment by moment, to take control of my spirit. I found that as I chose God’s way, He gave me the grace to live accordingly, resulting in a much more stable and restful spirit.

So, take heart in the dark times! Choose to respond to circumstances in God’s way. As He refines your spirit and your character, He also wants to receive the glory for it. This is a journey God is taking me on, and I’m thankful to Him for continuing to patiently break and shape my spirit for His glory.

A Meek Spirit

But let it be … the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit… –1 Peter 3:4.

In many ways a meek spirit is a yielded spirit. It is a spirit that is totally under the control of Almighty God. It does not fight unpleasant circumstances or strive to make life “better.” But neither is it a passive, “roll with punches”, cowering attitude. Actually, this spirit denotes someone who has gifts and abilities, is trained and effective, and could be very useful to the work of the church, yet is in complete subjection to God, moving only at His will.

A Quiet Spirit

But let it be … the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit… –1 Peter 3:4.

A quiet and restful spirit is an amazing quality. It is not humanly possible to achieve. When you see this spirit in someone, you can know it comes from a heart of brokenness. According to Isaiah, it is a choice: …In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not –Isaiah 30:15.

A quiet spirit and a meek spirit go hand in hand. It is an attitude of sitting back and letting God lead—whether exciting or boring, whether easy or difficult—and not resisting Him in any way.

There are times when we feel very disquieted in spirit, and it’s not possible to pull ourselves out of it by sheer willpower. But the Word of God is life-giving, and by studying the promises of God we can receive peace and rest for our spirits, as well as courage and grace to go on. I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved. Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope –Psalms 16:8, 9.

Under de senaste åren har Gud lett mig genom en dal, en lång och till synes ändlös dal. Det verkar som att så snart en situation löser sig dyker en annan upp. Dessa svårigheter kräver ett gensvar. Ofta handlar det inte så mycket om en fysisk handling som om ett gensvar i anden. För mig tog det ungefär två år innan jag kom till en punkt där jag började lära mig att göra hälsosamma och, ännu viktigare, bibliska känslomässiga val.

”Ande” definieras i den här artikeln som ”ett sinnelag eller en läggning”. Bibeln nämner flera slags andar som Gud har undervisat mig om. Två är mer allmänna och gäller alla, och två ges särskilt till oss kvinnor.

Innan det är meningsfullt att diskutera vad en biblisk och hälsosam ande är, är det viktigt att förstå att den är ett val. Den är inte ett resultat av omständigheterna. Den kommer inte över oss på måfå. Särskilt som unga kvinnor har vi lätt att låta känslorna styra oss. Men de flesta känslor som ”styr” oss är inte hälsosamma. En biblisk ande är resultatet av medvetna val – inte känslostyrda eller omständighetsstyrda val. Om vi låter dem kan ohälsosamma känslor bli monstruösa och dra oss nedåt till många oönskade tillstånd, som depression, bitterhet och omoral. Som svar kallar Gud oss att medvetet välja den sorts ande som beskrivs i Bibeln.

En bruten ande

Ty så säger den höge och upphöjde, han som tronar i evighet och vars namn är Helig: Jag bor i det höga och heliga, men också hos den som har en ångerfull [krossad] och ödmjuk ande, för att ge den ödmjukes ande nytt liv och den ångerfulles hjärta nytt liv – Jesaja 57:15.

Framför allt är det viktigt att vi väljer att bli brutna. Det går knappt att nog betona hur viktigt detta är. Om vi inte tillåter oss själva att bli brutna öppnar vi dörren för alla slags negativa känslor, reaktioner och framför allt synd.

Att bli bruten är ett svårt, nästan omöjligt val att göra på egen hand. Ofta leder Gud oss in i svåra situationer där vi måste välja – antingen gudfruktig brutenhet eller något ohälsosamt, som vrede eller missmod. Brutenheten skalar bort allt. Den kräver att vi överlåter kontrollen över dåliga saker, som sjukdom eller besvikelse, och över goda saker, som våra framtidsönskningar. Brutenhet innebär att vi överlåter kontrollen över allting till Gud; vi behåller ingenting. För det mesta sker djup brutenhet inte på en gång; det är en smärtsam resa där vi ger upp, och ger upp, och ger upp igen. Utan att bli bittra. Utan att förlora tron på Gud. Faktum är att det är när vi krossas som vi väljer att tro gott om Gud, även när det inte verkar finnas någon god anledning till det.

Brutenhet är ett val – ett mycket svårt val som bereder väg för att Gud ska få äran, eftersom det är en process där jaget utplånas. Den gör det också möjligt för andra ädlare egenskaper att komma fram.

Ett sansat sinnelag

Spänn därför bältet om ert förstånd [och] var nyktra … – 1 Petrusbrevet 1:13.

Betydelsen av ”nykter” i den här versen är ”att vara lugn och samlad till sinnet; att vara måttfull och opartisk”. Det är ett tankeväckande ord. Enligt den här versen är vi befallda att vara lugna och samlade till sinnet. Som unga kvinnor vet vi hur lätt, och till och med automatiskt, det är att låta våra känslor inför situationer och omständigheter skena iväg.

Själv befann jag mig i ett slags limbo och ovisshet, och jag var så missmodig att jag knappt orkade fortsätta. Jag kunde inte koncentrera mig på viktiga saker som arbetet och att nå ut till andra. När jag studerade den här versen överbevisade Gud mig om att ja, även om jag befann mig i en mycket mörk tid, var hans befallning till mig att vara lugn och inte låta mina stormande känslor styra. Han förde mig till en punkt där jag var tvungen att välja, stund för stund, att ta kontroll över min ande. Jag märkte att när jag valde Guds väg gav han mig nåden att leva därefter, vilket ledde till ett mycket mer stabilt och rofyllt sinnelag.

Så fatta mod i de mörka tiderna! Välj att bemöta omständigheterna på Guds sätt. När han formar din ande och din karaktär vill han också få äran för det. Gud leder mig genom den här resan, och jag är tacksam mot honom för att han tålmodigt fortsätter att bryta ned och forma min ande till sin ära.

En ödmjuk ande

Låt det i stället … vara den ödmjuka och stilla andens prydnad … – 1 Petrusbrevet 3:4.

På många sätt är en ödmjuk ande en överlåten ande. Det är en ande som helt står under den allsmäktige Gudens kontroll. Den kämpar inte emot obehagliga omständigheter och strävar inte efter att göra livet ”bättre”. Men den är inte heller en passiv, kuvad attityd som bara ”tar emot slagen”. Den här anden kännetecknar faktiskt någon som har gåvor och förmågor, är utbildad och effektiv och skulle kunna vara mycket användbar i kyrkans arbete, men ändå står helt underordnad Gud och handlar endast när han vill.

En stilla ande

Låt det i stället … vara den ödmjuka och stilla andens prydnad … – 1 Petrusbrevet 3:4.

Ett stilla och rofyllt sinnelag är en enastående egenskap. Det är inte möjligt att uppnå med mänskliga krafter. När du ser detta sinnelag hos någon kan du veta att det kommer ur ett brustet hjärta. Enligt Jesaja är det ett val: … Genom omvändelse och ro ska ni bli räddade, i stillhet och förtröstan ligger er styrka: men ni ville inte – Jesaja 30:15.

En stilla ande och en ödmjuk ande hör ihop. Det är en hållning där man lutar sig tillbaka och låter Gud leda – vare sig det är spännande eller tråkigt, lätt eller svårt – och inte gör motstånd mot honom på något sätt.

Det finns stunder då vi känner oss mycket oroliga till sinnes, och då kan vi inte ta oss ur det enbart genom viljestyrka. Men Guds ord ger liv, och genom att studera Guds löften kan vi få frid och vila för våra andar, liksom mod och nåd att fortsätta. Jag har alltid Herren för mina ögon, han står på min högra sida, jag ska inte vackla. Därför gläds mitt hjärta och jublar min ära, också min kropp får vila i trygghet – Psaltaren 16:8, 9.

A rough, Old Testament warrior and a 21st century housewife—what might they have in common? Reading through the Psalms, we find a man who was determined to find the heart of God and walk in obedience. While there are not many similarities between my life and the life of this man, his words still touch my need and steady my floundering heart.

David set his heart on God even when his life was fraught with difficulty and distress. He was often unable to have the secure life he craved. As I read through his writings, I embark on a personal journey of faith and obedience. Often when confronted with a need in my life, the first words that come to my lips are “I’ll try”. It is so easy to allow emotions of frustration, fear, and worry to rule, instead of making the conscious choice of obedience. Many times, throughout the book of Psalms, David uses the words “I will”. David was determined to steer his heart in the way of obedience. Follow me on my journey thru this beautiful book as we explore a few of David’s “I wills”.

  • I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart. –Psalm 9:1a
  • I will love thee, O Lord, my strength. –Psalm 18:1
  • I will call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised. –Psalm 18:3a
  • I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord. –Psalm 32:5b
  • I will keep my mouth with a bridle. –Psalm 39:1b
  • I will wait on thy name. –Psalm 52:9b
  • I will trust in thee. –Psalm 56:3b
  • I will not fear what flesh can do unto me. –Psalm 56:4b
  • I will declare what he hath done for my soul. –Psalm 66:16b
  • I will praise the name of God with a song. –Psalm 69:30a
  • I will go in the strength of the Lord God. –Psalm 71:16a
  • I will remember the works of the Lord. –Psalm 77:11a
  • I will meditate also of all thy work and talk of thy doings. –Psalm 77:12
  • I will be satisfied when I awake with Thy likeness. –Psalm 17:5b

Most of David’s “I wills” were a conscious, emotional choice in the middle of unruly circumstances. Without emotions, this world would be a cold, hard place unable to be inhabited by God’s Spirit. All humankind was created with emotion, but women especially are easily dominated by them. We deal with the ebb and flow of our emotions daily, often like a wild horse which constantly tries to get out of control. But God also gives us His strength to rein in this ‘wild horse’ and guide it in the right direction. Once the choice is made, God’s grace is all ours. Opposite from what we often tell ourselves, we are not victims of our feelings or emotions. We are responsible to take action, for this is, in fact, a war between good and evil. It is a war between our sin nature and the nature of Christ.

I want to look at a few struggles which are common to women and then we will look at how a God-directed “I will” can change our perspective and ultimately affect our emotional responses and spiritual health.

Comparison

For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise –2 Corinthians 10:12.

It is our natural tendency to compare ourselves with others. Yet every time, we end up feeling either superior or inferior to the other person. This evokes many emotions that can either depress us, or unjustly affirm ourselves. Neither of these responses produces a peaceful heart. Instead of following this tendency of comparison, we can say like David, “I will love thee, O Lord, my strength.” Having our eyes on Christ will fulfill our hearts in a way that our desire for human reassurance and acceptance never can or will.

Fear

What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee –Psalm 56:3.

It doesn’t always feel like we have a choice in this one, as fear tends to crash in on us without warning. But in some of my recent battles with fear, God showed me that living in continual fear is refusing to believe the promises found in His Word. David’s “I will trust in Thee” is a conscious choice that I also need to make. As some have said, “Fear is living in the future without God in it.” God’s grace is here for me today and it will be here for me tomorrow, but I cannot try to find grace today for tomorrow’s trials.

Discontentment

Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content –Philippians 4:11.

And having food and raiment let us be therewith content –1 Timothy 6:8.

Everything about the advertising strategies of today’s world are designed to create a desire for more. No matter how beautiful of a house we live in, our human nature will always crave just one more thing. Consider the peace that is available for you as a woman of God, if you choose to imitate David’s attitude, “I will be satisfied when I awake with thy likeness.” As God fulfills the longings of your heart, there’s no longer a need to search for a counterfeit fulfillment.

Gossip

Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man –Colossians 4:6.

Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers –Ephesians 4:29.

The word ‘gossip’ is defined as “casual or unconstrained conversation or reports about other people, typically involving details which are not confirmed to be true.” It is often an effort to elevate our own ego which is rooted in insecurity. David says, “I will keep my mouth with a bridle.” Even though he had every reason to spread ‘stories’ about his enemies, he found no need to devalue others through gossip.

Here we have considered only a few examples. I encourage each of you to prayerfully evaluate your own emotional responses and the way they can dominate your life. Here is a list of questions to help you discern the areas in your life that may need a change of perspective.

  1. Do you need more of an “I will” attitude in your life?
  2. Are you listless and wondering about the meaning of life?
  3. Are you struggling with depression?
  4. Do you struggle with your priorities and lack of motivation to change them?
  5. Do your children need more words of encouragement?
  6. Do you struggle with unhealthy eating habits?
  7. Are you caught in the cogs of negative thought patterns?
  8. Are you fighting your husband’s desires and leadership?

Good intentions and change are often only separated by lack of faith and motivation. Often, we don’t understand how God intimately cares about these emotions and problems in our lives and is waiting to see our willingness to change. When we take the first step of obedience, His grace is there to do the miracle. The “I’ll try” mindset brings lethargy and defeat. The “I will” opens up God’s endless store of grace. Every day brings hundreds of small decisions. How we respond to these decisions eventually form the woman we become and the woman we will be in our old age.

Mary, the future mother of Jesus, was suddenly face to face with an angel one day. His words troubled her and she “cast in her mind” what he was telling her. She could have allowed herself to be overcome with fear at the thought of what the angel’s words meant for her. Instead, she said, “Behold the handmaiden of the Lord, be it unto me according to Thy word.” She chose faith and it impacted the world in ways she could never have imagined.

It was a choice. A choice for which she could not take days or weeks to prepare. However, her being a part of God’s plan for the salvation of the world hung on that choice.

Esther, the queen was faced with a serious dilemma. Her people were in danger of being wiped out by the treacherous Haman. Mordecai told her that she was a queen for such a time as this and she must go in to the king and beg for his help. Her heart quavered. She was well acquainted with the king’s rules that whoever ventured into his palace without an invitation would likely be killed. But she chose courage… “If I perish, I perish.” She was going to do what she could for her people no matter what the cost.

It was just a choice. Yet the safety of her people and the miracle of their deliverance came through her willingness to make such a difficult choice.

Attitudes and emotions—the negative, or the positive—are all hidden choices we must make. Which will you choose, the faithless “I’ll try” or the courageous “I will”? Will you choose, by God’s grace, to make the right choice? God has promised to perfect the things which concern you, but He will not do His work in your life without your “I will”. It is up to you.

And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work: –2 Corinthians 9:8.

پرانے عہدنامے کا ایک سخت جان جنگجو اور اکیسویں صدی کی ایک گھریلو خاتون—ان دونوں میں کیا بات مشترک ہو سکتی ہے؟ زبور پڑھتے ہوئے ہمیں ایک ایسے شخص کا پتا چلتا ہے جو خدا کے دل کو جاننے اور فرمانبرداری سے چلنے کے لیے پُرعزم تھا۔ اگرچہ میری زندگی اور اس شخص کی زندگی میں بہت کم مماثلتیں ہیں، پھر بھی اس کے الفاظ میری ضرورت کو چھوتے اور میرے ڈگمگاتے دل کو سہارا دیتے ہیں۔

داؤد نے خدا کو اپنے دل میں جگہ دی، یہاں تک کہ جب اس کی زندگی مشکلات اور پریشانیوں سے بھری ہوئی تھی۔ وہ اکثر وہ محفوظ زندگی نہیں گزار پاتا تھا جس کی اسے آرزو تھی۔ اس کی تحریریں پڑھتے ہوئے، میں ایمان اور فرمانبرداری کے ذاتی سفر پر نکلتی ہوں۔ اکثر جب میری زندگی میں کسی ضرورت کا سامنا ہوتا ہے تو میرے لبوں پر سب سے پہلے یہ الفاظ آتے ہیں: ”میں کوشش کروں گی۔“ مایوسی، خوف اور فکر کے جذبات کو حاوی ہونے دینا بہت آسان ہے، بجائے اس کے کہ ہم شعوری طور پر فرمانبرداری کا انتخاب کریں۔ زبور کی کتاب میں داؤد کئی بار ”میں کروں گا“ کے الفاظ استعمال کرتا ہے۔ داؤد اپنے دل کو فرمانبرداری کی راہ پر گامزن کرنے کے لیے پُرعزم تھا۔ اس خوب صورت کتاب کے سفر میں میرے ساتھ چلیں، جب ہم داؤد کے چند ”میں کروں گا“ پر غور کرتے ہیں۔

  • میں ضرور اپنے سارے دل سے تیری ستایش کروں گا، اے خداوند۔ –زبور 9:1a
  • میں ضرور تجھ سے محبت رکھوں گا، اے خداوند، میری قوت۔ –زبور 18:1
  • میں ضرور خداوند کو پکاروں گا، جو ستایش کے لائق ہے۔ –زبور 18:3a
  • میں ضرور خداوند کے حضور اپنے گناہوں کا اقرار کروں گا۔ –زبور 32:5b
  • میں ضرور اپنے منہ پر لگام رکھوں گا۔ –زبور 39:1b
  • میں ضرور تیرے نام کا انتظار کروں گا۔ –زبور 52:9b
  • میں ضرور تجھ پر توکل کروں گا۔ –زبور 56:3b
  • میں ضرور اس بات سے نہ ڈروں گا کہ انسان میرا کیا کر سکتا ہے۔ –زبور 56:4b
  • میں ضرور بیان کروں گا کہ اُس نے میری جان کے لیے کیا کیا ہے۔ –زبور 66:16b
  • میں ضرور گیت گا کر خدا کے نام کی ستایش کروں گا۔ –زبور 69:30a
  • میں ضرور خداوند خدا کی قوت میں چلوں گا۔ –زبور 71:16a
  • میں ضرور خداوند کے کاموں کو یاد کروں گا۔ –زبور 77:11a
  • میں ضرور تیرے سب کاموں پر غور بھی کروں گا اور تیرے کاموں کا ذکر کروں گا۔ –زبور 77:12
  • میں ضرور جاگنے پر تیری شبیہ سے آسودہ ہوں گا۔ –زبور 17:5b

داؤد کے زیادہ تر ”میں کروں گا“ بے قابو حالات کے بیچ ایک شعوری اور جذباتی انتخاب تھے۔ جذبات نہ ہوں تو یہ دنیا ایک سرد اور سخت جگہ ہوتی، جس میں خدا کی روح سکونت نہ کر سکتی۔ تمام انسان جذبات کے ساتھ پیدا کیے گئے ہیں، لیکن عورتیں خاص طور پر ان کے زیرِ اثر جلد آ جاتی ہیں۔ ہم روزانہ اپنے جذبات کے اتار چڑھاؤ سے نبردآزما ہوتی ہیں، اکثر ایک ایسے جنگلی گھوڑے کی طرح جو مسلسل بے قابو ہونے کی کوشش کرتا ہے۔ لیکن خدا ہمیں اس ”جنگلی گھوڑے“ کو لگام دینے اور درست سمت میں لے جانے کے لیے اپنی قوت بھی دیتا ہے۔ فیصلہ کر لینے کے بعد، خدا کا فضل مکمل طور پر ہمارا ہے۔ اس کے برعکس جو ہم اکثر اپنے آپ سے کہتے ہیں، ہم اپنے احساسات یا جذبات کے ہاتھوں مجبور نہیں ہیں۔ ہمیں قدم اٹھانے کی ذمہ داری قبول کرنی ہے، کیونکہ حقیقت میں یہ اچھائی اور برائی کے درمیان جنگ ہے۔ یہ ہماری گناہ آلود فطرت اور مسیح کی فطرت کے درمیان جنگ ہے۔

میں عورتوں کے چند عام مسائل پر نظر ڈالنا چاہتی ہوں، اور پھر ہم دیکھیں گے کہ خدا کی راہ نمائی میں کہا گیا ”میں کروں گی“ ہمارا نقطۂ نظر کیسے بدل سکتا ہے اور بالآخر ہمارے جذباتی ردِعمل اور روحانی صحت پر کیسے اثرانداز ہو سکتا ہے۔

موازنہ

کیونکہ ہم اُن میں سے نہیں جو اپنے آپ کو اُن کے برابر شمار کرنے یا اُن کے ساتھ اپنا مقابلہ کرنے کی جرأت کرتے ہیں جو اپنی تعریف آپ کرتے ہیں؛ لیکن وہ آپس میں ایک دوسرے کو ناپ کر اور ایک دوسرے سے اپنا مقابلہ کر کے نادانی کرتے ہیں –2 کرنتھیوں 10:12۔

دوسروں سے اپنا موازنہ کرنا ہماری فطری عادت ہے۔ لیکن ہر بار، ہم یا تو خود کو دوسرے شخص سے برتر محسوس کرتے ہیں یا کمتر۔ اس سے بہت سے ایسے جذبات پیدا ہوتے ہیں جو یا تو ہمیں افسردہ کر سکتے ہیں یا ناحق ہمیں اپنی تعریف کرنے پر مائل کر سکتے ہیں۔ ان میں سے کوئی بھی ردِعمل دل کو سکون نہیں دیتا۔ موازنہ کرنے کی اس عادت کے پیچھے چلنے کے بجائے، ہم داؤد کی طرح کہہ سکتی ہیں، ”میں تجھ سے محبت رکھوں گا، اے خداوند، میری قوت۔“ مسیح پر نگاہیں جمائے رکھنے سے ہمارے دل اس طرح بھر جائیں گے جس طرح انسانی تسلی اور قبولیت کی خواہش کبھی نہیں کر سکتی اور نہ ہی کر پائے گی۔

خوف

جس وقت مجھے ڈر لگے گا، میں تجھ پر توکل کروں گا –زبور 56:3۔

اس معاملے میں ہمیشہ ایسا محسوس نہیں ہوتا کہ ہمارے پاس کوئی انتخاب ہے، کیونکہ خوف اکثر بغیر کسی تنبیہ کے ہم پر ٹوٹ پڑتا ہے۔ لیکن خوف کے ساتھ اپنی حالیہ چند کشمکشوں میں خدا نے مجھے دکھایا کہ مسلسل خوف میں جینا اُس کے کلام میں پائے جانے والے وعدوں پر یقین کرنے سے انکار کرنا ہے۔ داؤد کا کہنا، ”میں تجھ پر توکل کروں گا،“ ایک شعوری انتخاب ہے جو مجھے بھی کرنا ہے۔ جیسا کہ بعض لوگوں نے کہا ہے، ”خوف، خدا کے بغیر مستقبل میں جینے کا نام ہے۔“ خدا کا فضل آج میرے لیے موجود ہے اور کل بھی میرے لیے موجود ہوگا، لیکن میں کل کی آزمائشوں کے لیے آج ہی فضل ڈھونڈنے کی کوشش نہیں کر سکتی۔

عدمِ قناعت

یہ نہیں کہ میں محتاجی کے لحاظ سے کہتا ہوں، کیونکہ میں نے یہ سیکھ لیا ہے کہ جس حالت میں ہوں، اُسی میں قناعت کروں –فلپیوں 4:11۔

اور اگر ہمارے پاس خوراک اور پوشاک ہو تو اُسی پر قناعت کریں –1 تیمتھیس 6:8۔

آج کی دنیا میں اشتہارات کی حکمتِ عملیوں کا ہر پہلو مزید چیزیں چاہنے کی خواہش پیدا کرنے کے لیے بنایا گیا ہے۔ ہم خواہ کتنے ہی خوب صورت گھر میں رہتے ہوں، ہماری انسانی فطرت ہمیشہ بس ایک اور چیز کی خواہش کرے گی۔ خدا کی عورت ہونے کے ناتے، سوچیں کہ اگر آپ داؤد کے رویے کی پیروی کرنے کا انتخاب کریں تو آپ کے لیے کتنا سکون دستیاب ہے: ”میں جاگنے پر تیری شبیہ سے آسودہ ہوں گا۔“ جب خدا آپ کے دل کی آرزوؤں کو پورا کرتا ہے تو پھر کسی جھوٹی تسکین کی تلاش کی ضرورت باقی نہیں رہتی۔

غیبت

تمہاری گفتگو ہمیشہ پُرفضل اور نمکین ہو تاکہ تمہیں ہر شخص کو مناسب جواب دینا آ جائے –کلسیوں 4:6۔

کوئی گندی بات تمہارے منہ سے نہ نکلے بلکہ وہی جو ضرورت کے مطابق ترقی دے تاکہ سننے والوں پر فضل ہو –افسیوں 4:29۔

لفظ ’غیبت‘ کی تعریف یہ ہے: ”دوسرے لوگوں کے بارے میں غیر رسمی یا بے تکلف گفتگو یا باتیں، جن میں عموماً ایسی تفصیلات شامل ہوں جن کے سچ ہونے کی تصدیق نہ کی گئی ہو۔“ یہ اکثر اپنی انا کو بلند کرنے کی کوشش ہوتی ہے، جس کی جڑ عدمِ تحفظ کا احساس ہے۔ داؤد کہتا ہے، ”میں اپنے منہ پر لگام رکھوں گا۔“ اگرچہ اُس کے پاس اپنے دشمنوں کے بارے میں ’کہانیاں‘ پھیلانے کی ہر وجہ موجود تھی، پھر بھی اُس نے غیبت کے ذریعے دوسروں کی قدر گھٹانے کی کوئی ضرورت نہ پائی۔

یہاں ہم نے صرف چند مثالوں پر غور کیا ہے۔ میں آپ میں سے ہر ایک کی حوصلہ افزائی کرتی ہوں کہ اپنے جذباتی ردِعمل اور اس بات کا دعا کے ساتھ جائزہ لیں کہ وہ آپ کی زندگی پر کیسے غالب آ سکتے ہیں۔ آپ کی زندگی کے جن شعبوں میں نقطۂ نظر کی تبدیلی کی ضرورت ہو سکتی ہے، اُنہیں پہچاننے میں مدد کے لیے یہاں چند سوالات ہیں۔

  1. کیا آپ کو اپنی زندگی میں ”میں ضرور کروں گی“ والے رویے کی زیادہ ضرورت ہے؟
  2. کیا آپ بے دلی کا شکار ہیں اور زندگی کے مقصد کے بارے میں سوچتی رہتی ہیں؟
  3. کیا آپ افسردگی سے نبردآزما ہیں؟
  4. کیا آپ اپنی ترجیحات کے معاملے میں کشمکش میں ہیں اور انہیں بدلنے کی تحریک نہیں پاتیں؟
  5. کیا آپ کے بچوں کو حوصلہ افزائی کے مزید الفاظ کی ضرورت ہے؟
  6. کیا آپ کو کھانے پینے کی غیر صحت مند عادتوں سے مسئلہ ہے؟
  7. کیا آپ منفی سوچ کے مسلسل چلتے رہنے والے سلسلوں میں پھنسی ہوئی ہیں؟
  8. کیا آپ اپنے شوہر کی خواہشات اور راہ نمائی کی مخالفت کرتی ہیں؟

اچھے ارادوں اور تبدیلی کے درمیان اکثر صرف ایمان اور تحریک کی کمی حائل ہوتی ہے۔ اکثر ہم نہیں سمجھتیں کہ خدا ہماری زندگی کے ان جذبات اور مسائل کی کتنی گہری فکر کرتا ہے اور ہماری تبدیلی کی آمادگی دیکھنے کا منتظر ہے۔ جب ہم فرمانبرداری کا پہلا قدم اٹھاتی ہیں تو معجزہ کرنے کے لیے اُس کا فضل موجود ہوتا ہے۔ ”میں کوشش کروں گی“ کی سوچ سستی اور شکست کا باعث بنتی ہے۔ ”میں ضرور کروں گی“ خدا کے فضل کے بے انتہا خزانے کو کھول دیتا ہے۔ ہر روز سینکڑوں چھوٹے فیصلے کرنے پڑتے ہیں۔ ہم ان فیصلوں کا کیا جواب دیتی ہیں، اسی سے آخرکار وہ عورت بنتی ہے جو ہم ہیں اور بڑھاپے میں ہوں گی۔

ایک دن مریم، جو آگے چل کر یسوع کی ماں بنی، اچانک ایک فرشتے کے روبرو تھی۔ اُس کے الفاظ نے اُسے پریشان کیا اور اُس نے اُن باتوں پر ”غور کیا“ جو فرشتہ اُس سے کہہ رہا تھا۔ فرشتے کے الفاظ کا اپنے لیے مطلب سوچ کر وہ خوف سے مغلوب ہو سکتی تھی۔ اس کے بجائے اُس نے کہا، ”دیکھ، میں خداوند کی بندی ہوں؛ تیرے قول کے مطابق میرے لیے ہو۔“ اُس نے ایمان کا انتخاب کیا، اور اس انتخاب نے دنیا پر ایسے طریقوں سے اثر ڈالا جن کا وہ کبھی تصور بھی نہیں کر سکتی تھی۔

یہ ایک انتخاب تھا۔ ایسا انتخاب جس کے لیے وہ کئی دن یا ہفتے تیاری نہیں کر سکتی تھی۔ تاہم، دنیا کی نجات کے لیے خدا کے منصوبے میں اُس کی شمولیت اسی انتخاب پر منحصر تھی۔

ملکہ آستر ایک سنگین مخمصے سے دوچار تھی۔ اُس کی قوم کو خبیث ہامان کے ہاتھوں مٹا دیے جانے کا خطرہ تھا۔ مردکی نے اُس سے کہا کہ وہ ایسے ہی وقت کے لیے ملکہ بنی ہے اور اسے بادشاہ کے پاس جا کر اُس سے مدد کی درخواست کرنی چاہیے۔ اُس کا دل کانپ اٹھا۔ وہ بادشاہ کے اُن قوانین سے بخوبی واقف تھی جن کے مطابق کوئی بھی شخص بلاوے کے بغیر اُس کے محل میں جانے کی جرأت کرتا تو غالباً مارا جاتا۔ لیکن اُس نے ہمت کا انتخاب کیا… ”اگر میں ہلاک ہوئی تو ہلاک ہوئی۔“ وہ اپنی قوم کے لیے جو کچھ کر سکتی تھی، کرنے والی تھی، چاہے اس کی کوئی بھی قیمت ہوتی۔

یہ محض ایک انتخاب تھا۔ پھر بھی اُس کی قوم کی سلامتی اور اُن کی رہائی کا معجزہ، ایسا مشکل انتخاب کرنے کی اُس کی آمادگی کے ذریعے ممکن ہوا۔

رویے اور جذبات—خواہ منفی ہوں یا مثبت—سب پوشیدہ انتخاب ہیں جو ہمیں کرنے ہوتے ہیں۔ آپ کیا چنیں گی: بے ایمانی والا ”میں کوشش کروں گی“ یا حوصلہ مند ”میں ضرور کروں گی“؟ کیا آپ خدا کے فضل سے درست انتخاب کرنے کا فیصلہ کریں گی؟ خدا نے وعدہ کیا ہے کہ وہ اُن باتوں کو کامل کرے گا جو آپ سے متعلق ہیں، لیکن وہ آپ کی آمادگی کے بغیر آپ کی زندگی میں اپنا کام نہیں کرے گا۔ یہ آپ پر منحصر ہے۔

A rough, Old Testament warrior and a 21st century housewife—what might they have in common? Reading through the Psalms, we find a man who was determined to find the heart of God and walk in obedience. While there are not many similarities between my life and the life of this man, his words still touch my need and steady my floundering heart.

David set his heart on God even when his life was fraught with difficulty and distress. He was often unable to have the secure life he craved. As I read through his writings, I embark on a personal journey of faith and obedience. Often when confronted with a need in my life, the first words that come to my lips are “I’ll try”. It is so easy to allow emotions of frustration, fear, and worry to rule, instead of making the conscious choice of obedience. Many times, throughout the book of Psalms, David uses the words “I will”. David was determined to steer his heart in the way of obedience. Follow me on my journey thru this beautiful book as we explore a few of David’s “I wills”.

  • I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart. –Psalm 9:1a
  • I will love thee, O Lord, my strength. –Psalm 18:1
  • I will call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised. –Psalm 18:3a
  • I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord. –Psalm 32:5b
  • I will keep my mouth with a bridle. –Psalm 39:1b
  • I will wait on thy name. –Psalm 52:9b
  • I will trust in thee. –Psalm 56:3b
  • I will not fear what flesh can do unto me. –Psalm 56:4b
  • I will declare what he hath done for my soul. –Psalm 66:16b
  • I will praise the name of God with a song. –Psalm 69:30a
  • I will go in the strength of the Lord God. –Psalm 71:16a
  • I will remember the works of the Lord. –Psalm 77:11a
  • I will meditate also of all thy work and talk of thy doings. –Psalm 77:12
  • I will be satisfied when I awake with Thy likeness. –Psalm 17:5b

Most of David’s “I wills” were a conscious, emotional choice in the middle of unruly circumstances. Without emotions, this world would be a cold, hard place unable to be inhabited by God’s Spirit. All humankind was created with emotion, but women especially are easily dominated by them. We deal with the ebb and flow of our emotions daily, often like a wild horse which constantly tries to get out of control. But God also gives us His strength to rein in this ‘wild horse’ and guide it in the right direction. Once the choice is made, God’s grace is all ours. Opposite from what we often tell ourselves, we are not victims of our feelings or emotions. We are responsible to take action, for this is, in fact, a war between good and evil. It is a war between our sin nature and the nature of Christ.

I want to look at a few struggles which are common to women and then we will look at how a God-directed “I will” can change our perspective and ultimately affect our emotional responses and spiritual health.

Comparison

For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise –2 Corinthians 10:12.

It is our natural tendency to compare ourselves with others. Yet every time, we end up feeling either superior or inferior to the other person. This evokes many emotions that can either depress us, or unjustly affirm ourselves. Neither of these responses produces a peaceful heart. Instead of following this tendency of comparison, we can say like David, “I will love thee, O Lord, my strength.” Having our eyes on Christ will fulfill our hearts in a way that our desire for human reassurance and acceptance never can or will.

Fear

What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee –Psalm 56:3.

It doesn’t always feel like we have a choice in this one, as fear tends to crash in on us without warning. But in some of my recent battles with fear, God showed me that living in continual fear is refusing to believe the promises found in His Word. David’s “I will trust in Thee” is a conscious choice that I also need to make. As some have said, “Fear is living in the future without God in it.” God’s grace is here for me today and it will be here for me tomorrow, but I cannot try to find grace today for tomorrow’s trials.

Discontentment

Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content –Philippians 4:11.

And having food and raiment let us be therewith content –1 Timothy 6:8.

Everything about the advertising strategies of today’s world are designed to create a desire for more. No matter how beautiful of a house we live in, our human nature will always crave just one more thing. Consider the peace that is available for you as a woman of God, if you choose to imitate David’s attitude, “I will be satisfied when I awake with thy likeness.” As God fulfills the longings of your heart, there’s no longer a need to search for a counterfeit fulfillment.

Gossip

Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man –Colossians 4:6.

Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers –Ephesians 4:29.

The word ‘gossip’ is defined as “casual or unconstrained conversation or reports about other people, typically involving details which are not confirmed to be true.” It is often an effort to elevate our own ego which is rooted in insecurity. David says, “I will keep my mouth with a bridle.” Even though he had every reason to spread ‘stories’ about his enemies, he found no need to devalue others through gossip.

Here we have considered only a few examples. I encourage each of you to prayerfully evaluate your own emotional responses and the way they can dominate your life. Here is a list of questions to help you discern the areas in your life that may need a change of perspective.

  1. Do you need more of an “I will” attitude in your life?
  2. Are you listless and wondering about the meaning of life?
  3. Are you struggling with depression?
  4. Do you struggle with your priorities and lack of motivation to change them?
  5. Do your children need more words of encouragement?
  6. Do you struggle with unhealthy eating habits?
  7. Are you caught in the cogs of negative thought patterns?
  8. Are you fighting your husband’s desires and leadership?

Good intentions and change are often only separated by lack of faith and motivation. Often, we don’t understand how God intimately cares about these emotions and problems in our lives and is waiting to see our willingness to change. When we take the first step of obedience, His grace is there to do the miracle. The “I’ll try” mindset brings lethargy and defeat. The “I will” opens up God’s endless store of grace. Every day brings hundreds of small decisions. How we respond to these decisions eventually form the woman we become and the woman we will be in our old age.

Mary, the future mother of Jesus, was suddenly face to face with an angel one day. His words troubled her and she “cast in her mind” what he was telling her. She could have allowed herself to be overcome with fear at the thought of what the angel’s words meant for her. Instead, she said, “Behold the handmaiden of the Lord, be it unto me according to Thy word.” She chose faith and it impacted the world in ways she could never have imagined.

It was a choice. A choice for which she could not take days or weeks to prepare. However, her being a part of God’s plan for the salvation of the world hung on that choice.

Esther, the queen was faced with a serious dilemma. Her people were in danger of being wiped out by the treacherous Haman. Mordecai told her that she was a queen for such a time as this and she must go in to the king and beg for his help. Her heart quavered. She was well acquainted with the king’s rules that whoever ventured into his palace without an invitation would likely be killed. But she chose courage… “If I perish, I perish.” She was going to do what she could for her people no matter what the cost.

It was just a choice. Yet the safety of her people and the miracle of their deliverance came through her willingness to make such a difficult choice.

Attitudes and emotions—the negative, or the positive—are all hidden choices we must make. Which will you choose, the faithless “I’ll try” or the courageous “I will”? Will you choose, by God’s grace, to make the right choice? God has promised to perfect the things which concern you, but He will not do His work in your life without your “I will”. It is up to you.

And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work: –2 Corinthians 9:8.

Shujaa mkali wa Agano la Kale na mama wa nyumbani wa karne ya 21—wanaweza kuwa na jambo gani linalofanana? Tunapoisoma Zaburi, tunamwona mtu aliyedhamiria kuutafuta moyo wa Mungu na kutembea katika utii. Ingawa maisha yangu hayafanani sana na maisha ya mtu huyu, maneno yake bado yanagusa mahitaji yangu na kuutia moyo wangu unaoyumba uimara.

Daudi aliuelekeza moyo wake kwa Mungu hata maisha yake yalipokuwa yamejaa magumu na dhiki. Mara nyingi hakuweza kuwa na maisha yenye usalama aliyoyatamani. Ninaposoma maandishi yake, ninaanza safari binafsi ya imani na utii. Mara nyingi ninapokabiliwa na hitaji maishani mwangu, maneno ya kwanza kutoka kinywani mwangu ni “Nitajaribu”. Ni rahisi sana kuruhusu hisia za kufadhaika, hofu na wasiwasi zitawale, badala ya kufanya uchaguzi wa makusudi wa kutii. Mara nyingi katika kitabu cha Zaburi, Daudi hutumia maneno “Nitafanya”. Daudi aliazimia kuuelekeza moyo wake katika njia ya utii. Fuata safari yangu katika kitabu hiki kizuri tunapochunguza baadhi ya kauli za Daudi za “Nitafanya”.

  • Nitakusifu, Ee Bwana, kwa moyo wangu wote. –Zaburi 9:1a
  • Nitakupenda, Ee Bwana, nguvu yangu. –Zaburi 18:1
  • Nitamwita Bwana, astahiliye kusifiwa. –Zaburi 18:3a
  • Nitakiri makosa yangu kwa Bwana. –Zaburi 32:5b
  • Nitaizuia kinywa changu kwa lijamu. –Zaburi 39:1b
  • Nitalingojea jina lako. –Zaburi 52:9b
  • Nitakutumaini. –Zaburi 56:3b
  • Sitaogopa kile ambacho mwanadamu anaweza kunitendea. –Zaburi 56:4b
  • Nitatangaza aliyoyatenda kwa nafsi yangu. –Zaburi 66:16b
  • Nitalisifu jina la Mungu kwa wimbo. –Zaburi 69:30a
  • Nitaenda kwa nguvu za Bwana Mungu. –Zaburi 71:16a
  • Nitayakumbuka matendo ya Bwana. –Zaburi 77:11a
  • Nitatafakari pia kazi zako zote na kuzungumza juu ya matendo yako. –Zaburi 77:12
  • Nitaridhika niamkapo nikiwa na mfano wako. –Zaburi 17:5b

Kauli nyingi za Daudi za “Nitafanya” zilikuwa uchaguzi wa makusudi wa kihisia katikati ya hali zisizodhibitika. Bila hisia, ulimwengu huu ungekuwa mahali pa baridi na pagumu, ambapo Roho wa Mungu hangeweza kukaa. Wanadamu wote waliumbwa wakiwa na hisia, lakini wanawake hasa hutawaliwa nazo kwa urahisi. Kila siku tunakabiliana na kupanda na kushuka kwa hisia zetu, mara nyingi kama farasi-mwitu anayejaribu kujiachilia na kwenda nje ya udhibiti. Lakini Mungu pia hutupa nguvu zake za kumdhibiti huyu ‘farasi-mwitu’ na kumwongoza katika njia iliyo sahihi. Mara tu uchaguzi unapofanywa, neema ya Mungu ni yetu yote. Kinyume na tunavyojiambia mara nyingi, sisi si wahanga wa hisia zetu. Tuna wajibu wa kuchukua hatua, kwa maana kwa kweli hii ni vita kati ya mema na mabaya. Ni vita kati ya asili yetu ya dhambi na asili ya Kristo.

Nataka kuangazia baadhi ya mapambano ambayo ni ya kawaida kwa wanawake, kisha tutaona jinsi kauli ya “Nitafanya” inayoongozwa na Mungu inavyoweza kubadili mtazamo wetu na hatimaye kuathiri miitikio yetu ya kihisia na afya yetu ya kiroho.

Kujilinganisha

Kwa maana hatuthubutu kujihesabu au kujilinganisha na baadhi ya watu wanaojisifu wenyewe; lakini wao wanapojipima kwa kujilinganisha wao kwa wao, hawana akili –2 Wakorintho 10:12.

Ni mwelekeo wetu wa asili kujilinganisha na wengine. Hata hivyo, kila mara huishia kujihisi bora au duni kuliko mtu mwingine. Hilo huchochea hisia nyingi ambazo zinaweza kutuhuzunisha au kutufanya tujithibitishe isivyostahili. Miitikio hii yote miwili haileti moyo wenye amani. Badala ya kufuata mwelekeo huu wa kujilinganisha, tunaweza kusema kama Daudi, “Nitakupenda, Ee Bwana, nguvu yangu.” Kuelekeza macho yetu kwa Kristo kutatimiza mahitaji ya mioyo yetu kwa namna ambayo tamaa yetu ya kupata uthibitisho na kukubalika kutoka kwa wanadamu haiwezi wala haitafanya.

Hofu

Ninapoogopa, nitakutumaini –Zaburi 56:3.

Si mara zote tunahisi kuwa tuna uchaguzi katika jambo hili, kwani hofu hutujia kwa ghafla bila kutuonya. Lakini katika baadhi ya mapambano yangu ya hivi karibuni na hofu, Mungu alinionyesha kwamba kuishi katika hofu ya daima ni kukataa kuyaamini ahadi zilizo katika Neno lake. Kauli ya Daudi “Nitakutumaini” ni uchaguzi wa makusudi ambao nami ninahitaji kufanya. Kama wengine walivyosema, “Hofu ni kuishi katika siku zijazo bila kumjumuisha Mungu.” Neema ya Mungu ipo kwa ajili yangu leo na itakuwepo kwa ajili yangu kesho, lakini siwezi kutafuta leo neema kwa ajili ya majaribu ya kesho.

Kutoridhika

Sisemi haya kwa sababu ya uhitaji; maana nimejifunza kuridhika katika hali yoyote niliyo nayo –Wafilipi 4:11.

Tukiwa na chakula na mavazi, tutaridhika navyo –1 Timotheo 6:8.

Kila kitu kuhusu mbinu za matangazo za ulimwengu wa leo kimeundwa ili kutokeza tamaa ya kupata zaidi. Haidhuru tunaishi katika nyumba nzuri kiasi gani, asili yetu ya kibinadamu daima itatamani kitu kimoja zaidi. Fikiria amani inayopatikana kwako kama mwanamke wa Mungu, ukichagua kuiga mtazamo wa Daudi: “Nitaridhika niamkapo nikiwa na mfano wako.” Mungu anapotimiza shauku za moyo wako, huhitaji tena kutafuta utoshelevu bandia.

Masengenyo

Maneno yenu na yawe na neema sikuzote, yakikolezwa kwa chumvi, mpate kujua jinsi inavyowapasa kumjibu kila mtu –Wakolosai 4:6.

Neno lo lote lililo ovu lisitoke vinywani mwenu, bali lililo jema kwa kujenga kama ilivyo lazima, ili liwape neema wanaosikia –Waefeso 4:29.

Neno ‘masengenyo’ linafafanuliwa kuwa “mazungumzo au taarifa za kawaida au zisizozuiwa kuhusu watu wengine, ambazo kwa kawaida hujumuisha maelezo ambayo hayajathibitishwa kuwa ya kweli.” Mara nyingi ni jaribio la kukuza majivuno yetu wenyewe, ambayo chanzo chake ni kutojiamini. Daudi asema, “Nitaizuia kinywa changu kwa lijamu.” Ingawa alikuwa na kila sababu ya kusambaza ‘habari’ kuhusu adui zake, hakuona haja ya kuwashusha wengine kwa masengenyo.

Hapa tumeangalia mifano michache tu. Ninawahimiza kila mmoja wenu kutathmini kwa maombi miitikio yenu ya kihisia na jinsi inavyoweza kutawala maisha yenu. Hii hapa orodha ya maswali ya kuwasaidia kutambua maeneo ya maisha yenu ambayo huenda yanahitaji mabadiliko ya mtazamo.

  1. Je, unahitaji kuwa na mtazamo zaidi wa “Nitafanya” maishani mwako?
  2. Je, huna ari na unajiuliza maana ya maisha ni nini?
  3. Je, unapambana na msongo wa mawazo?
  4. Je, unatatizika kuweka vipaumbele vyako na huna motisha ya kuvibadili?
  5. Je, watoto wako wanahitaji maneno zaidi ya kuwatia moyo?
  6. Je, unatatizika kuwa na tabia zisizofaa za ulaji?
  7. Je, umenaswa katika mifumo ya mawazo hasi?
  8. Je, unapinga matamanio na uongozi wa mume wako?

Nia njema na mabadiliko mara nyingi hutenganishwa tu na ukosefu wa imani na motisha. Mara nyingi hatuelewi jinsi Mungu anavyojali kwa karibu hisia hizi na matatizo katika maisha yetu, na anavyongojea kuona utayari wetu wa kubadilika. Tunapochukua hatua ya kwanza ya utii, neema yake ipo ili kutenda muujiza. Mtazamo wa “Nitajaribu” huleta uzembe na kushindwa. Kauli ya “Nitafanya” hufungua hazina isiyo na mwisho ya neema ya Mungu. Kila siku huleta mamia ya maamuzi madogo. Jinsi tunavyoitikia maamuzi haya hatimaye huunda mwanamke tutakayekuwa na mwanamke tutakayekuwa katika uzee wetu.

Mariya, mama wa baadaye wa Yesu, siku moja alikabiliana ghafla uso kwa uso na malaika. Maneno yake yalimtatiza, naye “akawaza moyoni mwake” kile alichokuwa akimwambia. Angeweza kujiruhusu kuzidiwa na hofu alipofikiria maana ya maneno ya malaika kwake. Badala yake, alisema, “Tazama, mimi ni mjakazi wa Bwana; na iwe kwangu kama ulivyosema.” Alichagua imani, na hilo liliathiri ulimwengu kwa njia ambazo hangeweza kamwe kuzifikiria.

Ulikuwa uchaguzi. Uchaguzi ambao hangeweza kuchukua siku au wiki kujiandaa kuufanya. Hata hivyo, kuwa kwake sehemu ya mpango wa Mungu wa wokovu wa ulimwengu kulitegemea uchaguzi huo.

Esta, malkia, alikabiliwa na tatizo zito. Watu wake walikuwa hatarini kuangamizwa na Hamani mdanganyifu. Mordekai alimwambia kwamba alikuwa malkia kwa ajili ya wakati kama huu na kwamba lazima aingie kwa mfalme na kuomba msaada wake. Moyo wake ulitetemeka. Alizifahamu vizuri sheria za mfalme kwamba yeyote ambaye angeingia katika jumba lake bila mwaliko huenda angeuawa. Lakini alichagua ujasiri… “Nikiangamia, na niangamie.” Alikuwa tayari kufanya aliloweza kwa ajili ya watu wake bila kujali gharama yake.

Ulikuwa uchaguzi tu. Hata hivyo, usalama wa watu wake na muujiza wa kuokolewa kwao vilitokana na utayari wake wa kufanya uchaguzi mgumu hivyo.

Mitazamo na hisia—hasi au chanya—yote ni chaguo zilizofichika ambazo lazima tufanye. Utachagua lipi, “Nitajaribu” lisilo na imani au “Nitafanya” lenye ujasiri? Je, kwa neema ya Mungu, utachagua kufanya uchaguzi ulio sahihi? Mungu ameahidi kukamilisha mambo yanayokuhusu, lakini hatafanya kazi yake maishani mwako bila “Nitafanya” yako. Uamuzi uko kwako.

Na Mungu aweza kuwajaza neema kila namna, ili ninyi mkiwa na riziki za kila namna siku zote, mpate kuzidi sana katika kila tendo jema –2 Wakorintho 9:8.
