Greetings of Christian love to each one. Hopefully, you have found Christ as the anchor for your soul and the solution to your difficulties. Another year is past and gone, and what a year it was… An unseen virus encircling the world, unsettling cultures from third-world countries to the most advanced and industrialized. World leaders blaming each other for the ever-increasing pandemic as their country’s economies continued to spiral downward. And churches struggling to maintain unity in the midst of their various government’s mandates regarding social distancing, mask wearing, and limits on the size of gatherings.

For many, the year 2020 has destroyed or radically altered that which used to be considered normal and has begun establishing new norms and many things may never be the same again. ‘Six feet’ has become a well-recognized unit of measurement. The sound of coughing draws glances from those within hearing distance. Mask wearing has become the focus of jokes and endless arguments regarding the pros and cons.

Through it all, many have suffered in various ways. Most importantly, I wonder if we have considered the spiritual fallout happening to those around us?

I have heard numerous reports of folks who couldn’t handle the loss of fellowship when their local church completely stopped having in-person worship services. Some silently pined away, growing increasingly disillusioned with Christianity. Others, deciding this was ‘the straw that broke their camel’s back’, took action and left their old church, then joined a new group that was more supportive of their views. There were, however, many churches that chose to “obey God rather than man” and continued to quietly meet for worship.

Conscience in Crisis

This issue alone (governments telling churches how and when to worship) has been the cause of much discussion, disorder, and even dissension in many churches. We are facing unprecedented times. For most of us, we don’t have any experience in our past to fall back on which will help us make a clear decision. Some Christians’ consciences will not allow them peace while ‘disobeying the civil authorities’, while other Christians’ consciences will not allow them peace while ‘forsaking the assembling of themselves together’. Somehow, this “intrusion” of government into the everyday life of the church just hasn’t seemed quite right.

During the 1600s and the 1700s, our Anabaptist forefathers emigrated from Europe to foreign countries in search of a new home where they were free to worship as their conscience directed. Ever since, one of the key aspects of living in America has been that of the “separation of church and state”. So, it was with uncertainty and trepidation that we, conservative Anabaptists, have considered that which our local, state, or federal governments have asked of us. One thing that I am extremely grateful for is that the leaders of our local fellowship have maintained very strong admonishment throughout this time, that: “As we sort through each new challenge that comes our way, we must ALWAYS exhibit a godly respect (in thought, in word, and in action) for our civil authorities”, especially if we find it necessary to “obey God rather than man”.

Another major point of concern was that of the United States elections at the end of 2020. Somehow, this country has become more and more polarized over the last four years, (maybe it has been longer). I heard a report of one man from the world who said that if Trump doesn’t win the election then he sees no hope to continue living and he is contemplating whether he should just take his own life and end it all. Sure, a man of the world may not have the hope of a better life to come since he probably doesn’t see himself as a “stranger and a pilgrim” here on this earth and most likely he doesn’t believe in life eternal. But what about those of us who claim to be Christians, are we doing any better? Are we responding to each situation in fear or in faith?

All of this upheaval in our ‘normal’ way of life, has brought uncertainty. Uncertainty about jobs. Uncertainty about our future. Uncertainty about our families. Uncertainty about the end of time. And the list could go on with each person filling in the blanks for him or herself.

The Vaccines

The most recent issue of upheaval that is taking front stage both in our minds and in our conversations is that of the vaccine. Will it be “forced” upon us? Are there properties included in this new type of vaccine that will enable others to ‘track’ us and listen in to all our private conversations? Is it true that there is somehow a microchip, or a multitude of nano robots immersed in that small volume of liquid? Will this new technology that has been manufactured as a synthetic mRNA vaccine somehow change my DNA if I allow them to prick my skin? Is this vaccine the mark of the beast? All these, and more, are questions which I have been hearing with ever-increasing frequency and urgency.

Conspiracy Theories

The uncertainty of it all (the virus, the election, and the vaccine) has spawned many, many conspiracy theories. Usually, if there is a negative connotation surrounding something, then we tend to close ourselves to the possibility that we may be involved. “Surely, the ideas that I am passing on are not a conspiracy theory!”

Or are they? Let’s stop and think about this a minute. Conspiracy = a secret plan by a group to do something unlawful or harmful. Theory = a supposition or a system of ideas intended to explain something. Doesn’t this fit most of the allegations and claims that have been circulated among us? Almost every new ‘story’ will claim that ‘certain’ people are secretly involved in an all-encompassing agenda to use this certain negative issue of upheaval to bring about a specific negative change that will harm the masses. Most often these ‘stories’ are designed to play on our emotions, triggering a response rooted in fear, that is ultimately designed to protect myself from the alleged personal harm—that of being personally controlled by others, loss of personal rights, loss of personal privacy, etc., etc.

If we are honest about the actual definition of ‘conspiracy’ and of ‘theory’, then we would also need to admit that many, if not most, of the ‘stories’ that are spreading through the rumor-mill are indeed conspiracy theories. I am not suggesting that we bury our heads in the sand, or that we shouldn’t be a prepared people. I am simply cautioning against being sucked into the emotional rhetoric of the many ‘stories’ that are continually being promoted.

There are some questions we can ask ourselves that will help to sort through the confusion of all the various claims or allegations being made. Am I being asked to join the fight to protect the Constitution of the United States? Am I being advised to join others in standing up for our ‘rights’? If I stop and consider what’s happening in my heart, what is motivating me to action—Faith? or Fear? If there is any truth in that which is being alleged, is there anything that I can do about it?

Like I said before, we are facing unprecedented times. Let’s face our future with faith—our God is sovereignly in control. Let’s not lose sight of our future home in heaven—we are called to be strangers and pilgrims in this world. Let’s always remember the promises of God—that He will be with us always even unto the end of the world, and that He will NOT allow us to be tempted above that which we are able to bear. These promises and many, many more are clearly specified in the Scriptures.

The virus hits home

My (Curvin’s) family contracted the Covid-19 virus in the middle of October 2020. It affected each of our family members in slightly different ways, which was interesting to observe. One of the intriguing aspects was that most of us lost our sense of taste and smell. Most of our family didn’t suffer more than we normally would with the normal flu. However, my mother, who lives with us, ended up on the very verge of needing to be hospitalized due to low oxygen levels in her blood. Thankfully, this was averted through a doctor prescribing some potent drugs which had an almost immediate effect on reversing this.

For myself, I was so sick from the virus that I wasn’t able to work for over two months. The only thing that kept me out of the hospital was a daily intake of one restricted drug and double the recommended dose of steroids through nebulizer treatments. This went on for over six weeks. It is now almost two months since I finally started to recover and yet I am still not fully back to where I was prior to contracting Covid-19.

On a side note, we have included an article bringing recognition to the life of Mose Stoltzfus, an older brother from one of our sister churches who died after contracting Covid-19. Considering these two situations, I can say of a surety that the virus is real and not a hoax; that the virus affects everybody in slightly different ways; that some people have hardly any ill effects even though they do contract the virus; and that there are some who do become very ill indeed.

The Vaccine booklet

Back a number of issues we ran a number of articles written by a doctor on the whole issue of vaccines. Our goal was to try to present as balanced of a view as possible. We had numerous requests to have those articles compiled into a booklet format, which we had announced previously that we were planning to do. We encountered a number of practical issues that needed to be sorted through, which took time (much longer than we had anticipated). Finally, we have now arrived at the point of being ready to compile and publish this booklet.

If you want to receive one or more copies of this booklet, we ask that you contact us with your contact information and the number of booklets desired, even if you have previously done so. This will help us gauge the interest level to know how many we should print. We can be reached by mail, phone, or email, each of which can be found inside the front cover of each issue of our magazine, The Heartbeat of the Remnant.

Continued Changes

Over the last year or two we have pursued various ways of streamlining our production efforts. One of these, which we have mentioned before is that of working towards having multiple authors write articles for the various specific columns, such as the Children’s Corner, Sister to Sister, A Word from The Doctor, etc. One of the changes you will see is that we will have more than one doctor writing articles for the medical column.

Finances

As you will notice, we have included a financial report in this issue for the year of 2020. A year ago, we had made known through our annual newsletter that things were quite desperate for us financially and that we needed funds if we were going to keep going forward. The response was overwhelming, and we have been blessed by all who decided to partner with us in this need. However, as you can see by the financial report, there is a need for continued financial support since our expenses are ongoing. For those of you who are actively involved in this way, we say thank you and may God richly bless your generosity.

A Point of Interest

The children’s story in this issue of the magazine holds special interest for me. While the details of the story may not all be according to fact, there was a John M. and Catharine Kurtz family that lost five children in infancy and then years later they lost six children to diphtheria. Only John S. Kurtz survived, but was joined by two younger siblings later on. John was ordained to the ministry at the age of 27 and married Maria Horning almost two years later.

John S. and Maria (Horning) Kurtz were my great, great grandparents. So, that line of my ancestry can be traced back through the time of another pandemic and tremendous upheaval in people’s lives, through that of the only surviving child out of a family of 12. For me, this brings personal interest and perspective to some of the situations we are facing today.

May God bless and keep each one. As the world becomes ever darker and more chaotic, let us as Christians draw ever closer to our Lord. In this, He has given a command containing a promise for each of us to: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded –James 4:8.

Curvin L Wenger

Salam kasih Kristen kepada setiap orang. Semoga Anda telah menemukan Kristus sebagai jangkar bagi jiwa Anda dan jalan keluar bagi kesulitan-kesulitan Anda. Satu tahun lagi telah berlalu, dan sungguh tahun yang luar biasa… Virus tak terlihat mengelilingi dunia, mengguncang masyarakat dari negara-negara dunia ketiga hingga negara-negara paling maju dan terindustrialisasi. Para pemimpin dunia saling menyalahkan atas pandemi yang terus memburuk, sementara perekonomian negara mereka terus merosot. Dan gereja-gereja berjuang mempertahankan kesatuan di tengah berbagai ketentuan pemerintah mereka mengenai jaga jarak sosial, pemakaian masker, dan pembatasan jumlah orang dalam pertemuan.

Bagi banyak orang, tahun 2020 telah menghancurkan atau mengubah secara radikal hal-hal yang dahulu dianggap normal, dan mulai membentuk norma-norma baru; banyak hal mungkin tidak akan pernah sama lagi. “Enam kaki” telah menjadi satuan ukuran yang dikenal luas. Suara batuk membuat orang-orang yang mendengarnya menoleh. Pemakaian masker telah menjadi sasaran lelucon dan perdebatan tanpa akhir mengenai kelebihan dan kekurangannya.

Di tengah semua itu, banyak orang menderita dalam berbagai hal. Yang terpenting, saya bertanya-tanya apakah kita telah memikirkan dampak rohani yang dialami orang-orang di sekitar kita?

Saya telah mendengar banyak laporan tentang orang-orang yang tidak sanggup menghadapi hilangnya persekutuan ketika gereja setempat mereka sama sekali berhenti mengadakan ibadah tatap muka. Ada yang diam-diam merana, semakin kecewa terhadap Kekristenan. Yang lain, karena memutuskan bahwa ini adalah “pukulan terakhir yang tak tertahankan”, bertindak dengan meninggalkan gereja lama mereka, lalu bergabung dengan kelompok baru yang lebih mendukung pandangan mereka. Namun, banyak gereja memilih untuk “lebih taat kepada Allah daripada kepada manusia” dan terus berkumpul dengan tenang untuk beribadah.

Hati Nurani dalam Krisis

Persoalan ini saja (pemerintah memberi tahu gereja bagaimana dan kapan harus beribadah) telah menjadi penyebab banyak pembahasan, kekacauan, bahkan perselisihan di banyak gereja. Kita sedang menghadapi masa-masa yang belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya. Kebanyakan dari kita tidak memiliki pengalaman masa lalu yang dapat dijadikan pegangan untuk membantu kita mengambil keputusan yang jelas. Hati nurani sebagian orang Kristen tidak akan membiarkan mereka merasa tenteram ketika “tidak menaati pemerintah sipil”, sementara hati nurani orang Kristen lainnya tidak akan membiarkan mereka merasa tenteram ketika “mengabaikan pertemuan bersama”. Entah bagaimana, “campur tangan” pemerintah dalam kehidupan sehari-hari gereja terasa tidak sepenuhnya benar.

Pada tahun 1600-an dan 1700-an, leluhur Anabaptis kita beremigrasi dari Eropa ke negeri-negeri asing untuk mencari tempat tinggal baru yang memungkinkan mereka beribadah menurut tuntunan hati nurani mereka. Sejak saat itu, salah satu aspek penting kehidupan di Amerika adalah “pemisahan gereja dan negara”. Karena itu, kami, kaum Anabaptis konservatif, menyikapi dengan ketidakpastian dan kegelisahan hal-hal yang diminta oleh pemerintah daerah, negara bagian, atau federal dari kami. Satu hal yang sangat saya syukuri adalah bahwa para pemimpin persekutuan setempat kami terus-menerus menasihati dengan sangat tegas sepanjang masa ini, bahwa: “Saat kita menyikapi setiap tantangan baru yang datang, kita harus SELALU menunjukkan penghormatan yang saleh (dalam pikiran, perkataan, dan tindakan) kepada pemerintah sipil kita”, terutama jika kita merasa perlu untuk “lebih taat kepada Allah daripada kepada manusia”.

Hal besar lain yang menjadi perhatian adalah pemilihan umum Amerika Serikat pada akhir tahun 2020. Entah bagaimana, negara ini semakin terpolarisasi selama empat tahun terakhir (mungkin sudah lebih lama). Saya mendengar laporan tentang seorang pria duniawi yang berkata bahwa jika Trump tidak memenangkan pemilihan, ia tidak melihat harapan untuk terus hidup dan sedang mempertimbangkan apakah ia sebaiknya mengakhiri hidupnya sendiri dan mengakhiri semuanya. Tentu saja, seorang pria duniawi mungkin tidak memiliki harapan akan kehidupan yang lebih baik kelak karena ia mungkin tidak memandang dirinya sebagai “orang asing dan pendatang” di bumi ini dan kemungkinan besar ia tidak percaya pada hidup kekal. Namun, bagaimana dengan kita yang mengaku sebagai orang Kristen, apakah keadaan kita lebih baik? Apakah kita menanggapi setiap situasi dengan ketakutan atau dengan iman?

Semua gejolak ini dalam cara hidup kita yang “normal” telah membawa ketidakpastian. Ketidakpastian tentang pekerjaan. Ketidakpastian tentang masa depan kita. Ketidakpastian tentang keluarga kita. Ketidakpastian tentang akhir zaman. Dan daftarnya dapat terus berlanjut, dengan setiap orang mengisi sendiri bagian yang kosong.

Vaksin

Persoalan terbaru yang menjadi pusat gejolak, baik dalam pikiran maupun percakapan kita, adalah vaksin. Apakah vaksin itu akan “dipaksakan” kepada kita? Apakah jenis vaksin baru ini mengandung unsur-unsur yang memungkinkan orang lain “melacak” kita dan menyadap semua percakapan pribadi kita? Benarkah di dalamnya entah bagaimana terdapat sebuah mikrocip, atau sejumlah besar robot nano yang tercampur dalam sedikit cairan itu? Apakah teknologi baru yang dibuat sebagai vaksin mRNA sintetis ini entah bagaimana akan mengubah DNA saya jika saya membiarkan mereka menusuk kulit saya? Apakah vaksin ini tanda binatang itu? Semua ini, dan pertanyaan-pertanyaan lainnya, adalah hal-hal yang belakangan ini semakin sering dan mendesak saya dengar.

Teori Konspirasi

Ketidakpastian mengenai semuanya (virus, pemilihan umum, dan vaksin) telah melahirkan banyak sekali teori konspirasi. Biasanya, jika sesuatu memiliki konotasi negatif, kita cenderung menutup diri terhadap kemungkinan bahwa kita mungkin terlibat. “Tentu saja, gagasan yang saya teruskan bukan teori konspirasi!”

Atau benarkah? Mari kita berhenti sejenak dan memikirkan hal ini. Konspirasi = rencana rahasia oleh sekelompok orang untuk melakukan sesuatu yang melanggar hukum atau merugikan. Teori = dugaan atau sistem gagasan yang dimaksudkan untuk menjelaskan sesuatu. Bukankah definisi ini sesuai dengan sebagian besar tuduhan dan klaim yang beredar di antara kita? Hampir setiap “cerita” baru akan menyatakan bahwa orang-orang “tertentu” diam-diam terlibat dalam agenda menyeluruh untuk memanfaatkan persoalan gejolak negatif tertentu ini demi mendatangkan perubahan negatif tertentu yang akan merugikan orang banyak. Sering kali “cerita-cerita” ini dirancang untuk memainkan emosi kita, memicu tanggapan yang berakar pada ketakutan, yang pada akhirnya dimaksudkan untuk melindungi diri saya dari bahaya pribadi yang dituduhkan—dikendalikan secara pribadi oleh orang lain, kehilangan hak pribadi, kehilangan privasi pribadi, dan sebagainya, dan sebagainya.

Jika kita jujur mengenai definisi sebenarnya dari “konspirasi” dan “teori”, kita juga perlu mengakui bahwa banyak, jika bukan sebagian besar, “cerita” yang menyebar melalui kabar angin memang merupakan teori konspirasi. Saya tidak menyarankan agar kita berpura-pura tidak melihat, atau bahwa kita tidak perlu menjadi orang yang siap siaga. Saya hanya memperingatkan agar kita tidak terseret ke dalam retorika emosional dari banyak “cerita” yang terus-menerus disebarkan.

Ada beberapa pertanyaan yang dapat kita ajukan kepada diri sendiri untuk membantu memilah kebingungan dari berbagai klaim atau tuduhan yang dilontarkan. Apakah saya diminta bergabung dalam perjuangan untuk melindungi Konstitusi Amerika Serikat? Apakah saya dinasihati untuk bergabung dengan orang lain dalam membela “hak-hak” kita? Jika saya berhenti sejenak dan mempertimbangkan apa yang terjadi dalam hati saya, apa yang mendorong saya untuk bertindak—Iman? Atau ketakutan? Jika ada kebenaran dalam hal yang dituduhkan itu, adakah sesuatu yang dapat saya lakukan mengenainya?

Seperti yang saya katakan sebelumnya, kita sedang menghadapi masa-masa yang belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya. Marilah kita menghadapi masa depan dengan iman—Allah kita berdaulat dan memegang kendali. Janganlah kita melupakan rumah masa depan kita di surga—kita dipanggil untuk menjadi orang asing dan pendatang di dunia ini. Marilah kita selalu mengingat janji-janji Allah—bahwa Dia akan menyertai kita senantiasa sampai akhir zaman, dan bahwa Dia TIDAK akan membiarkan kita dicobai melampaui kemampuan kita untuk menanggungnya. Janji-janji ini dan banyak sekali janji lainnya dinyatakan dengan jelas dalam Kitab Suci.

Virus Menimpa Keluarga Kami

Keluarga saya (Curvin) tertular virus Covid-19 pada pertengahan Oktober 2020. Dampaknya terhadap setiap anggota keluarga kami sedikit berbeda-beda, dan menarik untuk diamati. Salah satu hal yang menarik adalah bahwa sebagian besar dari kami kehilangan indra pengecap dan penciuman. Sebagian besar keluarga kami tidak menderita lebih parah daripada yang biasanya kami alami saat terserang flu biasa. Namun, ibu saya, yang tinggal bersama kami, nyaris harus dirawat di rumah sakit karena kadar oksigen dalam darahnya rendah. Syukurlah, hal itu dapat dicegah berkat dokter yang meresepkan beberapa obat kuat yang hampir seketika berdampak membalikkan keadaan ini.

Bagi saya sendiri, saya begitu sakit akibat virus ini sehingga tidak dapat bekerja selama lebih dari dua bulan. Satu-satunya hal yang membuat saya tidak sampai dirawat di rumah sakit adalah konsumsi harian satu obat yang penggunaannya dibatasi dan dosis steroid dua kali lipat dari dosis yang dianjurkan melalui perawatan dengan nebulizer. Hal ini berlangsung selama lebih dari enam minggu. Kini hampir dua bulan sejak saya akhirnya mulai pulih, tetapi saya masih belum sepenuhnya kembali ke keadaan sebelum tertular Covid-19.

Sebagai catatan tambahan, kami menyertakan sebuah artikel untuk mengenang kehidupan Mose Stoltzfus, seorang saudara yang lebih tua dari salah satu gereja saudari kami yang meninggal setelah tertular Covid-19. Dengan mempertimbangkan kedua keadaan ini, saya dapat mengatakan dengan pasti bahwa virus ini nyata dan bukan tipuan; bahwa dampak virus ini sedikit berbeda pada setiap orang; bahwa sebagian orang hampir tidak mengalami dampak buruk meskipun tertular virus ini; dan bahwa ada juga orang-orang yang benar-benar jatuh sakit parah.

Buklet tentang Vaksin

Beberapa edisi yang lalu, kami memuat sejumlah artikel yang ditulis oleh seorang dokter mengenai seluruh persoalan vaksin. Tujuan kami adalah berusaha menyajikan pandangan yang seimbang sebisa mungkin. Kami menerima banyak permintaan agar artikel-artikel itu dihimpun dalam bentuk buklet, dan sebelumnya telah mengumumkan bahwa kami berencana melakukannya. Kami menghadapi sejumlah persoalan praktis yang perlu dibereskan, dan hal itu memerlukan waktu (jauh lebih lama daripada yang kami perkirakan). Akhirnya, kini kami telah siap untuk menyusun dan menerbitkan buklet ini.

Jika Anda ingin menerima satu atau beberapa eksemplar buklet ini, kami meminta Anda menghubungi kami dengan menyertakan informasi kontak dan jumlah buklet yang diinginkan, meskipun Anda telah melakukannya sebelumnya. Hal ini akan membantu kami mengukur tingkat minat agar kami mengetahui berapa banyak yang perlu dicetak. Anda dapat menghubungi kami melalui surat, telepon, atau email; masing-masing informasi tersebut dapat ditemukan di bagian dalam sampul depan setiap edisi majalah kami, The Heartbeat of the Remnant.

Perubahan Berkelanjutan

Selama satu atau dua tahun terakhir, kami telah mengupayakan berbagai cara untuk menyederhanakan pekerjaan produksi kami. Salah satunya, yang pernah kami sebutkan sebelumnya, adalah upaya agar beberapa penulis menulis artikel untuk berbagai rubrik khusus, seperti Sudut Anak-Anak, Dari Saudari kepada Saudari, Sepatah Kata dari Dokter, dan sebagainya. Salah satu perubahan yang akan Anda lihat adalah bahwa lebih dari satu dokter akan menulis artikel untuk rubrik kesehatan.

Keuangan

Seperti yang akan Anda lihat, dalam edisi ini kami menyertakan laporan keuangan untuk tahun 2020. Setahun yang lalu, melalui buletin tahunan kami, kami telah memberitahukan bahwa keadaan keuangan kami sangat genting dan bahwa kami membutuhkan dana untuk dapat terus melanjutkan pekerjaan. Tanggapannya sungguh luar biasa, dan kami telah diberkati oleh semua orang yang memutuskan untuk bermitra dengan kami dalam memenuhi kebutuhan ini. Namun, seperti yang dapat Anda lihat dalam laporan keuangan, dukungan keuangan yang berkelanjutan masih diperlukan karena pengeluaran kami terus berjalan. Kepada Anda yang aktif terlibat dengan cara ini, kami mengucapkan terima kasih dan kiranya Allah melimpahkan berkat-Nya atas kemurahan hati Anda.

Hal yang Menarik

Kisah anak-anak dalam edisi majalah ini sangat menarik bagi saya. Meskipun rincian kisah itu mungkin tidak semuanya sesuai fakta, memang ada keluarga John M. dan Catharine Kurtz yang kehilangan lima anak saat masih bayi, lalu bertahun-tahun kemudian kehilangan enam anak akibat difteri. Hanya John S. Kurtz yang selamat, tetapi kemudian ia mendapat dua adik. John ditahbiskan menjadi pelayan jemaat pada usia 27 tahun dan menikah dengan Maria Horning hampir dua tahun kemudian.

John S. dan Maria (Horning) Kurtz adalah kakek-nenek canggah saya. Jadi, garis keturunan saya dapat ditelusuri kembali hingga melewati masa pandemi lain dan gejolak besar dalam kehidupan banyak orang, melalui satu-satunya anak yang selamat dari keluarga yang terdiri atas 12 anak. Bagi saya, hal ini memberikan ketertarikan dan perspektif pribadi terhadap beberapa keadaan yang kita hadapi saat ini.

Kiranya Allah memberkati dan memelihara setiap orang. Saat dunia menjadi semakin gelap dan kacau, marilah kita sebagai orang Kristen semakin mendekat kepada Tuhan kita. Dalam hal ini, Dia telah memberikan perintah yang berisi janji bagi kita masing-masing: Mendekatlah kepada Allah, dan Ia akan mendekat kepadamu. Bersihkanlah tanganmu, hai orang-orang berdosa; dan sucikanlah hatimu, hai orang-orang yang mendua hati –Yakobus 4:8.

Curvin L Wenger

Meet the doctor who wrote this article for our medical column. (See the editorial under the section “continued changes” for further details.)

Hello,

My full name is Vincent “John” Bradford Waldron (I go by John) and I am a Family Physician in south central Virginia. My family and I attend church at Bethel Mennonite Church in Gladys, Virginia. My wife, Elaine, and I have been married since 2002 and have five children. I have been in practice for twenty years; the first seventeen I practiced in southern Indiana.

Currently, I practice in an outpatient setting taking care of patients in the small town of Brookneal. My vision is to care for people as Jesus would. I want to share the Gospel with those who need it and to minister to the needs of those who are hurting. The majority of my patients are not from a conservative Anabaptist background and perhaps the only way they will see Jesus is through me.

John

Editor’s Note:

Currently, the details are changing, sometimes daily, regarding the vaccines, the unexpected problems associated with providing the vaccines to the vast multitudes of the world’s population, and the potential side effects developing from receiving the vaccine. This article was first written prior to the first vaccines being available, since then it has been revised at least twice.

We realize there are many unknowns surrounding this whole issue. It is with this in mind that we have tried to be as balanced as possible as we have considered the information that was available at the time of writing. We plan to keep our ears tuned to the progression of these situations. And we will do our best to continue investigating and evaluating concerns that are directed our way. If the Lord wills, we plan to print updated information regarding these issues in succeeding issues of the magazine.

Bottomline, as a board, we second the comments found in Larry Zook’s article (Admonition for Uncertain Times) found in this issue of the magazine… “Informed Consent and Getting a Second Opinion—both have been the long-standing ethical basis of decision-making in choosing medical treatment. I hope we retain both.”

Coronavirus vaccines are in the news these days. When the first vaccines were finally considered ‘safe’ for use by the medical community the initial focus was on England as many “Brits” were among the first to receive the vaccine including one man, who interestingly enough, has the name of William Shakespeare. As of the writing of this article, here in the U.S., the FDA has approved the initial Covid-19 vaccines developed by Moderna and Pfizer.

The Initial Vaccines

The first two vaccines that have come out and been approved were vaccines that used synthetic mRNA (messenger RNA). In cells, DNA encodes the different proteins that cells need to produce in order to function. The only thing is that no proteins are actually made in the nucleus, they are actually made in the ribosomes of the cell. So, the cell needs a messenger to go from the nucleus to the ribosomes and carry those instructions. That messenger is mRNA.

The mRNA takes the messages from the nucleus to the ribosomes. After a time the message degrades, and the ribosomes stop making that particular protein.

In the case of mRNA vaccines, the synthetic mRNA in the vaccine encodes a protein that looks like the spike protein on the COVID virus. As cells make this protein, the body’s immune system will identify those proteins as foreign and begin to create antibodies to them.

Does mRNA Change DNA?

I know that there is much fear around the idea that these vaccines will change our genetic code. This, of course, could be really dangerous. Fortunately, the mRNA doesn’t make its way to the nucleus and instead is only active where proteins are made. This technology (mRNA vaccines) is quite different than stem cell gene therapies, and the various gene-editing therapies, such as CRISPR. Both of these fields of therapy do affect a person at the level of their genes, but the mRNA vaccine does not.

Effectiveness

In the studies that looked at the two mRNA vaccines, we found that they were quite effective. There were only 8 cases of COVID identified in the patients seven days after the second dose of the Pfizer vaccine, while in those who got the placebo vaccine, there were 162 cases in that same period. Looking at severe cases, there was only one case in the vaccine group (this happened between the first and second doses) and nine cases of severe COVID in the placebo group.1 The Moderna vaccine showed similar effectiveness.2

There is still a question out there. Do these vaccines actually prevent all COVID infections or do they just turn COVID infections into low-symptom or no-symptom infections? Currently, studies are being done to look at this. The only way to know is to run antibody testing on patients who have gotten the COVID vaccine for proteins that are not in the vaccine. So, for instance, there is a protein called the “n” protein that is in a different part of the virus. Someone who has had the vaccine, but not an infection with COVID will not have an antibody to this protein, while someone who has had an actual COVID infection will have this antibody as well as an antibody to the spike protein.

In the meantime, everyone, even those who have received the vaccine, will still need to practice extra caution, such as wearing masks, hand washing, and social distancing, at least until we know for sure whether or not it’s possible to get infections (even with the vaccine) and how contagious these potential infections may be.

Side Effects of COVID Vaccine

The most common side effects that have been noted so far has been arm soreness. This usually lasts for one to three days and then resolves. Many people also often feel tired and achy. They may even run low-grade fevers for one to two days after getting the injections. However, this seems to be a bigger issue with the second injection.

There have been isolated allergic reactions to the vaccines as well. The rate of anaphylaxis (severe allergy) to COVID vaccine does seem to be somewhat higher when compared with other vaccines. Because of this, it is recommended that people get vaccinated in locations where there is treatment available to take care of such a reaction and that they should stay for a minimum of 15 minutes after the shot (or 30 minutes if they normally carry an epi pen).3

Updated Side Effects

In the last several weeks, nearly 15 million people in the United States have gotten at least one dose of the COVID vaccines. There have been a lot more doses given around the world. As we have done this, certain things have been clearer as far as side effects.

Anaphylaxis is the most serious “common” side effect. The CDC is saying that the rate of serious allergy to the Moderna and Pfizer vaccines is about 11 per million doses given. This sort of an allergy requires medications like epinephrine to reverse it and is seen with other vaccines and medications too.

In Norway, nearly all of the patients in nursing homes were vaccinated against COVID.4 In the subsequent six days, 23 of the frailest of those died. At this point, it is being investigated as to whether or not the vaccine contributed in any way to those deaths. From what we know, those patients weren’t in good health prior to the vaccine, but I think I would probably avoid giving the vaccine to people who are in extremely poor health (understanding that if those folks get COVID they probably wouldn’t do well either).

A lot of people have had muscle pains, chills and even low-grade fevers after the second dose of vaccine. Several of my co-workers had these sorts of symptoms and all of them resolved within 48 hours of getting the vaccine.

I think one last thing to remember is that just because something happens after you get vaccinated, it does not mean the vaccine caused it. So, if you get a shot and then get hit by a car, clearly the shot didn’t cause the accident. One possible example of this is a doctor in Florida who got a COVID vaccine and then developed really low platelet counts and eventually died. There is no indication that the vaccination caused the low platelet count and we have not seen this in any other patients who have gotten vaccinated for COVID. The guess is simply that he was probably developing this disorder already and that the vaccine didn’t cause it or affect it.

Simply put, when you give millions of doses of anything, there will always be some who develop other illnesses soon after getting the medicine or vaccine. The challenge is to figure out what is related to the therapy and what is just “noise.”

Ethical Issues

Other than the two vaccines listed above, there are many others being researched and developed. Some of these vaccines are grown on cell lines that were derived from babies that were aborted in the 70s and 80s. I need to be clear that there are no ongoing abortions being utilized to make any vaccines.

In light of this, the one good thing is that the Pfizer and Moderna vaccines are not grown on these fetal cell lines.

Other Vaccines

Janssen (Johnson and Johnson) Pharmaceuticals and Astra Zeneca are both working on vaccines that are more traditional vaccines—that is they grow the virus, then kill it, and then give small doses of the killed virus to trigger the immune response. create immunity. The Astra Zeneca vaccine probably will be released before too long. The studies on it are a little more unclear with regard to its effectiveness.

The important thing with these vaccines is that they are both grown on HEK293 fetal cells, which are derived from an aborted infant.

There are a number of other vaccines that are a little further away from release, but there is one from Merck is a non-mRNA vaccine that is also ethically sourced (not grown on aborted fetal cells). The Lozier Institute has a web page that lists which vaccines use fetal cell lines and which ones do not.5

Other Questions

There have been a number of questions about who was behind these vaccines and a variety of concerns with respect to their development. Some have even speculated about companies introducing a “microchip” into the vaccines.

The needles being used to administer these vaccines are a very small caliber (21 gauge or smaller) which makes it unlikely that a microchip could be administered through such a needle. It seems probable that to administer a microchip, it would require a significantly larger needle than the ones being recommended, (the microchips that are normally used in pets are roughly the size of a kernel of rice).

Making a Decision

Is it worthwhile to get one of these vaccines, and, if so, which one?

The biggest reason to get a COVID vaccine is to avoid the possible long-term effects of a COVID infection. In some people, COVID produces chronic fatigue, a long-term cough, and “brain fog.” Getting one of these vaccines certainly would help to avoid those disease-induced problems along with the possibility that COVID could also cause some heart damage.6

What if You’ve Had COVID already?

Many in our circles have already had COVID. If you know you had COVID then probably the best thing to do is to wait. There is no particular reason to run out and get vaccinated, since we believe your antibodies should remain active for three to six months. In studies, they did seem to decline over time, but folks who had COVID should be immune for a minimum of 3 months and probably longer.

It seems most reasonable to wait and see if one of the vaccines shows itself to be superior, with regard either to effectiveness or fewer side effects, than the others.

Who Should Not Get Vaccinated?

Currently, there are certain people who should not get the vaccine. The first category are groups that weren’t in the studies. So, children under the age of 16, pregnant women, and nursing mothers should all avoid the COVID vaccines for the time being. It may be that the vaccine would be safe for people in these groups, but since they weren’t tested, they shouldn’t get it for now.

Secondly, if you actively have COVID or are currently isolating because of being exposed to it, you shouldn’t get the vaccine. I suppose this makes sense as we don’t typically give vaccinations to people who are already sick.

Finally, you should be careful if you have a history of severe reactions to other vaccines.

Everyone else

If someone has not had a COVID infection, I would certainly lean towards getting the vaccine. Personally, I have started getting vaccinated using the Pfizer vaccine and feel comfortable with that. For those who are working in health care, I would lean towards getting one of the vaccines. The issue for me is not the risk of infection to me, rather my concern as a Christian doctor is the danger that I might pass COVID on to one of my patients.

If you are caring for the elderly and have not had a COVID infection, I would also think strongly about getting vaccinated. Once again, the primary concern should not be how you will handle the infection, but instead who you might pass that infection on to.

Conclusion

I understand that others’ comfort level may be lower with these new vaccines and if that is the case, I would wait. These vaccines are being given to millions of people and if there are issues, they will become apparent fairly quickly.

Finally, I am glad that there are going to be several ethically sourced vaccines available to those who desire them.

আমাদের চিকিৎসা-বিষয়ক কলামের জন্য এই নিবন্ধটি লিখেছেন যে চিকিৎসক, তাঁর সঙ্গে পরিচিত হোন। (আরও বিস্তারিত জানতে “ক্রমাগত পরিবর্তন” বিভাগে সম্পাদকীয়টি দেখুন।)

নমস্কার,

আমার পুরো নাম ভিনসেন্ট “জন” ব্র্যাডফোর্ড ওয়ালড্রন (আমি জন নামেই পরিচিত), এবং আমি ভার্জিনিয়ার দক্ষিণ-মধ্যাঞ্চলে একজন পারিবারিক চিকিৎসক। আমার পরিবার ও আমি ভার্জিনিয়ার গ্ল্যাডিসে বেথেল মেনোনাইট চার্চে উপাসনায় যোগ দিই। আমার স্ত্রী এলেইন এবং আমি ২০০২ সাল থেকে বিবাহিত, আমাদের পাঁচটি সন্তান আছে। আমি বিশ বছর ধরে চিকিৎসা পেশায় আছি; প্রথম সতেরো বছর দক্ষিণ ইন্ডিয়ানায় চিকিৎসা করেছি।

বর্তমানে, আমি ব্রুকনিলের ছোট শহরে বহির্বিভাগে রোগীদের চিকিৎসা করি। আমার লক্ষ্য, যিশু যেভাবে করতেন সেভাবে মানুষের সেবা করা। যাদের সুসমাচার প্রয়োজন, তাদের সঙ্গে তা ভাগ করে নিতে চাই এবং যারা কষ্ট পাচ্ছেন, তাদের প্রয়োজন মেটাতে সেবা করতে চাই। আমার অধিকাংশ রোগীই রক্ষণশীল অ্যানাব্যাপ্টিস্ট পটভূমি থেকে আসেন না, এবং হয়তো আমার মাধ্যমেই তারা যিশুকে দেখতে পাবেন।

জন

সম্পাদকের নোট:

বর্তমানে, টিকা, বিশ্বের বিপুল জনসমষ্টিকে টিকা দেওয়ার ক্ষেত্রে দেখা দেওয়া অপ্রত্যাশিত সমস্যা এবং টিকা নেওয়ার ফলে দেখা দিতে পারে এমন সম্ভাব্য পার্শ্বপ্রতিক্রিয়া সম্পর্কে তথ্য কখনো কখনো প্রতিদিনই বদলাচ্ছে। প্রথম টিকাগুলো পাওয়া যাওয়ার আগেই এই নিবন্ধটি প্রথম লেখা হয়েছিল; তারপর থেকে এটি অন্তত দুবার সংশোধন করা হয়েছে।

আমরা বুঝতে পারি, এই পুরো বিষয়টি ঘিরে অনেক কিছুই অজানা। এই বিষয়টি মাথায় রেখে, লেখার সময় যে তথ্য পাওয়া গিয়েছিল তা বিবেচনা করার সময় আমরা যথাসম্ভব ভারসাম্যপূর্ণ থাকার চেষ্টা করেছি। এই পরিস্থিতিগুলোর অগ্রগতি সম্পর্কে আমরা সতর্ক নজর রাখার পরিকল্পনা করছি। আমাদের কাছে উত্থাপিত উদ্বেগগুলো অনুসন্ধান ও মূল্যায়ন চালিয়ে যাওয়ার জন্য যথাসাধ্য করব। প্রভুর ইচ্ছা হলে, পত্রিকার পরবর্তী সংখ্যাগুলোতে এই বিষয়গুলো সম্পর্কে হালনাগাদ তথ্য প্রকাশ করার পরিকল্পনা রয়েছে।

সারকথা, পরিচালনা পর্ষদ হিসেবে আমরা এই সংখ্যায় প্রকাশিত ল্যারি জুকের নিবন্ধ (অনিশ্চিত সময়ের জন্য উপদেশ)-এ থাকা মন্তব্যগুলোর সঙ্গে একমত… “অবহিত সম্মতি এবং দ্বিতীয় মতামত নেওয়া—চিকিৎসা বেছে নেওয়ার সিদ্ধান্তের ক্ষেত্রে দুটিই দীর্ঘদিনের নৈতিক ভিত্তি। আশা করি, আমরা দুটিই বজায় রাখব।”

আজকাল করোনাভাইরাসের টিকা খবরের শিরোনামে। চিকিৎসা মহল যখন শেষ পর্যন্ত প্রথম টিকাগুলোকে ব্যবহারের জন্য ‘নিরাপদ’ বলে বিবেচনা করল, তখন প্রাথমিক দৃষ্টি ছিল ইংল্যান্ডের দিকে; কারণ টিকা নেওয়া প্রথম ব্যক্তিদের মধ্যে অনেক “ব্রিটিশ” ছিলেন। তাঁদের একজনের নাম ছিল উইলিয়াম শেক্‌সপিয়ার—যা বেশ কৌতূহলোদ্দীপক। এই নিবন্ধটি লেখার সময়, এখানে যুক্তরাষ্ট্রে, FDA মডার্না ও ফাইজারের তৈরি প্রাথমিক কোভিড-১৯ টিকাগুলো অনুমোদন করেছে।

প্রাথমিক টিকাগুলো

প্রথম যে দুটি টিকা বাজারে এসেছে এবং অনুমোদিত হয়েছে, সেগুলোতে কৃত্রিম mRNA (মেসেঞ্জার RNA) ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে। কোষে, DNA বিভিন্ন প্রোটিনের সংকেত বহন করে, যেগুলো কোষের কাজ করার জন্য তৈরি করা দরকার। বিষয়টি হলো, নিউক্লিয়াসে আসলে কোনো প্রোটিন তৈরি হয় না; সেগুলো তৈরি হয় কোষের রাইবোসোমে। তাই নিউক্লিয়াস থেকে রাইবোসোমে গিয়ে সেই নির্দেশ বহন করার জন্য কোষের একজন বার্তাবাহক দরকার। সেই বার্তাবাহকই mRNA।

mRNA নিউক্লিয়াস থেকে রাইবোসোমে বার্তা নিয়ে যায়। কিছু সময় পর বার্তাটি ক্ষয় হয়ে যায়, আর রাইবোসোমগুলো সেই নির্দিষ্ট প্রোটিন তৈরি করা বন্ধ করে দেয়।

mRNA টিকার ক্ষেত্রে, টিকায় থাকা কৃত্রিম mRNA এমন একটি প্রোটিনের সংকেত বহন করে, যা COVID ভাইরাসের স্পাইক প্রোটিনের মতো দেখতে। কোষগুলো এই প্রোটিন তৈরি করলে, শরীরের রোগপ্রতিরোধ ব্যবস্থা সেগুলোকে বহিরাগত হিসেবে শনাক্ত করবে এবং সেগুলোর বিরুদ্ধে অ্যান্টিবডি তৈরি করতে শুরু করবে।

mRNA কি DNA পরিবর্তন করে?

আমি জানি, এই টিকাগুলো আমাদের জিনগত সংকেত বদলে দেবে—এই ধারণা নিয়ে অনেক ভয় রয়েছে। অবশ্যই, তা সত্যিই বিপজ্জনক হতে পারে। সৌভাগ্যবশত, mRNA নিউক্লিয়াসে পৌঁছায় না; বরং এটি শুধু সেই স্থানেই সক্রিয় থাকে, যেখানে প্রোটিন তৈরি হয়। এই প্রযুক্তি (mRNA টিকা) স্টেম সেল জিন-থেরাপি এবং CRISPR-এর মতো বিভিন্ন জিন-সম্পাদনা থেরাপির চেয়ে বেশ আলাদা। এই দুই ধরনের চিকিৎসাই একজন ব্যক্তির জিনের স্তরে প্রভাব ফেলে, কিন্তু mRNA টিকা তা করে না।

কার্যকারিতা

দুটি mRNA টিকা নিয়ে করা গবেষণায় দেখা গেছে, সেগুলো বেশ কার্যকর ছিল। ফাইজার টিকার দ্বিতীয় ডোজ নেওয়ার সাত দিন পর রোগীদের মধ্যে মাত্র ৮টি কোভিডের সংক্রমণ শনাক্ত হয়েছিল, আর প্লাসিবো টিকা নেওয়া ব্যক্তিদের মধ্যে একই সময়ে ১৬২টি সংক্রমণ ঘটেছিল। গুরুতর সংক্রমণের দিকে তাকালে, টিকা নেওয়া দলের মধ্যে মাত্র একটি ঘটনা ঘটেছিল (এটি প্রথম ও দ্বিতীয় ডোজের মধ্যে ঘটেছিল), আর প্লাসিবো দলের মধ্যে গুরুতর কোভিডের ৯টি ঘটনা ঘটেছিল।1 মডার্না টিকাও একই রকম কার্যকারিতা দেখিয়েছে।2

তবু একটি প্রশ্ন রয়েই গেছে। এই টিকাগুলো কি সত্যিই সব কোভিড সংক্রমণ প্রতিরোধ করে, নাকি সংক্রমণকে কেবল কম উপসর্গযুক্ত বা উপসর্গহীন সংক্রমণে পরিণত করে? বর্তমানে এ বিষয়ে গবেষণা চলছে। জানার একমাত্র উপায় হলো, কোভিড টিকা নেওয়া রোগীদের মধ্যে টিকায় নেই এমন প্রোটিনের বিরুদ্ধে অ্যান্টিবডি পরীক্ষা করা। উদাহরণস্বরূপ, “n” প্রোটিন নামে একটি প্রোটিন আছে, যা ভাইরাসের অন্য একটি অংশে থাকে। যিনি টিকা নিয়েছেন, কিন্তু কোভিডে আক্রান্ত হননি, তাঁর এই প্রোটিনের বিরুদ্ধে অ্যান্টিবডি থাকবে না; অন্যদিকে, যিনি সত্যিকারের কোভিড সংক্রমণে আক্রান্ত হয়েছেন, তাঁর এই অ্যান্টিবডি থাকবে, পাশাপাশি স্পাইক প্রোটিনের বিরুদ্ধেও অ্যান্টিবডি থাকবে।

এর মধ্যে, প্রত্যেকেরই—এমনকি যারা টিকা নিয়েছেন তাঁদেরও—অতিরিক্ত সতর্কতা অবলম্বন করতে হবে; যেমন মাস্ক পরা, হাত ধোয়া এবং অন্যদের থেকে দূরত্ব বজায় রাখা। অন্তত যতক্ষণ না আমরা নিশ্চিতভাবে জানতে পারি যে টিকা নেওয়ার পরও সংক্রমণ হওয়া সম্ভব কি না এবং এ ধরনের সম্ভাব্য সংক্রমণ কতটা ছোঁয়াচে হতে পারে।

কোভিড টিকার পার্শ্বপ্রতিক্রিয়া

এ পর্যন্ত যে পার্শ্বপ্রতিক্রিয়াগুলো সবচেয়ে বেশি লক্ষ করা গেছে, তার মধ্যে রয়েছে বাহুতে ব্যথা। সাধারণত এক থেকে তিন দিন স্থায়ী হয়, তারপর সেরে যায়। অনেকেরই ক্লান্তি ও শরীর ব্যথা লাগে। ইনজেকশন নেওয়ার পর এক থেকে দুই দিন তাঁদের হালকা জ্বরও হতে পারে। তবে দ্বিতীয় ইনজেকশনের ক্ষেত্রে এটি বেশি দেখা যায় বলে মনে হয়।

টিকার কারণে বিচ্ছিন্নভাবে অ্যালার্জির প্রতিক্রিয়াও দেখা গেছে। কোভিড টিকার ফলে অ্যানাফাইল্যাক্সিসের (তীব্র অ্যালার্জি) হার অন্য টিকার তুলনায় কিছুটা বেশি বলে মনে হয়। এ কারণে এমন স্থানে টিকা নেওয়ার পরামর্শ দেওয়া হয়, যেখানে এ ধরনের প্রতিক্রিয়ার চিকিৎসার ব্যবস্থা আছে; এবং টিকা নেওয়ার পর অন্তত ১৫ মিনিট সেখানে থাকতে হবে (অথবা সাধারণত সঙ্গে এপি-পেন রাখলে ৩০ মিনিট)।3

হালনাগাদ পার্শ্বপ্রতিক্রিয়া

গত কয়েক সপ্তাহে যুক্তরাষ্ট্রে প্রায় ১৫ মিলিয়ন মানুষ কোভিড টিকার অন্তত একটি ডোজ নিয়েছেন। সারা বিশ্বে এর চেয়ে অনেক বেশি ডোজ দেওয়া হয়েছে। এভাবে টিকা দেওয়ার ফলে পার্শ্বপ্রতিক্রিয়ার কিছু বিষয় আরও স্পষ্ট হয়েছে।

অ্যানাফাইল্যাক্সিস হলো সবচেয়ে গুরুতর “সাধারণ” পার্শ্বপ্রতিক্রিয়া। CDC-এর বক্তব্য অনুযায়ী, মডার্না ও ফাইজার টিকায় গুরুতর অ্যালার্জির হার প্রতি দশ লাখ ডোজে প্রায় ১১টি। এ ধরনের অ্যালার্জির প্রতিক্রিয়া কাটাতে এপিনেফ্রিনের মতো ওষুধ লাগে; অন্য টিকা ও ওষুধের ক্ষেত্রেও এটি দেখা যায়।

নরওয়েতে, নার্সিং হোমের প্রায় সব রোগীকেই কোভিডের টিকা দেওয়া হয়েছিল।4 পরবর্তী ছয় দিনে, তাঁদের মধ্যে সবচেয়ে দুর্বল ২৩ জন মারা যান। এই মুহূর্তে, মৃত্যুগুলোর সঙ্গে টিকার কোনোভাবে সম্পর্ক ছিল কি না, তা তদন্ত করা হচ্ছে। আমরা যতটুকু জানি, টিকা নেওয়ার আগে ওই রোগীদের স্বাস্থ্য ভালো ছিল না; তবে আমার মনে হয়, যাঁদের স্বাস্থ্য অত্যন্ত খারাপ, তাঁদের টিকা দেওয়া সম্ভবত আমি এড়িয়ে চলতাম (যদিও বুঝতে হবে, ওই ব্যক্তিরা কোভিডে আক্রান্ত হলেও সম্ভবত ভালো অবস্থায় থাকতেন না)।

দ্বিতীয় ডোজ টিকা নেওয়ার পর অনেকের পেশিতে ব্যথা, কাঁপুনি, এমনকি হালকা জ্বর হয়েছে। আমার কয়েকজন সহকর্মীরও এ ধরনের উপসর্গ হয়েছিল, এবং তাঁদের সবারই টিকা নেওয়ার ৪৮ ঘণ্টার মধ্যে তা সেরে যায়।

শেষ যে বিষয়টি মনে রাখা দরকার বলে আমার মনে হয়, তা হলো—টিকা নেওয়ার পর কোনো কিছু ঘটলেই তার মানে এই নয় যে টিকাটি সেটি ঘটিয়েছে। উদাহরণ হিসেবে, আপনি টিকা নেওয়ার পর গাড়ির ধাক্কায় পড়লে, স্পষ্টতই টিকাটি দুর্ঘটনার কারণ হয়নি। এর একটি সম্ভাব্য উদাহরণ হলো ফ্লোরিডার একজন চিকিৎসক, যিনি কোভিডের টিকা নেওয়ার পর তাঁর প্লেটলেটের সংখ্যা অত্যন্ত কমে যায় এবং শেষ পর্যন্ত তিনি মারা যান। টিকা নেওয়ায় তাঁর প্লেটলেটের সংখ্যা কমেছিল—এমন কোনো ইঙ্গিত নেই, এবং কোভিডের টিকা নেওয়া অন্য কোনো রোগীর ক্ষেত্রেও আমরা এমনটি দেখিনি। ধারণা করা হয়, তাঁর এই রোগটি সম্ভবত আগে থেকেই হচ্ছিল, এবং টিকাটি তা ঘটায়নি বা এতে প্রভাব ফেলেনি।

সহজভাবে বললে, কোনো ওষুধ বা টিকার লক্ষ লক্ষ ডোজ দিলে, ওষুধ বা টিকা নেওয়ার কিছুদিনের মধ্যে কিছু মানুষের অন্য অসুস্থতা হবেই। চ্যালেঞ্জ হলো, কোনটি চিকিৎসার সঙ্গে সম্পর্কিত আর কোনটি নিছক “আকস্মিক ঘটনা”—তা নির্ধারণ করা।

নৈতিক বিষয়

উপরে উল্লেখিত দুটি টিকা ছাড়াও আরও অনেক টিকা নিয়ে গবেষণা ও উন্নয়ন চলছে। এগুলোর কিছু টিকা এমন কোষ-লাইনে উৎপাদিত হয়, যেগুলো ৭০ ও ৮০-এর দশকে গর্ভপাত করা শিশুদের কোষ থেকে তৈরি। বিষয়টি স্পষ্ট করে বলা দরকার যে, কোনো টিকা তৈরিতে চলমান গর্ভপাত ব্যবহার করা হচ্ছে না।

এই প্রেক্ষাপটে একটি ভালো দিক হলো, ফাইজার ও মডার্নার টিকা এই ভ্রূণীয় কোষ-লাইনে উৎপাদিত হয় না।

অন্যান্য টিকা

জ্যানসেন (জনসন অ্যান্ড জনসন) ফার্মাসিউটিক্যালস এবং অ্যাস্ট্রাজেনেকা—দুটি প্রতিষ্ঠানই অপেক্ষাকৃত প্রচলিত ধরনের টিকা নিয়ে কাজ করছে—অর্থাৎ, তারা ভাইরাস উৎপাদন করে, তারপর সেটিকে নিষ্ক্রিয় করে এবং রোগপ্রতিরোধী প্রতিক্রিয়া সৃষ্টি করতে সেই নিষ্ক্রিয় ভাইরাসের অল্প পরিমাণ দেয়। রোগপ্রতিরোধ ক্ষমতা তৈরি করে। অ্যাস্ট্রাজেনেকার টিকা সম্ভবত খুব বেশি দেরি না করেই বাজারে আসবে। এর কার্যকারিতা সম্পর্কে গবেষণাগুলো কিছুটা অস্পষ্ট।

এই টিকাগুলোর ক্ষেত্রে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয় হলো, দুটিই HEK293 ভ্রূণীয় কোষে উৎপাদিত হয়, যা গর্ভপাত করা একটি শিশুর কোষ থেকে তৈরি।

আরও কয়েকটি টিকা বাজারে আসতে কিছুটা সময় লাগবে; তবে মার্কের একটি টিকা আছে, যা mRNA-ভিত্তিক নয় এবং নৈতিকভাবে সংগৃহীত উপাদান ব্যবহার করে (গর্ভপাত করা ভ্রূণের কোষে উৎপাদিত নয়)। লোজিয়ার ইনস্টিটিউটের একটি ওয়েব পৃষ্ঠায় কোন টিকায় ভ্রূণীয় কোষ-লাইন ব্যবহার করা হয় আর কোনগুলোতে হয় না, তার তালিকা রয়েছে।5

অন্যান্য প্রশ্ন

এই টিকাগুলোর পেছনে কারা রয়েছে এবং এগুলো তৈরির বিষয়ে নানা উদ্বেগ নিয়ে অনেক প্রশ্ন এসেছে। কেউ কেউ এমনও অনুমান করেছেন যে, কোম্পানিগুলো টিকার মধ্যে “মাইক্রোচিপ” ঢুকিয়ে দিচ্ছে।

এই টিকাগুলো দেওয়ার জন্য যে সূঁচ ব্যবহার করা হচ্ছে, সেগুলোর মাপ খুবই সরু (২১ গেজ বা তার চেয়ে ছোট); ফলে এ ধরনের সূঁচ দিয়ে মাইক্রোচিপ দেওয়া সম্ভব হওয়ার সম্ভাবনা কম। মাইক্রোচিপ দিতে হলে, সুপারিশ করা সূঁচের চেয়ে উল্লেখযোগ্যভাবে বড় সূঁচ লাগবে বলেই মনে হয় (পোষা প্রাণীর শরীরে সাধারণত যে মাইক্রোচিপ ব্যবহার করা হয়, সেগুলোর আকার মোটামুটি এক দানার চালের মতো)।

সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়া

এই টিকাগুলোর একটি নেওয়া কি সার্থক? আর যদি হয়, তাহলে কোনটি?

কোভিড টিকা নেওয়ার সবচেয়ে বড় কারণ হলো, কোভিড সংক্রমণের সম্ভাব্য দীর্ঘমেয়াদি প্রভাব এড়ানো। কিছু মানুষের ক্ষেত্রে কোভিড দীর্ঘস্থায়ী ক্লান্তি, দীর্ঘদিনের কাশি এবং “মস্তিষ্কের ঝাপসাভাব” সৃষ্টি করে। এই টিকাগুলোর একটি নিলে রোগের কারণে সৃষ্ট এসব সমস্যা এড়াতে অবশ্যই সাহায্য হবে; পাশাপাশি কোভিডের কারণে হৃদ্‌যন্ত্রের কিছু ক্ষতি হওয়ার সম্ভাবনাও এড়ানো যাবে।6

আপনি আগে থেকেই কোভিডে আক্রান্ত হয়ে থাকলে কী করবেন?

আমাদের পরিচিত অনেকেই ইতিমধ্যে কোভিডে আক্রান্ত হয়েছেন। আপনি যদি জানেন যে আপনার কোভিড হয়েছিল, তাহলে সম্ভবত সবচেয়ে ভালো কাজ হবে অপেক্ষা করা। এখনই বেরিয়ে টিকা নেওয়ার বিশেষ কোনো কারণ নেই, কারণ আমাদের বিশ্বাস, আপনার অ্যান্টিবডি তিন থেকে ছয় মাস সক্রিয় থাকার কথা। গবেষণায় দেখা গেছে, সময়ের সঙ্গে এগুলোর মাত্রা কমতে পারে; তবে যাঁদের কোভিড হয়েছিল, তাঁরা অন্তত ৩ মাস, এবং সম্ভবত তারও বেশি সময় রোগপ্রতিরোধী থাকবেন।

অন্যগুলোর তুলনায় কোনো একটি টিকা কার্যকারিতার দিক থেকে উন্নত, বা তার পার্শ্বপ্রতিক্রিয়া কম—এমনটি স্পষ্ট হওয়া পর্যন্ত অপেক্ষা করে দেখা সবচেয়ে যুক্তিসংগত বলে মনে হয়।

কারা টিকা নেবেন না?

বর্তমানে, কিছু নির্দিষ্ট ব্যক্তির টিকা নেওয়া উচিত নয়। প্রথম শ্রেণিতে আছেন সেই দলগুলো, যারা গবেষণায় অন্তর্ভুক্ত ছিলেন না। তাই ১৬ বছরের কম বয়সী শিশু, গর্ভবতী নারী এবং শিশুকে বুকের দুধ খাওয়ান এমন মায়েদের আপাতত কোভিডের টিকা এড়িয়ে চলা উচিত। এই দলগুলোর জন্য টিকাটি নিরাপদ হতে পারে, কিন্তু তাঁদের ওপর পরীক্ষা করা হয়নি বলে আপাতত তাঁদের এটি নেওয়া উচিত নয়।

দ্বিতীয়ত, আপনার যদি সক্রিয় কোভিড সংক্রমণ থাকে, অথবা সংস্পর্শে আসার কারণে বর্তমানে নিজেকে আলাদা করে রাখেন, তাহলে আপনার টিকা নেওয়া উচিত নয়। আমার ধারণা, এতে যুক্তি আছে, কারণ যারা ইতিমধ্যেই অসুস্থ, তাদের আমরা সাধারণত টিকা দিই না।

সবশেষে, অন্য টিকায় গুরুতর প্রতিক্রিয়ার ইতিহাস থাকলে সতর্ক থাকা উচিত।

অন্য সবাই

কেউ যদি কোভিডে আক্রান্ত না হয়ে থাকেন, তাহলে আমি অবশ্যই টিকা নেওয়ার পক্ষেই ঝুঁকব। ব্যক্তিগতভাবে, আমি ফাইজার টিকা নেওয়া শুরু করেছি এবং এ নিয়ে স্বস্তি বোধ করছি। যারা স্বাস্থ্যসেবায় কাজ করেন, তাঁদের ক্ষেত্রে আমি কোনো একটি টিকা নেওয়ার পক্ষেই ঝুঁকব। আমার কাছে বিষয়টি আমার নিজের সংক্রমণের ঝুঁকি নয়; বরং একজন খ্রিষ্টান চিকিৎসক হিসেবে আমার উদ্বেগ হলো, আমি যেন আমার কোনো রোগীর কাছে কোভিড ছড়িয়ে না দিই।

আপনি যদি বয়স্কদের সেবা করেন এবং কোভিডে আক্রান্ত না হয়ে থাকেন, তাহলে টিকা নেওয়ার বিষয়টি গুরুত্বসহকারে বিবেচনা করা উচিত বলেই আমি মনে করি। আবারও বলছি, আপনার সংক্রমণ কীভাবে সামলাবেন—সেটি প্রধান উদ্বেগ হওয়া উচিত নয়; বরং আপনি কার কাছে সংক্রমণটি ছড়িয়ে দিতে পারেন, সেটিই হওয়া উচিত।

উপসংহার

আমি বুঝতে পারি, এই নতুন টিকাগুলো নিয়ে অন্যদের স্বস্তির মাত্রা কম হতে পারে; যদি তা-ই হয়, তাহলে আমি অপেক্ষা করতাম। লক্ষ লক্ষ মানুষকে এই টিকা দেওয়া হচ্ছে, আর কোনো সমস্যা থাকলে তা মোটামুটি দ্রুতই স্পষ্ট হয়ে উঠবে।

সবশেষে, যারা চান তাঁদের জন্য নৈতিকভাবে সংগৃহীত উপাদান ব্যবহার করে তৈরি কয়েকটি টিকা পাওয়া যাবে জেনে আমি আনন্দিত।

1. This world is not my home, I’m just a passing through
My treasures are laid up somewhere beyond the blue;
The angels beckon me from heaven’s open door,
And I can’t feel at home in this world anymore.

Chorus:

O Lord, you know I have no friend like you,
If heaven’s not my home, then Lord what will I do?
The angels beckon me from heaven’s open door,
And I can’t feel at home in this world anymore.

2. They’re all expecting me, and that’s one thing I know,
My Savior pardoned me and now I onward go;
I know He’ll take me thro’, tho’ I am weak and poor,
And I can’t feel at home in this world anymore.

3. I have a loving Savior up in glory-land,
I don’t expect to stop until I with Him stand,
He’s waiting now for me in heaven’s open door,
And I can’t feel at home in this world anymore.

4. Just up in glory-land we’ll live eternally,
The saints on every hand are shouting victory,
Their songs of sweetest praise drift back from heaven’s shore,
And I can’t feel at home in this world anymore.

1. Αυτός ο κόσμος δεν είναι το σπίτι μου, απλώς περνώ από εδώ
Οι θησαυροί μου φυλάγονται κάπου πέρα από τον γαλανό ουρανό·
Οι άγγελοι με καλούν από την ανοιχτή πύλη του ουρανού,
Και δεν μπορώ πια να νιώσω σαν στο σπίτι μου σ’ αυτόν τον κόσμο.

Ρεφρέν:

Ω, Κύριε, ξέρεις πως δεν έχω φίλο σαν εσένα,
Αν ο ουρανός δεν είναι το σπίτι μου, τότε, Κύριε, τι θα κάνω;
Οι άγγελοι με καλούν από την ανοιχτή πύλη του ουρανού,
Και δεν μπορώ πια να νιώσω σαν στο σπίτι μου σ’ αυτόν τον κόσμο.

2. Όλοι με περιμένουν, κι αυτό το ξέρω καλά,
Ο Σωτήρας μου με συγχώρησε και τώρα συνεχίζω τον δρόμο μου·
Ξέρω πως θα με περάσει μέσα απ’ όλα, αν και είμαι αδύναμος και φτωχός,
Και δεν μπορώ πια να νιώσω σαν στο σπίτι μου σ’ αυτόν τον κόσμο.

3. Έχω έναν στοργικό Σωτήρα εκεί ψηλά, στη χώρα της δόξας,
Δεν σκοπεύω να σταματήσω ώσπου να σταθώ μαζί Του,
Τώρα με περιμένει στην ανοιχτή πύλη του ουρανού,
Και δεν μπορώ πια να νιώσω σαν στο σπίτι μου σ’ αυτόν τον κόσμο.

4. Εκεί ψηλά, στη χώρα της δόξας, θα ζούμε αιώνια,
Οι άγιοι ολόγυρα φωνάζουν πως νίκησαν,
Τα γλυκύτερα τραγούδια δοξολογίας τους φτάνουν ως εμάς από την ακτή του ουρανού,
Και δεν μπορώ πια να νιώσω σαν στο σπίτι μου σ’ αυτόν τον κόσμο.

Greetings of Christian love to each one. Hopefully, you have found Christ as the anchor for your soul and the solution to your difficulties. Another year is past and gone, and what a year it was… An unseen virus encircling the world, unsettling cultures from third-world countries to the most advanced and industrialized. World leaders blaming each other for the ever-increasing pandemic as their country’s economies continued to spiral downward. And churches struggling to maintain unity in the midst of their various government’s mandates regarding social distancing, mask wearing, and limits on the size of gatherings.

For many, the year 2020 has destroyed or radically altered that which used to be considered normal and has begun establishing new norms and many things may never be the same again. ‘Six feet’ has become a well-recognized unit of measurement. The sound of coughing draws glances from those within hearing distance. Mask wearing has become the focus of jokes and endless arguments regarding the pros and cons.

Through it all, many have suffered in various ways. Most importantly, I wonder if we have considered the spiritual fallout happening to those around us?

I have heard numerous reports of folks who couldn’t handle the loss of fellowship when their local church completely stopped having in-person worship services. Some silently pined away, growing increasingly disillusioned with Christianity. Others, deciding this was ‘the straw that broke their camel’s back’, took action and left their old church, then joined a new group that was more supportive of their views. There were, however, many churches that chose to “obey God rather than man” and continued to quietly meet for worship.

Conscience in Crisis

This issue alone (governments telling churches how and when to worship) has been the cause of much discussion, disorder, and even dissension in many churches. We are facing unprecedented times. For most of us, we don’t have any experience in our past to fall back on which will help us make a clear decision. Some Christians’ consciences will not allow them peace while ‘disobeying the civil authorities’, while other Christians’ consciences will not allow them peace while ‘forsaking the assembling of themselves together’. Somehow, this “intrusion” of government into the everyday life of the church just hasn’t seemed quite right.

During the 1600s and the 1700s, our Anabaptist forefathers emigrated from Europe to foreign countries in search of a new home where they were free to worship as their conscience directed. Ever since, one of the key aspects of living in America has been that of the “separation of church and state”. So, it was with uncertainty and trepidation that we, conservative Anabaptists, have considered that which our local, state, or federal governments have asked of us. One thing that I am extremely grateful for is that the leaders of our local fellowship have maintained very strong admonishment throughout this time, that: “As we sort through each new challenge that comes our way, we must ALWAYS exhibit a godly respect (in thought, in word, and in action) for our civil authorities”, especially if we find it necessary to “obey God rather than man”.

Another major point of concern was that of the United States elections at the end of 2020. Somehow, this country has become more and more polarized over the last four years, (maybe it has been longer). I heard a report of one man from the world who said that if Trump doesn’t win the election then he sees no hope to continue living and he is contemplating whether he should just take his own life and end it all. Sure, a man of the world may not have the hope of a better life to come since he probably doesn’t see himself as a “stranger and a pilgrim” here on this earth and most likely he doesn’t believe in life eternal. But what about those of us who claim to be Christians, are we doing any better? Are we responding to each situation in fear or in faith?

All of this upheaval in our ‘normal’ way of life, has brought uncertainty. Uncertainty about jobs. Uncertainty about our future. Uncertainty about our families. Uncertainty about the end of time. And the list could go on with each person filling in the blanks for him or herself.

The Vaccines

The most recent issue of upheaval that is taking front stage both in our minds and in our conversations is that of the vaccine. Will it be “forced” upon us? Are there properties included in this new type of vaccine that will enable others to ‘track’ us and listen in to all our private conversations? Is it true that there is somehow a microchip, or a multitude of nano robots immersed in that small volume of liquid? Will this new technology that has been manufactured as a synthetic mRNA vaccine somehow change my DNA if I allow them to prick my skin? Is this vaccine the mark of the beast? All these, and more, are questions which I have been hearing with ever-increasing frequency and urgency.

Conspiracy Theories

The uncertainty of it all (the virus, the election, and the vaccine) has spawned many, many conspiracy theories. Usually, if there is a negative connotation surrounding something, then we tend to close ourselves to the possibility that we may be involved. “Surely, the ideas that I am passing on are not a conspiracy theory!”

Or are they? Let’s stop and think about this a minute. Conspiracy = a secret plan by a group to do something unlawful or harmful. Theory = a supposition or a system of ideas intended to explain something. Doesn’t this fit most of the allegations and claims that have been circulated among us? Almost every new ‘story’ will claim that ‘certain’ people are secretly involved in an all-encompassing agenda to use this certain negative issue of upheaval to bring about a specific negative change that will harm the masses. Most often these ‘stories’ are designed to play on our emotions, triggering a response rooted in fear, that is ultimately designed to protect myself from the alleged personal harm—that of being personally controlled by others, loss of personal rights, loss of personal privacy, etc., etc.

If we are honest about the actual definition of ‘conspiracy’ and of ‘theory’, then we would also need to admit that many, if not most, of the ‘stories’ that are spreading through the rumor-mill are indeed conspiracy theories. I am not suggesting that we bury our heads in the sand, or that we shouldn’t be a prepared people. I am simply cautioning against being sucked into the emotional rhetoric of the many ‘stories’ that are continually being promoted.

There are some questions we can ask ourselves that will help to sort through the confusion of all the various claims or allegations being made. Am I being asked to join the fight to protect the Constitution of the United States? Am I being advised to join others in standing up for our ‘rights’? If I stop and consider what’s happening in my heart, what is motivating me to action—Faith? or Fear? If there is any truth in that which is being alleged, is there anything that I can do about it?

Like I said before, we are facing unprecedented times. Let’s face our future with faith—our God is sovereignly in control. Let’s not lose sight of our future home in heaven—we are called to be strangers and pilgrims in this world. Let’s always remember the promises of God—that He will be with us always even unto the end of the world, and that He will NOT allow us to be tempted above that which we are able to bear. These promises and many, many more are clearly specified in the Scriptures.

The virus hits home

My (Curvin’s) family contracted the Covid-19 virus in the middle of October 2020. It affected each of our family members in slightly different ways, which was interesting to observe. One of the intriguing aspects was that most of us lost our sense of taste and smell. Most of our family didn’t suffer more than we normally would with the normal flu. However, my mother, who lives with us, ended up on the very verge of needing to be hospitalized due to low oxygen levels in her blood. Thankfully, this was averted through a doctor prescribing some potent drugs which had an almost immediate effect on reversing this.

For myself, I was so sick from the virus that I wasn’t able to work for over two months. The only thing that kept me out of the hospital was a daily intake of one restricted drug and double the recommended dose of steroids through nebulizer treatments. This went on for over six weeks. It is now almost two months since I finally started to recover and yet I am still not fully back to where I was prior to contracting Covid-19.

On a side note, we have included an article bringing recognition to the life of Mose Stoltzfus, an older brother from one of our sister churches who died after contracting Covid-19. Considering these two situations, I can say of a surety that the virus is real and not a hoax; that the virus affects everybody in slightly different ways; that some people have hardly any ill effects even though they do contract the virus; and that there are some who do become very ill indeed.

The Vaccine booklet

Back a number of issues we ran a number of articles written by a doctor on the whole issue of vaccines. Our goal was to try to present as balanced of a view as possible. We had numerous requests to have those articles compiled into a booklet format, which we had announced previously that we were planning to do. We encountered a number of practical issues that needed to be sorted through, which took time (much longer than we had anticipated). Finally, we have now arrived at the point of being ready to compile and publish this booklet.

If you want to receive one or more copies of this booklet, we ask that you contact us with your contact information and the number of booklets desired, even if you have previously done so. This will help us gauge the interest level to know how many we should print. We can be reached by mail, phone, or email, each of which can be found inside the front cover of each issue of our magazine, The Heartbeat of the Remnant.

Continued Changes

Over the last year or two we have pursued various ways of streamlining our production efforts. One of these, which we have mentioned before is that of working towards having multiple authors write articles for the various specific columns, such as the Children’s Corner, Sister to Sister, A Word from The Doctor, etc. One of the changes you will see is that we will have more than one doctor writing articles for the medical column.

Finances

As you will notice, we have included a financial report in this issue for the year of 2020. A year ago, we had made known through our annual newsletter that things were quite desperate for us financially and that we needed funds if we were going to keep going forward. The response was overwhelming, and we have been blessed by all who decided to partner with us in this need. However, as you can see by the financial report, there is a need for continued financial support since our expenses are ongoing. For those of you who are actively involved in this way, we say thank you and may God richly bless your generosity.

A Point of Interest

The children’s story in this issue of the magazine holds special interest for me. While the details of the story may not all be according to fact, there was a John M. and Catharine Kurtz family that lost five children in infancy and then years later they lost six children to diphtheria. Only John S. Kurtz survived, but was joined by two younger siblings later on. John was ordained to the ministry at the age of 27 and married Maria Horning almost two years later.

John S. and Maria (Horning) Kurtz were my great, great grandparents. So, that line of my ancestry can be traced back through the time of another pandemic and tremendous upheaval in people’s lives, through that of the only surviving child out of a family of 12. For me, this brings personal interest and perspective to some of the situations we are facing today.

May God bless and keep each one. As the world becomes ever darker and more chaotic, let us as Christians draw ever closer to our Lord. In this, He has given a command containing a promise for each of us to: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded –James 4:8.

Curvin L Wenger

그리스도인의 사랑으로 여러분 한 분 한 분께 문안드립니다. 여러분이 그리스도를 영혼의 닻이자 어려움의 해결책으로 발견하셨기를 바랍니다. 또 한 해가 지나갔습니다. 참으로 많은 일이 있었던 한 해였습니다… 눈에 보이지 않는 바이러스가 온 세계를 에워싸고, 제3세계 국가들부터 가장 발전하고 산업화된 국가들에 이르기까지 문화를 뒤흔들었습니다. 세계 지도자들은 팬데믹이 계속 심화되고 자국 경제가 계속 곤두박질치는 가운데 서로를 비난했습니다. 교회들은 사회적 거리 두기, 마스크 착용, 모임 규모 제한에 관한 각 정부의 명령 한가운데서 연합을 지키려고 애썼습니다.

많은 사람에게 2020년은 이전에 정상이라고 여겨졌던 것을 무너뜨리거나 크게 바꾸어 놓았으며, 새로운 규범을 만들어 내기 시작했습니다. 많은 것이 다시는 예전 같지 않을지도 모릅니다. ‘6피트’는 널리 알려진 측정 단위가 되었습니다. 기침 소리가 들리면 들을 수 있는 거리에 있는 사람들이 시선을 돌립니다. 마스크 착용은 농담과 장단점에 관한 끝없는 논쟁의 초점이 되었습니다.

이 모든 일을 겪는 동안 많은 사람이 여러 방식으로 고통을 겪었습니다. 무엇보다도, 우리 주변 사람들에게 일어나고 있는 영적 여파를 우리가 생각해 보았는지 궁금합니다.

지역 교회가 대면 예배를 완전히 중단했을 때 교제의 상실을 견디지 못한 사람들이 있었다는 이야기를 많이 들었습니다. 어떤 이들은 말없이 속을 태우며 기독교에 점점 더 환멸을 느꼈습니다. 다른 이들은 이것이 ‘낙타의 등을 부러뜨린 마지막 지푸라기’라고 여기고 행동에 나서, 이전 교회를 떠나 자신의 견해를 더 지지하는 새로운 단체에 합류했습니다. 그러나 “사람보다 하나님께 순종하기”를 택하고 조용히 모여 예배를 계속한 교회도 많았습니다.

위기에 처한 양심

이 문제 하나만으로도(정부가 교회에 언제 어떻게 예배할지를 지시하는 것) 많은 교회에서 상당한 논의와 혼란, 심지어 분열이 일어났습니다. 우리는 전례 없는 시대를 맞고 있습니다. 우리 대부분은 분명한 결정을 내리는 데 도움이 될 만한 과거의 경험이 없습니다. 어떤 그리스도인들은 ‘시민 당국에 불순종’하는 동안 양심의 평안을 누릴 수 없고, 또 다른 그리스도인들은 ‘함께 모이는 일을 저버리는’ 동안 양심의 평안을 누릴 수 없습니다. 어쩐지 정부가 교회의 일상에 이렇게 “개입”하는 것은 아무래도 옳지 않은 것처럼 느껴집니다.

1600년대와 1700년대에 우리의 아나뱁티스트 선조들은 양심의 인도에 따라 자유롭게 예배할 수 있는 새 터전을 찾아 유럽에서 외국으로 이주했습니다. 그 이래로 미국에서 살아가는 데 중요한 요소 가운데 하나는 “교회와 국가의 분리”였습니다. 그러므로 보수적인 아나뱁티스트인 우리는 지방정부, 주정부 또는 연방정부가 우리에게 요구한 것을 불확실함과 염려 속에서 숙고해 왔습니다. 제가 매우 감사하게 여기는 한 가지는 우리 지역 교제의 지도자들이 이 기간 내내 다음과 같이 매우 강하게 권면해 왔다는 것입니다. “우리에게 닥치는 새로운 도전 하나하나를 헤쳐 나갈 때, 우리는 언제나 생각과 말과 행동으로 시민 당국을 경건하게 존중해야 합니다.” 특히 “사람보다 하나님께 순종해야” 할 필요가 있다고 판단되는 경우에는 더욱 그렇습니다.

2020년 말 미국 선거도 또 하나의 주요한 우려 사항이었습니다. 어쩐지 이 나라는 지난 4년 동안 점점 더 양극화되어 왔습니다(어쩌면 그보다 더 오래되었을지도 모릅니다). 세상에 속한 한 남자가 트럼프가 선거에서 이기지 못하면 더는 살아갈 희망이 보이지 않는다며, 그냥 스스로 목숨을 끊고 모든 것을 끝내야 할지 생각하고 있다는 이야기를 들었습니다. 물론 세상에 속한 사람은 아마 자신을 이 땅의 “나그네와 순례자”로 여기지 않고 영원한 생명을 믿지 않을 것이므로 더 나은 내세에 대한 소망이 없을지도 모릅니다. 하지만 그리스도인이라고 고백하는 우리들은 어떻습니까? 우리는 더 나은 모습을 보이고 있습니까? 각 상황에 두려움으로 반응하고 있습니까, 믿음으로 반응하고 있습니까?

우리의 ‘평범한’ 삶의 방식에 일어난 이 모든 격변은 불확실함을 가져왔습니다. 직업에 대한 불확실함. 우리의 미래에 대한 불확실함. 가족에 대한 불확실함. 세상 끝에 대한 불확실함. 각자가 빈칸을 채운다면 목록은 계속 이어질 수 있습니다.

백신

최근 우리의 생각과 대화에서 가장 큰 자리를 차지하는 격변의 문제는 백신입니다. 백신이 우리에게 “강제로” 접종될까요? 이 새로운 유형의 백신에는 다른 사람들이 우리를 ‘추적’하고 우리의 사적인 대화를 모두 엿들을 수 있게 하는 성분이 들어 있습니까? 이 적은 양의 액체 속에 마이크로칩이나 수많은 나노 로봇이 들어 있다는 것이 사실입니까? 합성 mRNA 백신으로 만들어진 이 신기술이 우리가 피부에 주사를 맞도록 허용하면 어떻게든 DNA를 바꿀까요? 이 백신은 짐승의 표입니까? 이런 질문들을 비롯한 여러 질문을 저는 점점 더 자주, 더 절박하게 들어 왔습니다.

음모론

이 모든 것(바이러스, 선거, 백신)을 둘러싼 불확실함은 수많은 음모론을 낳았습니다. 대개 어떤 것에 부정적인 함의가 따라붙으면 우리는 자신이 거기에 연루되었을 가능성을 외면하는 경향이 있습니다. “내가 전하는 생각들이 음모론일 리가 없지!”

정말 그럴까요? 잠시 멈추어 이 문제를 생각해 봅시다. 음모란 한 집단이 불법적이거나 해로운 일을 하려고 세우는 비밀 계획입니다. 이론이란 어떤 것을 설명하기 위한 가정이나 사상 체계입니다. 이것이 우리 사이에 퍼진 대부분의 주장과 의혹에 들어맞지 않습니까? 거의 모든 새로운 ‘이야기’는 ‘특정한’ 사람들이 은밀히 포괄적인 의도를 가지고 이 특정한 부정적 격변을 이용해 대중에게 해를 끼칠 구체적인 부정적 변화를 일으키려 한다고 주장합니다. 대개 이런 ‘이야기’는 우리의 감정을 자극하고 두려움에 뿌리를 둔 반응을 불러일으키도록 만들어집니다. 궁극적으로는 주장된 개인적 피해, 즉 다른 사람에게 개인적으로 통제당하는 것, 개인의 권리를 잃는 것, 사생활을 침해당하는 것 등을 막으려는 반응입니다.

‘음모’와 ‘이론’의 실제 정의를 정직하게 살펴본다면, 소문 속에서 퍼져 나가는 ‘이야기’의 상당수, 어쩌면 대부분이 실제로 음모론이라는 점도 인정해야 할 것입니다. 저는 우리가 현실을 외면하거나 준비되지 않은 사람들이 되어야 한다고 말하는 것이 아닙니다. 계속해서 유포되는 수많은 ‘이야기’의 감정적 수사에 휩쓸리지 않도록 경계하자는 것뿐입니다.

온갖 주장과 의혹이 빚어내는 혼란을 가려내는 데 도움이 될 몇 가지 질문을 스스로에게 해 볼 수 있습니다. 미국 헌법을 수호하는 투쟁에 동참하라는 요청을 받고 있습니까? 우리의 ‘권리’를 지키기 위해 다른 사람들과 함께 나서라는 권고를 받고 있습니까? 멈추어 내 마음속에서 일어나는 일을 살펴본다면, 나를 행동하게 하는 것은 무엇입니까? 믿음입니까, 두려움입니까? 주장된 내용에 조금이라도 진실이 있다면, 제가 그것에 대해 할 수 있는 일이 있습니까?

앞서 말했듯이 우리는 전례 없는 시대를 맞고 있습니다. 우리의 하나님께서 주권적으로 다스리신다는 믿음으로 미래를 맞이합시다. 하늘에 있는 우리의 미래의 집을 놓치지 맙시다. 우리는 이 세상에서 나그네와 순례자로 부름받았습니다. 하나님의 약속을 늘 기억합시다. 그분은 세상 끝날까지 언제나 우리와 함께하시며, 우리가 감당할 수 있는 것 이상으로 시험받도록 허락하지 않으실 것입니다. 이러한 약속과 더 많은 약속이 성경에 분명히 기록되어 있습니다.

바이러스가 우리 가족에게 닥치다

저(커빈)의 가족은 2020년 10월 중순에 코로나19 바이러스에 감염되었습니다. 가족 구성원마다 조금씩 다르게 영향을 받은 것을 관찰하는 일은 흥미로웠습니다. 흥미로운 점 하나는 우리 대부분이 미각과 후각을 잃었다는 것입니다. 우리 가족 대부분은 보통 독감에 걸렸을 때보다 더 심하게 앓지는 않았습니다. 그러나 우리와 함께 사는 어머니는 혈중 산소 수치가 낮아 입원해야 할 지경에 이르렀습니다. 다행히 의사가 강력한 약을 처방했고, 거의 즉각적으로 상태가 호전되어 이를 피할 수 있었습니다.

저는 바이러스에 너무 심하게 앓아 두 달 넘게 일을 할 수 없었습니다. 저를 입원하지 않게 해 준 것은 사용이 제한된 약 한 가지를 매일 복용하고, 분무기 치료로 권장량의 두 배에 해당하는 스테로이드를 투여한 것뿐이었습니다. 이 치료는 6주 넘게 계속되었습니다. 제가 마침내 회복하기 시작한 지 이제 거의 두 달이 되었지만, 코로나19에 걸리기 전의 상태로 완전히 돌아오지는 못했습니다.

덧붙이자면, 이번 호에는 코로나19에 감염된 뒤 사망한 자매 교회 중 한 곳의 연로한 형제 모스 스톨츠퍼스의 삶을 기리는 글을 실었습니다. 이 두 가지 일을 생각할 때, 저는 바이러스가 실재하며 사기가 아니라는 점, 바이러스가 사람마다 조금씩 다르게 영향을 준다는 점, 감염되더라도 거의 아무런 부작용을 겪지 않는 사람도 있다는 점, 그리고 실제로 매우 심하게 앓는 사람도 있다는 점을 확실히 말씀드릴 수 있습니다.

백신 소책자

몇 호 전에 백신 전반에 관한 의사의 글을 여러 편 실었습니다. 가능한 한 균형 잡힌 견해를 제시하는 것이 우리의 목표였습니다. 그 글들을 소책자 형태로 엮어 달라는 요청이 많이 있었고, 이전에 그렇게 할 계획이라고 알린 바 있습니다. 처리해야 할 여러 현실적인 문제가 생겨 시간이 걸렸습니다(예상보다 훨씬 오래 걸렸습니다). 마침내 이제 이 소책자를 엮어 출판할 준비가 되었습니다.

이 소책자를 한 부 이상 받기 원하시면, 이전에 이미 알려 주셨더라도 연락처와 필요한 소책자 수를 알려 주시기 바랍니다. 그러면 관심이 어느 정도인지 파악해 인쇄 부수를 정하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 저희 잡지 남은 자들의 심장 박동 각 호의 앞표지 안쪽에서 우편 주소, 전화번호, 이메일 주소를 확인하실 수 있습니다.

계속되는 변화

지난 1~2년 동안 저희는 제작 작업을 간소화할 여러 방법을 모색해 왔습니다. 앞서 언급한 방법 중 하나는 어린이 코너, 자매에게 보내는 편지, 의사의 한마디 등 특정한 여러 코너의 글을 여러 필자가 쓰도록 하는 것입니다. 여러분이 보게 될 변화 가운데 하나는 의학 칼럼에 한 명이 아니라 여러 의사가 글을 쓰게 된다는 점입니다.

재정

아시겠지만, 이번 호에는 2020년 재정보고서를 실었습니다. 1년 전 저희는 연례 소식지를 통해 재정 상황이 매우 절박하며 계속 이어 가려면 자금이 필요하다고 알렸습니다. 많은 분이 응답해 주셨고, 이 필요를 함께 감당하기로 한 모든 분의 도움에 큰 복을 받았습니다. 그러나 재정보고서에서 보시듯 지출은 계속 발생하므로 지속적인 재정 지원이 필요합니다. 이 일에 적극적으로 참여해 주시는 분들께 감사드리며, 여러분의 너그러운 나눔에 하나님께서 풍성히 복 주시기를 바랍니다.

흥미로운 이야기

이번 호 잡지에 실린 어린이 이야기는 제게 특별히 흥미롭습니다. 이야기의 세부 내용이 모두 사실과 일치하지 않을 수도 있지만, 존 M.과 캐서린 커츠 부부에게는 영아기에 다섯 자녀를 잃고, 몇 년 뒤에는 디프테리아로 여섯 자녀를 잃은 일이 있었습니다. 존 S. 커츠만 살아남았으며, 그 후 어린 동생 둘이 태어났습니다. 존은 27세에 목회자로 안수받았고, 거의 2년 뒤 마리아 호닝과 결혼했습니다.

존 S.와 마리아(호닝) 커츠는 제 고조부모입니다. 그러므로 제 가계의 한 갈래는 또 다른 팬데믹과 사람들의 삶에 닥친 엄청난 격변의 시기로 거슬러 올라가며, 12명으로 이루어진 가족 가운데 유일하게 살아남은 자녀에게까지 이어집니다. 이 점은 오늘날 우리가 마주하는 몇몇 상황을 개인적으로 흥미롭게 바라보고 이해하는 관점을 제게 줍니다.

하나님께서 여러분 한 분 한 분을 복 주시고 지켜 주시기를 바랍니다. 세상이 점점 더 어둡고 혼란스러워질수록, 그리스도인인 우리는 주님께 더욱 가까이 나아갑시다. 주님께서는 우리 각자에게 약속이 담긴 명령을 주셨습니다. 하나님께 가까이 나아가십시오. 그러면 하나님께서 여러분에게 가까이 오실 것입니다. 죄인들이여, 손을 깨끗이 하고, 두 마음을 품은 사람들이여, 마음을 정결하게 하십시오 –야고보서 4:8.

커빈 L. 웽거
