Editor’s Note:

Normally, we haven’t used our magazine to bring focus to any specific individual. However, in regard to Mose, we felt it would be fitting to provide a small tribute. Mose was instrumental in helping to get The Heartbeat of the Remnant magazine started way back over twenty years ago when it was first begun. Then years later when several churches divided some of the various aspects of ministry between themselves, Ephrata Christian Fellowship with Mose as one of its leaders, took on the publishing of the magazine as their own effort. They continued this for a number of years until it eventually went out of print temporarily due to their editors moving out of the area. Fast forward to 2016, when we (The Berean Voice) wanted to begin publishing a newsletter/magazine. When Mose realized what we were about to do, he requested that we take over the publication of their magazine since he and his fellow laborers wished to see it continue in print. In short, this is how we ended up publishing a magazine that had originally been published by another church in another state. Thus, it seems fitting to give recognition to the life Mose has lived and the path he has endeavored to blaze for others. It is with gratefulness that we remember the life and example Mose has left us with. And it is with humility that we will persevere in our efforts to keep this torch (the magazine) burning for Truth.

Mose S. Stoltzfus entered into his eternal rest on December 6, 2020, following a brief battle with Covid-19. The testimony of his life was that of a race well run, leaving a legacy of godly faithfulness to the end which others can follow. Brother Mose, as he was often referred to by his church brethren, will be greatly missed. Family, friends, business associates, and church brethren remember with gratitude how his life was a blessing to them. Most of all, he will be missed by his beloved wife, Rhoda.

Mose grew up in a home where he was taught the “fear of the Lord” and had a new birth into the Kingdom of God at the age of 15. This was the beginning of his love for God and His Word, the Holy Scriptures. This was a love which he pursued for the rest of his life, and which in time enabled him to be mighty in word and deed.

It has been my privilege to have known Brother Mose for nearly 30 years. Most of the fellowship we had together was related to the work of the Church, and of the Kingdom of God. What I want to share here concerning Brother Mose is largely related to his ministry in the Gospel.

One of the prominent gifts the Lord gave to Brother Mose was the gift of preaching. It was a gift that he pursued with zeal, not by constraint, but willingly. Whether it was just a few gathered in a living room or hundreds gathered in a community hall, he loved to preach the Gospel of Jesus Christ. He often preached to men and women who had troubled souls and were seeking a Savior. He preached to small assemblies of believers where new churches were beginning, helping them to be established in the faith. He preached in large churches and fellowship gatherings of saints encouraging and exhorting them to follow Christ.

Those who were around Brother Mose during his years of ministry know that he loved singing. He encouraged believers to open their mouth and praise the Lord in song, both individually and in the church assembly. Between 2010 and 2015, he took a small choir with him on several trips to Canada, singing and preaching as they visited various churches. He also made at least two trips to Germany during those years as well. The choir of youth that traveled with him would sing, and then he would preach in the German language. They visited about a dozen churches over the course of each three-week trip. On one trip, they also included a stop in a city for street witnessing and passing out tracts. Here again, Brother Mose preached in the German language to those under the sound of his voice.

When I consider the spirit and zeal of Brother Mose, the words of the Apostle Paul to the Romans seem very fitting: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise. So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also –Romans 1:14-15. Brother Mose saw himself as a debtor to make Christ known to many and was ready to preach wherever there was an open door. His ‘Rome’ was across America, Canada, and beyond. He was …not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: boldly proclaiming it to be …the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek –Romans 1:16.

For nearly two decades, from the late 1980’s and onward, Brother Mose frequently teamed up with Denny Kenaston, and they would travel to communities where they had an invitation to preach. Often, this would be a weekend event, starting Friday evening, going all day Saturday, and Sunday morning and afternoon. Sometimes it was a whole week or more of evening messages. One of them would preach one night, and the other the next night throughout the week. With much unction from the Holy One, they would preach the Gospel. There are many testimonies of new conversions, of repentance from sin, of revival, and of straying souls returning to the Savior.

Brother Mose sought the lost from any background and any place where they would come to listen. He even preached on city streets to those who never went to church. When he held meetings, many evangelical, protestant denominations were represented in those who came to hear him preach. But it was the various conservative, Anabaptist groups toward which his heart was especially drawn, since this was his own background. His specific concern was regarding those who had backslidden or strayed from the way of Truth. Whether those he encountered were Mennonite, Amish, or Hutterite, he could relate to their background and was well versed in the history of each group. He was able to preach in a powerful way to expose sin and error, while warning of judgment to come. He preached the cross of Christ as the hope of salvation to all who would believe.

Another gift Brother Mose had was in speaking with individuals one-on-one. It could be a middle-aged person on a hospital bed, a youth in a living room, or a young adult who had responded to the Holy Spirit’s moving after a preaching service. He had a way of gently asking them about the needs in their life, and then explaining clearly what needed to be done in order for them to be reconciled to God.

Throughout his ministry, Brother Mose labored much to establish churches on a right foundation. He was directly involved in the formation of a number of new churches, as well as advising and helping already established groups. He ordained men for the ministry in many churches, often with the assistance of elders from his own fellowship or those of a sister church. Issues such as brotherhood, unity, and proper leadership were important to him.

Brother Mose was often the watchman on the wall for the church in this generation. He would frequently warn against false doctrines that threatened to creep into churches. He was on guard against false teachers, false prophets, and even false brethren. In the face of these dangers to the church, he gave much attention to teaching sound doctrine. The Word of God was lifted up as the safe and sure foundation by which to judge what is true and what is false.

Brother Mose was a true leader. He led by direct action and by example. One thing that seemed to make him restless in spirit was to observe a situation where there was lack of leadership, for want of a man to stand in the gap. He was ready to step forward and serve when occasion called for it. But even as a strong leader, he surrounded himself with men who would labor with him. Throughout his years of ministry, he worked as a member of the body. Many of his preaching events across the country would be with fellow ministers preaching alongside him. When dealing with church problems, he would frequently seek out the council of fellow ministers. In the last handful of years, he was actively involved in the annual ministers’ meetings held in Indiana as the “Agape Christian Fellowship” group was being formulated and established. He would express, sometimes with tears, his rejoicing in the fellowship and council of his brethren who were laboring with him for the welfare of the various churches represented. There was also humility of mind in looking back over the years at those things that should have been done differently, whether errors or omissions, and acknowledging them as such. His passion was to see the church endure faithful unto the end.

And now Brother Mose has entered into his eternal rest. To those of us who knew him and labored with him remains the responsibility of carrying on the work of the Kingdom until Christ returns for His Church. May we be found of Him in peace, without spot and blameless.

Redaktörens anmärkning:

Normalt har vi inte använt vår tidskrift för att rikta uppmärksamheten mot någon särskild person. När det gäller Mose tyckte vi dock att det skulle vara passande att ge en liten hyllning. Mose spelade en avgörande roll när tidskriften The Heartbeat of the Remnant startades för mer än tjugo år sedan. Flera år senare, när några församlingar fördelade olika delar av verksamheten mellan sig, tog Ephrata Christian Fellowship, med Mose som en av sina ledare, på sig att ge ut tidskriften som sitt eget arbete. De fortsatte med detta i ett antal år, tills den till slut tillfälligt upphörde att komma ut eftersom redaktörerna flyttade från området. Spola fram till 2016, då vi (The Berean Voice) ville börja ge ut ett nyhetsbrev/en tidskrift. När Mose förstod vad vi var på väg att göra bad han oss ta över utgivningen av deras tidskrift, eftersom han och hans medarbetare ville se den fortsätta att komma ut. Kort sagt är det så vi kom att ge ut en tidskrift som ursprungligen hade getts ut av en annan församling i en annan delstat. Därför känns det passande att uppmärksamma det liv Mose levde och den väg han försökte bana för andra. Det är med tacksamhet vi minns det liv och det föredöme Mose lämnat efter sig. Och det är med ödmjukhet vi kommer att fortsätta våra ansträngningar för att hålla denna fackla (tidskriften) brinnande för Sanningen.

Mose S. Stoltzfus gick in i sin eviga vila den 6 december 2020 efter en kort tids kamp mot covid-19. Hans liv vittnade om ett väl fullbordat lopp och lämnade efter sig ett arv av gudfruktig trofasthet ända till slutet, som andra kan följa. Broder Mose, som han ofta kallades av sina församlingsbröder, kommer att vara mycket saknad. Familj, vänner, affärsbekanta och församlingsbröder minns med tacksamhet hur hans liv var till välsignelse för dem. Mest av allt kommer hans älskade hustru Rhoda att sakna honom.

Mose växte upp i ett hem där han fick lära sig att ”frukta Herren” och föddes på nytt in i Guds rike när han var 15 år. Där började hans kärlek till Gud och hans ord, den heliga Skrift. Denna kärlek följde han resten av sitt liv, och med tiden gjorde den honom mäktig i ord och gärning.

Det har varit ett privilegium för mig att ha känt broder Mose i nästan 30 år. Det mesta av vår gemenskap handlade om församlingens och Guds rikes verk. Det jag här vill berätta om broder Mose har till stor del att göra med hans tjänst i evangeliet.

En av de framträdande gåvor Herren gav broder Mose var predikans gåva. Han ivrade för denna gåva, inte av tvång utan villigt. Oavsett om det bara var några få som samlats i ett vardagsrum eller hundratals i en samlingslokal, älskade han att predika Jesu Kristi evangelium. Han predikade ofta för män och kvinnor med oroliga själar som sökte en Frälsare. Han predikade för små grupper av troende på platser där nya församlingar höll på att grundas och hjälpte dem att bli stadiga i tron. Han predikade i stora församlingar och vid de troendes samlingar och uppmuntrade och förmanade dem att följa Kristus.

De som umgicks med broder Mose under hans år i tjänst vet att han älskade att sjunga. Han uppmuntrade de troende att öppna munnen och lovsjunga Herren, både enskilt och när församlingen samlades. Mellan 2010 och 2015 tog han med sig en liten kör på flera resor till Kanada, där de sjöng och predikade när de besökte olika församlingar. Under dessa år gjorde han också minst två resor till Tyskland. Ungdomskören som reste med honom sjöng, och sedan predikade han på tyska. Under var och en av de tre veckor långa resorna besökte de omkring ett dussin församlingar. På en av resorna gjorde de också ett uppehåll i en stad för att vittna på gatorna och dela ut traktater. Även där predikade broder Mose på tyska för dem som hörde hans röst.

När jag tänker på broder Moses anda och iver känns aposteln Paulus ord till romarna mycket passande: Jag står i skuld både till greker och barbarer, både till visa och ovisa. Därför är jag, så långt det beror på mig, redo att förkunna evangeliet också för er i Rom – Romarbrevet 1:14-15. Broder Mose såg sig stå i skuld att göra Kristus känd för många och var redo att predika därhelst en dörr stod öppen. Hans ”Rom” fanns över hela Amerika, i Kanada och ännu längre bort. Han var …inte skamsen för Kristi evangelium: och förkunnade frimodigt att det är …Guds kraft till frälsning för var och en som tror, först juden och sedan greken – Romarbrevet 1:16.

I nästan två decennier, från slutet av 1980-talet och framåt, samarbetade broder Mose ofta med Denny Kenaston. De reste till orter där de hade blivit inbjudna att predika. Ofta var det ett evenemang över en helg, med start fredag kväll och sedan hela lördagen samt söndag förmiddag och eftermiddag. Ibland pågick det en hel vecka eller längre med kvällsmöten. Den ene predikade en kväll och den andre nästa kväll under veckan. Med stor smörjelse från den Helige predikade de evangeliet. Det finns många vittnesbörd om människor som kommit till tro, om omvändelse från synd, väckelse och vilsegångna själar som återvänt till Frälsaren.

Broder Mose sökte de förlorade oavsett bakgrund och på varje plats där de ville komma och lyssna. Han predikade till och med på stadens gator för dem som aldrig gick i kyrkan. När han höll möten fanns det många evangeliska, protestantiska samfund representerade bland dem som kom för att höra honom predika. Men hans hjärta drogs särskilt till de olika konservativa anabaptistiska grupperna, eftersom det var hans egen bakgrund. Han var särskilt bekymrad för dem som hade avfallit eller kommit bort från Sanningens väg. Oavsett om de han mötte var mennoniter, amish eller hutteriter kunde han relatera till deras bakgrund och var väl insatt i varje grupps historia. Han kunde predika med kraft för att blottlägga synd och villfarelse och samtidigt varna för den kommande domen. Han predikade Kristi kors som frälsningens hopp för alla som ville tro.

En annan gåva broder Mose hade var förmågan att tala med människor enskilt. Det kunde vara en medelålders person i en sjukhussäng, en ungdom i ett vardagsrum eller en ung vuxen som hade svarat på den helige Andes verkan efter en predikan. Han hade ett sätt att varsamt fråga dem om behoven i deras liv och sedan tydligt förklara vad de behövde göra för att bli försonade med Gud.

Under hela sin tjänst arbetade broder Mose hårt för att grundlägga församlingar på en rätt grund. Han var direkt delaktig i bildandet av ett antal nya församlingar och gav också råd och hjälp åt redan etablerade grupper. Han ordinerade män till tjänst i många församlingar, ofta med hjälp av äldste från den gemenskap han själv tillhörde eller från en systerförsamling. Frågor som brödragemenskap, enhet och ett gott ledarskap var viktiga för honom.

Broder Mose var ofta en väktare på muren för församlingen i denna generation. Han varnade ofta för falska läror som hotade att smyga sig in i församlingarna. Han var på sin vakt mot falska lärare, falska profeter och till och med falska bröder. Inför dessa faror för församlingen ägnade han stor uppmärksamhet åt att undervisa om sund lära. Guds ord lyftes fram som den trygga och säkra grund utifrån vilken man kunde bedöma vad som är sant och vad som är falskt.

Broder Mose var en verklig ledare. Han ledde genom att själv handla och genom sitt föredöme. Något som tycktes göra honom orolig till sinnes var att se en situation där ledarskap saknades därför att ingen man stod i gapet. Han var redo att träda fram och tjäna när tillfället krävde det. Men även som en stark ledare omgav han sig med män som arbetade tillsammans med honom. Under alla sina år i tjänst verkade han som en del av kroppen. Vid många av hans predikoevenemang runt om i landet predikade andra förkunnare tillsammans med honom. När han hanterade problem i församlingarna sökte han ofta råd hos andra förkunnare. Under de senaste åren var han aktivt engagerad i de årliga predikantmöten som hölls i Indiana, medan gruppen ”Agape Christian Fellowship” formades och etablerades. Ibland uttryckte han med tårar sin glädje över gemenskapen och rådslagen med sina bröder, som tillsammans med honom arbetade för de olika församlingarnas väl. Han visade också ödmjukhet när han såg tillbaka på åren och tänkte på sådant som borde ha gjorts annorlunda, vare sig det handlade om misstag eller försummelser, och erkände det. Hans brinnande önskan var att församlingen skulle hålla ut trofast ända till slutet.

Och nu har broder Mose gått in i sin eviga vila. För oss som kände honom och arbetade tillsammans med honom återstår ansvaret att fortsätta arbetet i Guds rike tills Kristus kommer tillbaka för sin församling. Må vi befinnas av honom i frid, utan fläck och oklanderliga.

Greetings of Christian love to each one. Hopefully, you have found Christ as the anchor for your soul and the solution to your difficulties. Another year is past and gone, and what a year it was… An unseen virus encircling the world, unsettling cultures from third-world countries to the most advanced and industrialized. World leaders blaming each other for the ever-increasing pandemic as their country’s economies continued to spiral downward. And churches struggling to maintain unity in the midst of their various government’s mandates regarding social distancing, mask wearing, and limits on the size of gatherings.

For many, the year 2020 has destroyed or radically altered that which used to be considered normal and has begun establishing new norms and many things may never be the same again. ‘Six feet’ has become a well-recognized unit of measurement. The sound of coughing draws glances from those within hearing distance. Mask wearing has become the focus of jokes and endless arguments regarding the pros and cons.

Through it all, many have suffered in various ways. Most importantly, I wonder if we have considered the spiritual fallout happening to those around us?

I have heard numerous reports of folks who couldn’t handle the loss of fellowship when their local church completely stopped having in-person worship services. Some silently pined away, growing increasingly disillusioned with Christianity. Others, deciding this was ‘the straw that broke their camel’s back’, took action and left their old church, then joined a new group that was more supportive of their views. There were, however, many churches that chose to “obey God rather than man” and continued to quietly meet for worship.

Conscience in Crisis

This issue alone (governments telling churches how and when to worship) has been the cause of much discussion, disorder, and even dissension in many churches. We are facing unprecedented times. For most of us, we don’t have any experience in our past to fall back on which will help us make a clear decision. Some Christians’ consciences will not allow them peace while ‘disobeying the civil authorities’, while other Christians’ consciences will not allow them peace while ‘forsaking the assembling of themselves together’. Somehow, this “intrusion” of government into the everyday life of the church just hasn’t seemed quite right.

During the 1600s and the 1700s, our Anabaptist forefathers emigrated from Europe to foreign countries in search of a new home where they were free to worship as their conscience directed. Ever since, one of the key aspects of living in America has been that of the “separation of church and state”. So, it was with uncertainty and trepidation that we, conservative Anabaptists, have considered that which our local, state, or federal governments have asked of us. One thing that I am extremely grateful for is that the leaders of our local fellowship have maintained very strong admonishment throughout this time, that: “As we sort through each new challenge that comes our way, we must ALWAYS exhibit a godly respect (in thought, in word, and in action) for our civil authorities”, especially if we find it necessary to “obey God rather than man”.

Another major point of concern was that of the United States elections at the end of 2020. Somehow, this country has become more and more polarized over the last four years, (maybe it has been longer). I heard a report of one man from the world who said that if Trump doesn’t win the election then he sees no hope to continue living and he is contemplating whether he should just take his own life and end it all. Sure, a man of the world may not have the hope of a better life to come since he probably doesn’t see himself as a “stranger and a pilgrim” here on this earth and most likely he doesn’t believe in life eternal. But what about those of us who claim to be Christians, are we doing any better? Are we responding to each situation in fear or in faith?

All of this upheaval in our ‘normal’ way of life, has brought uncertainty. Uncertainty about jobs. Uncertainty about our future. Uncertainty about our families. Uncertainty about the end of time. And the list could go on with each person filling in the blanks for him or herself.

The Vaccines

The most recent issue of upheaval that is taking front stage both in our minds and in our conversations is that of the vaccine. Will it be “forced” upon us? Are there properties included in this new type of vaccine that will enable others to ‘track’ us and listen in to all our private conversations? Is it true that there is somehow a microchip, or a multitude of nano robots immersed in that small volume of liquid? Will this new technology that has been manufactured as a synthetic mRNA vaccine somehow change my DNA if I allow them to prick my skin? Is this vaccine the mark of the beast? All these, and more, are questions which I have been hearing with ever-increasing frequency and urgency.

Conspiracy Theories

The uncertainty of it all (the virus, the election, and the vaccine) has spawned many, many conspiracy theories. Usually, if there is a negative connotation surrounding something, then we tend to close ourselves to the possibility that we may be involved. “Surely, the ideas that I am passing on are not a conspiracy theory!”

Or are they? Let’s stop and think about this a minute. Conspiracy = a secret plan by a group to do something unlawful or harmful. Theory = a supposition or a system of ideas intended to explain something. Doesn’t this fit most of the allegations and claims that have been circulated among us? Almost every new ‘story’ will claim that ‘certain’ people are secretly involved in an all-encompassing agenda to use this certain negative issue of upheaval to bring about a specific negative change that will harm the masses. Most often these ‘stories’ are designed to play on our emotions, triggering a response rooted in fear, that is ultimately designed to protect myself from the alleged personal harm—that of being personally controlled by others, loss of personal rights, loss of personal privacy, etc., etc.

If we are honest about the actual definition of ‘conspiracy’ and of ‘theory’, then we would also need to admit that many, if not most, of the ‘stories’ that are spreading through the rumor-mill are indeed conspiracy theories. I am not suggesting that we bury our heads in the sand, or that we shouldn’t be a prepared people. I am simply cautioning against being sucked into the emotional rhetoric of the many ‘stories’ that are continually being promoted.

There are some questions we can ask ourselves that will help to sort through the confusion of all the various claims or allegations being made. Am I being asked to join the fight to protect the Constitution of the United States? Am I being advised to join others in standing up for our ‘rights’? If I stop and consider what’s happening in my heart, what is motivating me to action—Faith? or Fear? If there is any truth in that which is being alleged, is there anything that I can do about it?

Like I said before, we are facing unprecedented times. Let’s face our future with faith—our God is sovereignly in control. Let’s not lose sight of our future home in heaven—we are called to be strangers and pilgrims in this world. Let’s always remember the promises of God—that He will be with us always even unto the end of the world, and that He will NOT allow us to be tempted above that which we are able to bear. These promises and many, many more are clearly specified in the Scriptures.

The virus hits home

My (Curvin’s) family contracted the Covid-19 virus in the middle of October 2020. It affected each of our family members in slightly different ways, which was interesting to observe. One of the intriguing aspects was that most of us lost our sense of taste and smell. Most of our family didn’t suffer more than we normally would with the normal flu. However, my mother, who lives with us, ended up on the very verge of needing to be hospitalized due to low oxygen levels in her blood. Thankfully, this was averted through a doctor prescribing some potent drugs which had an almost immediate effect on reversing this.

For myself, I was so sick from the virus that I wasn’t able to work for over two months. The only thing that kept me out of the hospital was a daily intake of one restricted drug and double the recommended dose of steroids through nebulizer treatments. This went on for over six weeks. It is now almost two months since I finally started to recover and yet I am still not fully back to where I was prior to contracting Covid-19.

On a side note, we have included an article bringing recognition to the life of Mose Stoltzfus, an older brother from one of our sister churches who died after contracting Covid-19. Considering these two situations, I can say of a surety that the virus is real and not a hoax; that the virus affects everybody in slightly different ways; that some people have hardly any ill effects even though they do contract the virus; and that there are some who do become very ill indeed.

The Vaccine booklet

Back a number of issues we ran a number of articles written by a doctor on the whole issue of vaccines. Our goal was to try to present as balanced of a view as possible. We had numerous requests to have those articles compiled into a booklet format, which we had announced previously that we were planning to do. We encountered a number of practical issues that needed to be sorted through, which took time (much longer than we had anticipated). Finally, we have now arrived at the point of being ready to compile and publish this booklet.

If you want to receive one or more copies of this booklet, we ask that you contact us with your contact information and the number of booklets desired, even if you have previously done so. This will help us gauge the interest level to know how many we should print. We can be reached by mail, phone, or email, each of which can be found inside the front cover of each issue of our magazine, The Heartbeat of the Remnant.

Continued Changes

Over the last year or two we have pursued various ways of streamlining our production efforts. One of these, which we have mentioned before is that of working towards having multiple authors write articles for the various specific columns, such as the Children’s Corner, Sister to Sister, A Word from The Doctor, etc. One of the changes you will see is that we will have more than one doctor writing articles for the medical column.

Finances

As you will notice, we have included a financial report in this issue for the year of 2020. A year ago, we had made known through our annual newsletter that things were quite desperate for us financially and that we needed funds if we were going to keep going forward. The response was overwhelming, and we have been blessed by all who decided to partner with us in this need. However, as you can see by the financial report, there is a need for continued financial support since our expenses are ongoing. For those of you who are actively involved in this way, we say thank you and may God richly bless your generosity.

A Point of Interest

The children’s story in this issue of the magazine holds special interest for me. While the details of the story may not all be according to fact, there was a John M. and Catharine Kurtz family that lost five children in infancy and then years later they lost six children to diphtheria. Only John S. Kurtz survived, but was joined by two younger siblings later on. John was ordained to the ministry at the age of 27 and married Maria Horning almost two years later.

John S. and Maria (Horning) Kurtz were my great, great grandparents. So, that line of my ancestry can be traced back through the time of another pandemic and tremendous upheaval in people’s lives, through that of the only surviving child out of a family of 12. For me, this brings personal interest and perspective to some of the situations we are facing today.

May God bless and keep each one. As the world becomes ever darker and more chaotic, let us as Christians draw ever closer to our Lord. In this, He has given a command containing a promise for each of us to: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded –James 4:8.

Curvin L Wenger

Salamu za upendo wa Kikristo kwa kila mmoja wenu. Tunatumaini kwamba umempata Kristo kuwa nanga ya nafsi yako na suluhisho la matatizo yako. Mwaka mwingine umepita na kutoweka, na ulikuwa mwaka wa namna gani… Virusi visivyoonekana vilivyoizunguka dunia, vikivuruga jamii kuanzia nchi za ulimwengu wa tatu hadi nchi zilizoendelea na zilizoendelea kiviwanda zaidi. Viongozi wa dunia wakilaumiana kuhusu janga linalozidi kuongezeka, huku uchumi wa nchi zao ukiendelea kudorora. Na makanisa yakijitahidi kudumisha umoja katikati ya maagizo mbalimbali ya serikali zao kuhusu kutokaribiana, kuvaa barakoa, na kuweka kikomo cha idadi ya watu wanaoweza kukusanyika.

Kwa wengi, mwaka wa 2020 umeharibu au kubadili kwa kiasi kikubwa mambo yaliyokuwa yakichukuliwa kuwa ya kawaida, na umeanza kuweka viwango vipya; huenda mambo mengi yasiwe tena kama yalivyokuwa. ‘Futi sita’ imekuwa kipimo kinachotambulika sana. Sauti ya kukohoa huwafanya walioko karibu na kusikia wageuke kutazama. Kuvaa barakoa kumekuwa mada ya utani na mabishano yasiyoisha kuhusu faida na hasara zake.

Katikati ya hayo yote, wengi wameteseka kwa njia mbalimbali. Jambo la muhimu zaidi, ninajiuliza ikiwa tumefikiria kuhusu madhara ya kiroho yanayowapata watu wanaotuzunguka?

Nimesikia taarifa nyingi kuhusu watu ambao hawakuweza kustahimili kupoteza ushirika wa waumini, baada ya kanisa lao la mahali pao kusimamisha kabisa ibada za ana kwa ana. Baadhi yao waliendelea kuhuzunika kimya kimya, wakizidi kukata tamaa kuhusu Ukristo. Wengine, wakiamua kwamba hili lilikuwa ‘tone la mwisho lililovunja mgongo wa ngamia’, walichukua hatua na kuliacha kanisa lao la zamani, kisha wakajiunga na kundi jipya lililounga mkono zaidi maoni yao. Hata hivyo, kulikuwa na makanisa mengi yaliyochagua “kumtii Mungu kuliko wanadamu” na kuendelea kukutana kwa utulivu kwa ajili ya ibada.

Dhamiri Katika Mgogoro

Suala hili pekee (serikali kuziambia makanisa jinsi na lini yaabudu) limekuwa chanzo cha majadiliano mengi, machafuko, na hata mifarakano katika makanisa mengi. Tunakabili nyakati ambazo hazijapata kutokea kabla. Wengi wetu hatuna uzoefu wowote wa zamani ambao tunaweza kuutegemea utusaidie kufanya uamuzi ulio wazi. Dhamiri za baadhi ya Wakristo hazitawapa amani wanapokuwa ‘hawatii mamlaka za kiraia’, ilhali dhamiri za Wakristo wengine hazitawapa amani wanapokuwa ‘wakiacha kukusanyika pamoja’. Kwa namna fulani, “uingiliaji” huu wa serikali katika maisha ya kila siku ya kanisa haujaonekana kuwa sawa kabisa.

Katika miaka ya 1600 na 1700, mababu zetu Waanabaptisti walihama kutoka Ulaya kwenda nchi za kigeni wakitafuta makazi mapya ambako wangekuwa huru kuabudu kulingana na jinsi dhamiri zao zilivyowaongoza. Tangu wakati huo, mojawapo ya mambo muhimu ya maisha ya Marekani limekuwa “utengano wa kanisa na serikali”. Kwa hiyo, sisi Waanabaptisti wahafidhina tulitafakari kwa mashaka na wasiwasi yale ambayo serikali zetu za mitaa, majimbo, au shirikisho zilitutaka tufanye. Jambo moja ambalo ninashukuru sana ni kwamba viongozi wa ushirika wetu wa mahali hapa wameendelea kutoa himizo kali sana katika kipindi hiki chote, kwamba: “Tunapopitia kila changamoto mpya inayotukabili, ni lazima DAIMA tuonyeshe heshima ya kimungu (katika mawazo, maneno, na matendo) kwa mamlaka zetu za kiraia”, hasa ikiwa tutaona ni lazima “kumtii Mungu kuliko wanadamu”.

Jambo jingine kuu lililosababisha wasiwasi lilikuwa uchaguzi wa Marekani mwishoni mwa mwaka wa 2020. Kwa namna fulani, nchi hii imekuwa na mgawanyiko mkubwa zaidi katika kipindi cha miaka minne iliyopita (labda ni zaidi ya hapo). Nilisikia taarifa kuhusu mwanamume mmoja wa kidunia aliyesema kwamba Trump asiposhinda uchaguzi, basi haoni matumaini ya kuendelea kuishi na anafikiria kama anapaswa kujitoa uhai na kukomesha kila kitu. Ni kweli kwamba huenda mtu wa kidunia asiwe na tumaini la maisha bora yajayo, kwa kuwa labda hajioni kuwa “mgeni na msafiri” hapa duniani na inaelekea haamini katika uzima wa milele. Lakini je, sisi tunaodai kuwa Wakristo tuko afadhali? Je, tunaitikia kila hali kwa hofu au kwa imani?

Mvurugo huu wote katika namna yetu ‘ya kawaida’ ya kuishi umetuletea hali ya kutokuwa na uhakika. Kutokuwa na uhakika kuhusu kazi. Kutokuwa na uhakika kuhusu wakati wetu ujao. Kutokuwa na uhakika kuhusu familia zetu. Kutokuwa na uhakika kuhusu mwisho wa wakati. Orodha hiyo inaweza kuendelea, kila mtu akijaza nafasi zilizoachwa wazi kwa ajili yake mwenyewe.

Chanjo

Suala la hivi karibuni la mvurugo lililo mbele kabisa ya mawazo yetu na katika mazungumzo yetu ni chanjo. Je, “italazimishwa” kwetu? Je, kuna viambato katika aina hii mpya ya chanjo vitakavyowawezesha wengine ‘kutufuatilia’ na kusikiliza mazungumzo yetu yote ya faragha? Je, ni kweli kwamba kwa namna fulani kuna microchip, au roboti nyingi sana za nano zilizochanganywa katika kiasi hicho kidogo cha kimiminika? Je, teknolojia hii mpya iliyotengenezwa kama chanjo ya mRNA ya sintetiki itabadilisha kwa namna fulani DNA yangu nikiruhusu wachome ngozi yangu? Je, chanjo hii ndiyo alama ya mnyama? Haya yote, na mengine mengi, ni maswali ambayo nimekuwa nikiyasikia kwa kuongezeka kwa mara nyingi na kwa dharura zaidi.

Nadharia za Njama

Hali ya kutokuwa na uhakika kuhusu yote haya (virusi, uchaguzi, na chanjo) imezaa nadharia nyingi sana za njama. Kwa kawaida, ikiwa jambo fulani linahusishwa na maana hasi, huwa tunajifungia dhidi ya uwezekano kwamba huenda tunahusika. “Hakika mawazo ninayoyapitisha si nadharia ya njama!”

Au ni nadharia za njama? Tusimame na tufikirie kuhusu jambo hili kwa dakika moja. Njama = mpango wa siri wa kundi fulani wa kufanya jambo lisilo halali au lenye madhara. Nadharia = dhana au mfumo wa mawazo unaokusudiwa kueleza jambo fulani. Je, hivi havilingani na madai na tuhuma nyingi ambazo zimeenezwa miongoni mwetu? Karibu kila ‘simulizi’ jipya hudai kwamba watu ‘fulani’ wanahusika kwa siri katika ajenda inayojumuisha kila kitu, ya kutumia suala hili fulani hasi la mvurugo kuleta mabadiliko hasi mahususi yatakayowadhuru watu wengi. Mara nyingi ‘simulizi’ hizi zimeundwa kuchezea hisia zetu, na kuchochea mwitikio unaotokana na hofu, ambao hatimaye umekusudiwa kujilinda dhidi ya madhara ya kibinafsi yanayodaiwa—kudhibitiwa binafsi na wengine, kupoteza haki za kibinafsi, kupoteza faragha ya kibinafsi, n.k., n.k.

Tukiwa waaminifu kuhusu maana halisi ya ‘njama’ na ‘nadharia’, basi itatubidi pia tukubali kwamba nyingi, kama si nyingi zaidi, za ‘simulizi’ zinazoenezwa katika uvumi ni nadharia za njama kweli. Sisemi kwamba tufumbe macho tusione, au kwamba hatupaswi kuwa watu waliojiandaa. Ninachofanya tu ni kutoa tahadhari dhidi ya kunaswa na lugha ya kihisia ya ‘simulizi’ nyingi zinazoendelea kukuzwa.

Kuna maswali tunayoweza kujiuliza yatakayotusaidia kuchanganua mkanganyiko wa madai au tuhuma mbalimbali zinazotolewa. Je, ninaombwa kujiunga na mapambano ya kulinda Katiba ya Marekani? Je, nashauriwe kuungana na wengine kutetea ‘haki’ zetu? Nikisimama na kufikiria kinachoendelea moyoni mwangu, ni nini kinachonisukuma kuchukua hatua—Imani? Au Hofu? Ikiwa kuna ukweli wowote katika kinachodaiwa, je, kuna jambo lolote ninaloweza kufanya kuhusu hilo?

Kama nilivyosema awali, tunakabili nyakati ambazo hazijapata kutokea kabla. Tukabiliane na wakati wetu ujao kwa imani—Mungu wetu anatawala na ana mamlaka juu ya yote. Tusipoteze kamwe mtazamo wa makao yetu yajayo mbinguni—tumeitwa kuwa wageni na wasafiri katika ulimwengu huu. Tukumbuke daima ahadi za Mungu—kwamba atakuwa pamoja nasi siku zote, hata mpaka mwisho wa dunia, na kwamba HATARUHUSU tujaribiwe kupita uwezo wetu wa kustahimili. Ahadi hizi na nyingine nyingi sana zimetajwa waziwazi katika Maandiko.

Virusi Vinaigusa Familia Yetu

Familia yangu (ya Curvin) iliambukizwa virusi vya Covid-19 katikati ya Oktoba 2020. Virusi hivyo viliwaathiri wanafamilia wetu kwa namna zilizotofautiana kidogo, jambo ambalo lilivutia kulitazama. Mojawapo ya mambo ya kuvutia ni kwamba wengi wetu tulipoteza uwezo wa kuonja na kunusa. Wengi wa familia yetu hawakuteseka zaidi ya tunavyoteseka kwa kawaida tunapopata mafua ya kawaida. Hata hivyo, mama yangu, anayeishi nasi, alikaribia sana kuhitaji kulazwa hospitalini kwa sababu ya kiwango kidogo cha oksijeni katika damu yake. Kwa bahati nzuri, hilo liliepukwa baada ya daktari kuagiza dawa kali ambazo karibu mara moja zilianza kurejesha hali hiyo.

Mimi mwenyewe niliugua sana kutokana na virusi hivyo kiasi kwamba sikuweza kufanya kazi kwa zaidi ya miezi miwili. Kitu pekee kilichonizuia nisiende hospitalini ni kutumia kila siku dawa moja inayodhibitiwa na dozi ya steroidi mara mbili ya ile iliyopendekezwa, kupitia matibabu ya nebuliza. Hali hii iliendelea kwa zaidi ya wiki sita. Sasa karibu miezi miwili imepita tangu hatimaye nianze kupata nafuu, lakini bado sijarejea kikamilifu katika hali niliyokuwa nayo kabla ya kuambukizwa Covid-19.

Kando na hilo, tumejumuisha makala inayotambua maisha ya Mose Stoltzfus, ndugu mkubwa kutoka mojawapo ya makanisa dada zetu, aliyefariki baada ya kuambukizwa Covid-19. Nikizingatia hali hizi mbili, ninaweza kusema kwa hakika kwamba virusi hivi ni halisi na si hadaa; kwamba virusi hivi humwathiri kila mtu kwa namna tofauti kidogo; kwamba baadhi ya watu huwa na madhara machache sana ya ugonjwa hata wanapoambukizwa virusi hivyo; na kwamba kuna watu ambao huwa wagonjwa sana kweli.

Kijitabu Kuhusu Chanjo

Katika matoleo kadhaa yaliyopita tulichapisha makala kadhaa zilizoandikwa na daktari kuhusu suala zima la chanjo. Lengo letu lilikuwa kujaribu kutoa mtazamo uliosawazika kadiri iwezekanavyo. Tulipokea maombi mengi ya kuyaweka makala hayo pamoja katika muundo wa kijitabu, jambo ambalo tulikuwa tumetangaza awali kwamba tulipanga kufanya. Tulikumbana na masuala kadhaa ya kiutendaji ambayo yalihitaji kutatuliwa, na hilo lilichukua muda (mrefu zaidi kuliko tulivyotarajia). Hatimaye, sasa tumefikia hatua ya kuwa tayari kukusanya makala hizo na kuchapisha kijitabu hiki.

Ikiwa ungependa kupokea nakala moja au zaidi za kijitabu hiki, tunakuomba uwasiliane nasi ukitupa maelezo yako ya mawasiliano na idadi ya vijitabu unavyotaka, hata kama ulifanya hivyo hapo awali. Hii itatusaidia kupima kiwango cha mahitaji ili tujue tunapaswa kuchapisha vingapi. Tunaweza kufikiwa kwa barua, simu, au barua pepe; maelezo ya kila mojawapo yanaweza kupatikana ndani ya jalada la mbele la kila toleo la jarida letu, The Heartbeat of the Remnant.

Mabadiliko Yanayoendelea

Katika mwaka mmoja au miwili iliyopita, tumetafuta njia mbalimbali za kurahisisha juhudi zetu za utayarishaji. Mojawapo ya njia hizo, ambayo tumewahi kuitaja hapo awali, ni kujitahidi kuwa na waandishi wengi zaidi wakiandika makala kwa ajili ya safu mbalimbali maalum, kama vile Kona ya Watoto, Dada kwa Dada, Neno kutoka kwa Daktari, n.k. Mojawapo ya mabadiliko mtakayoyaona ni kwamba tutakuwa na zaidi ya daktari mmoja akiandika makala kwa ajili ya safu ya matibabu.

Fedha

Kama mtakavyoona, tumejumuisha ripoti ya fedha katika toleo hili kwa mwaka wa 2020. Mwaka mmoja uliopita, tulikuwa tumetangaza kupitia jarida letu la kila mwaka kwamba hali yetu ya kifedha ilikuwa mbaya sana na kwamba tulihitaji fedha ili tuweze kuendelea. Mwitikio ulikuwa mkubwa kupita kiasi, nasi tumebarikiwa na wote walioamua kushirikiana nasi katika hitaji hili. Hata hivyo, kama mnavyoona katika ripoti ya fedha, tunahitaji kuendelea kupata msaada wa kifedha kwa kuwa matumizi yetu yanaendelea. Kwa wale mnaoshiriki kikamilifu kwa njia hii, tunasema asanteni, na Mungu awabariki sana kwa ukarimu wenu.

Jambo la Kuvutia

Hadithi ya watoto katika toleo hili la jarida inanivutia sana. Ingawa huenda si maelezo yote ya hadithi hiyo yanayolingana na ukweli, kulikuwa na familia ya John M. na Catharine Kurtz iliyopoteza watoto watano wakiwa wachanga, kisha miaka kadhaa baadaye ikapoteza watoto sita kutokana na ugonjwa wa dondakoo. Ni John S. Kurtz pekee aliyenusurika, lakini baadaye alijiunga na ndugu wawili wadogo. John alitawazwa katika huduma akiwa na umri wa miaka 27 na akamwoa Maria Horning karibu miaka miwili baadaye.

John S. na Maria (Horning) Kurtz walikuwa babu na bibi wa babu yangu. Kwa hiyo, ukoo wangu unaweza kufuatiliwa hadi kipindi cha janga jingine na misukosuko mikubwa katika maisha ya watu, kupitia kwa mtoto pekee aliyenusurika katika familia ya watu 12. Kwangu, jambo hili linaifanya hali hii iwe ya kunivutia binafsi na kunipa mtazamo kuhusu baadhi ya hali tunazokabiliana nazo leo.

Mungu ambariki na kumlinda kila mmoja wenu. Kadiri ulimwengu unavyozidi kuwa na giza na machafuko, sisi Wakristo na tumkaribie Bwana wetu zaidi na zaidi. Katika jambo hili, ametupa amri yenye ahadi kwa kila mmoja wetu: Mkaribieni Mungu, naye atawakaribia ninyi. Takaseni mikono yenu, ninyi wenye dhambi; na kuzisafisha mioyo yenu, ninyi wenye nia mbili –Yakobo 4:8.

Curvin L Wenger

Meet the doctor who wrote this article for our medical column. (See the editorial under the section “continued changes” for further details.)

Hello,

My full name is Vincent “John” Bradford Waldron (I go by John) and I am a Family Physician in south central Virginia. My family and I attend church at Bethel Mennonite Church in Gladys, Virginia. My wife, Elaine, and I have been married since 2002 and have five children. I have been in practice for twenty years; the first seventeen I practiced in southern Indiana.

Currently, I practice in an outpatient setting taking care of patients in the small town of Brookneal. My vision is to care for people as Jesus would. I want to share the Gospel with those who need it and to minister to the needs of those who are hurting. The majority of my patients are not from a conservative Anabaptist background and perhaps the only way they will see Jesus is through me.

John

Editor’s Note:

Currently, the details are changing, sometimes daily, regarding the vaccines, the unexpected problems associated with providing the vaccines to the vast multitudes of the world’s population, and the potential side effects developing from receiving the vaccine. This article was first written prior to the first vaccines being available, since then it has been revised at least twice.

We realize there are many unknowns surrounding this whole issue. It is with this in mind that we have tried to be as balanced as possible as we have considered the information that was available at the time of writing. We plan to keep our ears tuned to the progression of these situations. And we will do our best to continue investigating and evaluating concerns that are directed our way. If the Lord wills, we plan to print updated information regarding these issues in succeeding issues of the magazine.

Bottomline, as a board, we second the comments found in Larry Zook’s article (Admonition for Uncertain Times) found in this issue of the magazine… “Informed Consent and Getting a Second Opinion—both have been the long-standing ethical basis of decision-making in choosing medical treatment. I hope we retain both.”

Coronavirus vaccines are in the news these days. When the first vaccines were finally considered ‘safe’ for use by the medical community the initial focus was on England as many “Brits” were among the first to receive the vaccine including one man, who interestingly enough, has the name of William Shakespeare. As of the writing of this article, here in the U.S., the FDA has approved the initial Covid-19 vaccines developed by Moderna and Pfizer.

The Initial Vaccines

The first two vaccines that have come out and been approved were vaccines that used synthetic mRNA (messenger RNA). In cells, DNA encodes the different proteins that cells need to produce in order to function. The only thing is that no proteins are actually made in the nucleus, they are actually made in the ribosomes of the cell. So, the cell needs a messenger to go from the nucleus to the ribosomes and carry those instructions. That messenger is mRNA.

The mRNA takes the messages from the nucleus to the ribosomes. After a time the message degrades, and the ribosomes stop making that particular protein.

In the case of mRNA vaccines, the synthetic mRNA in the vaccine encodes a protein that looks like the spike protein on the COVID virus. As cells make this protein, the body’s immune system will identify those proteins as foreign and begin to create antibodies to them.

Does mRNA Change DNA?

I know that there is much fear around the idea that these vaccines will change our genetic code. This, of course, could be really dangerous. Fortunately, the mRNA doesn’t make its way to the nucleus and instead is only active where proteins are made. This technology (mRNA vaccines) is quite different than stem cell gene therapies, and the various gene-editing therapies, such as CRISPR. Both of these fields of therapy do affect a person at the level of their genes, but the mRNA vaccine does not.

Effectiveness

In the studies that looked at the two mRNA vaccines, we found that they were quite effective. There were only 8 cases of COVID identified in the patients seven days after the second dose of the Pfizer vaccine, while in those who got the placebo vaccine, there were 162 cases in that same period. Looking at severe cases, there was only one case in the vaccine group (this happened between the first and second doses) and nine cases of severe COVID in the placebo group.1 The Moderna vaccine showed similar effectiveness.2

There is still a question out there. Do these vaccines actually prevent all COVID infections or do they just turn COVID infections into low-symptom or no-symptom infections? Currently, studies are being done to look at this. The only way to know is to run antibody testing on patients who have gotten the COVID vaccine for proteins that are not in the vaccine. So, for instance, there is a protein called the “n” protein that is in a different part of the virus. Someone who has had the vaccine, but not an infection with COVID will not have an antibody to this protein, while someone who has had an actual COVID infection will have this antibody as well as an antibody to the spike protein.

In the meantime, everyone, even those who have received the vaccine, will still need to practice extra caution, such as wearing masks, hand washing, and social distancing, at least until we know for sure whether or not it’s possible to get infections (even with the vaccine) and how contagious these potential infections may be.

Side Effects of COVID Vaccine

The most common side effects that have been noted so far has been arm soreness. This usually lasts for one to three days and then resolves. Many people also often feel tired and achy. They may even run low-grade fevers for one to two days after getting the injections. However, this seems to be a bigger issue with the second injection.

There have been isolated allergic reactions to the vaccines as well. The rate of anaphylaxis (severe allergy) to COVID vaccine does seem to be somewhat higher when compared with other vaccines. Because of this, it is recommended that people get vaccinated in locations where there is treatment available to take care of such a reaction and that they should stay for a minimum of 15 minutes after the shot (or 30 minutes if they normally carry an epi pen).3

Updated Side Effects

In the last several weeks, nearly 15 million people in the United States have gotten at least one dose of the COVID vaccines. There have been a lot more doses given around the world. As we have done this, certain things have been clearer as far as side effects.

Anaphylaxis is the most serious “common” side effect. The CDC is saying that the rate of serious allergy to the Moderna and Pfizer vaccines is about 11 per million doses given. This sort of an allergy requires medications like epinephrine to reverse it and is seen with other vaccines and medications too.

In Norway, nearly all of the patients in nursing homes were vaccinated against COVID.4 In the subsequent six days, 23 of the frailest of those died. At this point, it is being investigated as to whether or not the vaccine contributed in any way to those deaths. From what we know, those patients weren’t in good health prior to the vaccine, but I think I would probably avoid giving the vaccine to people who are in extremely poor health (understanding that if those folks get COVID they probably wouldn’t do well either).

A lot of people have had muscle pains, chills and even low-grade fevers after the second dose of vaccine. Several of my co-workers had these sorts of symptoms and all of them resolved within 48 hours of getting the vaccine.

I think one last thing to remember is that just because something happens after you get vaccinated, it does not mean the vaccine caused it. So, if you get a shot and then get hit by a car, clearly the shot didn’t cause the accident. One possible example of this is a doctor in Florida who got a COVID vaccine and then developed really low platelet counts and eventually died. There is no indication that the vaccination caused the low platelet count and we have not seen this in any other patients who have gotten vaccinated for COVID. The guess is simply that he was probably developing this disorder already and that the vaccine didn’t cause it or affect it.

Simply put, when you give millions of doses of anything, there will always be some who develop other illnesses soon after getting the medicine or vaccine. The challenge is to figure out what is related to the therapy and what is just “noise.”

Ethical Issues

Other than the two vaccines listed above, there are many others being researched and developed. Some of these vaccines are grown on cell lines that were derived from babies that were aborted in the 70s and 80s. I need to be clear that there are no ongoing abortions being utilized to make any vaccines.

In light of this, the one good thing is that the Pfizer and Moderna vaccines are not grown on these fetal cell lines.

Other Vaccines

Janssen (Johnson and Johnson) Pharmaceuticals and Astra Zeneca are both working on vaccines that are more traditional vaccines—that is they grow the virus, then kill it, and then give small doses of the killed virus to trigger the immune response. create immunity. The Astra Zeneca vaccine probably will be released before too long. The studies on it are a little more unclear with regard to its effectiveness.

The important thing with these vaccines is that they are both grown on HEK293 fetal cells, which are derived from an aborted infant.

There are a number of other vaccines that are a little further away from release, but there is one from Merck is a non-mRNA vaccine that is also ethically sourced (not grown on aborted fetal cells). The Lozier Institute has a web page that lists which vaccines use fetal cell lines and which ones do not.5

Other Questions

There have been a number of questions about who was behind these vaccines and a variety of concerns with respect to their development. Some have even speculated about companies introducing a “microchip” into the vaccines.

The needles being used to administer these vaccines are a very small caliber (21 gauge or smaller) which makes it unlikely that a microchip could be administered through such a needle. It seems probable that to administer a microchip, it would require a significantly larger needle than the ones being recommended, (the microchips that are normally used in pets are roughly the size of a kernel of rice).

Making a Decision

Is it worthwhile to get one of these vaccines, and, if so, which one?

The biggest reason to get a COVID vaccine is to avoid the possible long-term effects of a COVID infection. In some people, COVID produces chronic fatigue, a long-term cough, and “brain fog.” Getting one of these vaccines certainly would help to avoid those disease-induced problems along with the possibility that COVID could also cause some heart damage.6

What if You’ve Had COVID already?

Many in our circles have already had COVID. If you know you had COVID then probably the best thing to do is to wait. There is no particular reason to run out and get vaccinated, since we believe your antibodies should remain active for three to six months. In studies, they did seem to decline over time, but folks who had COVID should be immune for a minimum of 3 months and probably longer.

It seems most reasonable to wait and see if one of the vaccines shows itself to be superior, with regard either to effectiveness or fewer side effects, than the others.

Who Should Not Get Vaccinated?

Currently, there are certain people who should not get the vaccine. The first category are groups that weren’t in the studies. So, children under the age of 16, pregnant women, and nursing mothers should all avoid the COVID vaccines for the time being. It may be that the vaccine would be safe for people in these groups, but since they weren’t tested, they shouldn’t get it for now.

Secondly, if you actively have COVID or are currently isolating because of being exposed to it, you shouldn’t get the vaccine. I suppose this makes sense as we don’t typically give vaccinations to people who are already sick.

Finally, you should be careful if you have a history of severe reactions to other vaccines.

Everyone else

If someone has not had a COVID infection, I would certainly lean towards getting the vaccine. Personally, I have started getting vaccinated using the Pfizer vaccine and feel comfortable with that. For those who are working in health care, I would lean towards getting one of the vaccines. The issue for me is not the risk of infection to me, rather my concern as a Christian doctor is the danger that I might pass COVID on to one of my patients.

If you are caring for the elderly and have not had a COVID infection, I would also think strongly about getting vaccinated. Once again, the primary concern should not be how you will handle the infection, but instead who you might pass that infection on to.

Conclusion

I understand that others’ comfort level may be lower with these new vaccines and if that is the case, I would wait. These vaccines are being given to millions of people and if there are issues, they will become apparent fairly quickly.

Finally, I am glad that there are going to be several ethically sourced vaccines available to those who desire them.

Catatan Editor:

Saat ini, perinciannya terus berubah, terkadang setiap hari, sehubungan dengan vaksin-vaksin, masalah-masalah tak terduga terkait penyediaan vaksin bagi sangat banyak penduduk dunia, dan potensi efek samping yang muncul setelah menerima vaksin. Artikel ini pertama kali ditulis sebelum vaksin pertama tersedia; sejak saat itu artikel ini telah direvisi setidaknya dua kali.

Kami menyadari bahwa ada banyak hal yang belum diketahui seputar persoalan ini. Dengan mempertimbangkan hal tersebut, kami telah berusaha seimbang sebisa mungkin saat menimbang informasi yang tersedia pada waktu penulisan. Kami berencana untuk terus mencermati perkembangan situasi ini. Dan kami akan berupaya sebaik mungkin untuk terus menyelidiki dan mengevaluasi keprihatinan yang disampaikan kepada kami. Jika Tuhan menghendaki, kami berencana mencetak informasi terbaru mengenai persoalan ini dalam edisi-edisi majalah berikutnya.

Intinya, sebagai dewan, kami mendukung komentar dalam artikel Larry Zook (Nasihat untuk Masa yang Tidak Pasti) yang dimuat dalam edisi majalah ini… “Persetujuan yang Berdasarkan Informasi dan Meminta Pendapat Kedua—keduanya telah lama menjadi landasan etis dalam pengambilan keputusan untuk memilih perawatan medis. Saya berharap kita mempertahankan keduanya.”

Vaksin virus corona menjadi berita belakangan ini. Ketika vaksin pertama akhirnya dinilai ‘aman’ untuk digunakan oleh kalangan medis, perhatian awal tertuju pada Inggris karena banyak “orang Inggris” termasuk di antara orang-orang pertama yang menerima vaksin, termasuk seorang pria yang, cukup menarik, bernama William Shakespeare. Pada saat artikel ini ditulis, di sini, di A.S., FDA telah menyetujui vaksin Covid-19 awal yang dikembangkan Moderna dan Pfizer.

Vaksin-Vaksin Awal

Dua vaksin pertama yang tersedia dan disetujui adalah vaksin yang menggunakan mRNA sintetis (RNA pembawa pesan). Di dalam sel, DNA mengodekan berbagai protein yang perlu dihasilkan sel agar dapat berfungsi. Hanya saja, protein sebenarnya tidak dibuat di dalam nukleus; protein dibuat di ribosom sel. Jadi, sel memerlukan pembawa pesan untuk bergerak dari nukleus ke ribosom dan membawa instruksi tersebut. Pembawa pesan itu adalah mRNA.

mRNA membawa pesan dari nukleus ke ribosom. Setelah beberapa waktu, pesan itu terurai dan ribosom berhenti membuat protein tertentu tersebut.

Dalam vaksin mRNA, mRNA sintetis di dalam vaksin mengodekan protein yang tampak seperti protein paku pada virus COVID. Ketika sel membuat protein ini, sistem kekebalan tubuh akan mengenali protein tersebut sebagai benda asing dan mulai membentuk antibodi terhadapnya.

Apakah mRNA Mengubah DNA?

Saya tahu bahwa ada banyak ketakutan seputar gagasan bahwa vaksin-vaksin ini akan mengubah kode genetik kita. Tentu saja, hal ini bisa sangat berbahaya. Untungnya, mRNA tidak masuk ke nukleus dan hanya aktif di tempat protein dibuat. Teknologi ini (vaksin mRNA) sangat berbeda dari terapi gen sel punca dan berbagai terapi penyuntingan gen, seperti CRISPR. Kedua bidang terapi tersebut memang memengaruhi seseorang pada tingkat gennya, tetapi vaksin mRNA tidak.

Efektivitas

Dalam penelitian yang mengamati dua vaksin mRNA tersebut, kami mendapati bahwa keduanya cukup efektif. Hanya ada 8 kasus COVID yang teridentifikasi pada pasien tujuh hari setelah dosis kedua vaksin Pfizer, sedangkan pada mereka yang menerima vaksin plasebo, terdapat 162 kasus dalam periode yang sama. Jika melihat kasus yang parah, hanya ada satu kasus dalam kelompok vaksin (ini terjadi antara dosis pertama dan kedua) dan sembilan kasus COVID parah dalam kelompok plasebo.1 Vaksin Moderna menunjukkan efektivitas yang serupa.2

Masih ada satu pertanyaan. Apakah vaksin-vaksin ini benar-benar mencegah semua infeksi COVID, atau hanya membuat infeksi COVID bergejala ringan atau tanpa gejala? Saat ini, penelitian sedang dilakukan untuk mengkajinya. Satu-satunya cara untuk mengetahuinya adalah dengan melakukan tes antibodi pada pasien yang telah menerima vaksin COVID, untuk protein-protein yang tidak ada dalam vaksin. Jadi, misalnya, ada protein bernama protein “n” yang berada di bagian lain virus. Seseorang yang telah menerima vaksin, tetapi tidak mengalami infeksi COVID, tidak akan memiliki antibodi terhadap protein ini, sementara seseorang yang benar-benar pernah mengalami infeksi COVID akan memiliki antibodi ini dan juga antibodi terhadap protein paku.

Sementara itu, setiap orang, termasuk mereka yang telah menerima vaksin, tetap perlu berhati-hati lebih dari biasanya, misalnya dengan memakai masker, mencuci tangan, dan menjaga jarak sosial, setidaknya sampai kita tahu dengan pasti apakah infeksi masih mungkin terjadi (bahkan setelah vaksinasi) dan seberapa menular infeksi yang mungkin terjadi ini.

Efek Samping Vaksin COVID

Efek samping yang paling umum sejauh ini adalah nyeri pada lengan. Biasanya berlangsung selama satu hingga tiga hari lalu mereda. Banyak orang juga sering merasa lelah dan pegal-pegal. Mereka bahkan mungkin mengalami demam ringan selama satu hingga dua hari setelah disuntik. Namun, hal ini tampaknya lebih sering menjadi masalah setelah suntikan kedua.

Selain itu, telah terjadi beberapa reaksi alergi terhadap vaksin. Angka anafilaksis (alergi berat) terhadap vaksin COVID tampaknya agak lebih tinggi dibandingkan dengan vaksin-vaksin lain. Karena itu, orang dianjurkan menerima vaksinasi di tempat yang menyediakan penanganan untuk mengatasi reaksi semacam itu dan tetap berada di sana setidaknya selama 15 menit setelah disuntik (atau 30 menit jika biasanya membawa pena epinefrin).3

Pembaruan Efek Samping

Dalam beberapa minggu terakhir, hampir 15 juta orang di Amerika Serikat telah menerima setidaknya satu dosis vaksin COVID. Jauh lebih banyak dosis telah diberikan di seluruh dunia. Seiring dengan hal itu, beberapa hal terkait efek samping menjadi lebih jelas.

Anafilaksis adalah efek samping “umum” yang paling serius. CDC menyatakan bahwa angka alergi berat terhadap vaksin Moderna dan Pfizer sekitar 11 per sejuta dosis yang diberikan. Alergi semacam ini memerlukan obat-obatan seperti epinefrin untuk mengatasinya dan juga terjadi pada vaksin serta obat-obatan lain.

Di Norwegia, hampir semua pasien di panti jompo divaksinasi terhadap COVID.4 Dalam enam hari berikutnya, 23 orang yang paling lemah di antara mereka meninggal. Saat ini, sedang diselidiki apakah vaksin berkontribusi dalam bentuk apa pun terhadap kematian tersebut. Berdasarkan yang kita ketahui, kesehatan para pasien itu sudah buruk sebelum menerima vaksin, tetapi saya rasa saya mungkin akan menghindari pemberian vaksin kepada orang yang kesehatannya sangat buruk (dengan memahami bahwa jika mereka tertular COVID, kemungkinan besar keadaan mereka juga tidak akan baik).

Banyak orang mengalami nyeri otot, menggigil, bahkan demam ringan setelah dosis vaksin kedua. Beberapa rekan kerja saya mengalami gejala semacam ini dan semuanya mereda dalam 48 jam setelah menerima vaksin.

Satu hal terakhir yang perlu diingat adalah bahwa hanya karena sesuatu terjadi setelah Anda divaksinasi, bukan berarti vaksinlah penyebabnya. Jadi, jika Anda disuntik lalu tertabrak mobil, jelas suntikan itu tidak menyebabkan kecelakaan tersebut. Salah satu contoh yang mungkin terkait hal ini adalah seorang dokter di Florida yang menerima vaksin COVID lalu mengalami jumlah trombosit yang sangat rendah dan akhirnya meninggal. Tidak ada indikasi bahwa vaksinasi menyebabkan rendahnya jumlah trombosit itu dan kami belum melihat hal ini pada pasien lain yang telah divaksinasi COVID. Dugaan sederhananya adalah bahwa gangguan ini mungkin sudah mulai berkembang dan vaksin tidak menyebabkannya ataupun memengaruhinya.

Sederhananya, ketika jutaan dosis dari apa pun diberikan, akan selalu ada orang yang mengalami penyakit lain tidak lama setelah menerima obat atau vaksin. Tantangannya adalah mencari tahu mana yang berkaitan dengan terapi dan mana yang sekadar “kebetulan.”

Persoalan Etis

Selain dua vaksin yang disebutkan di atas, ada banyak vaksin lain yang sedang diteliti dan dikembangkan. Beberapa vaksin ini dikembangkan pada galur sel yang berasal dari bayi-bayi yang diaborsi pada tahun 70-an dan 80-an. Saya perlu menegaskan bahwa tidak ada aborsi yang sedang dilakukan untuk membuat vaksin apa pun.

Mengingat hal ini, satu hal baiknya adalah vaksin Pfizer dan Moderna tidak dikembangkan pada galur sel janin tersebut.

Vaksin Lain

Janssen (Johnson and Johnson) Pharmaceuticals dan Astra Zeneca sama-sama sedang mengembangkan vaksin yang lebih tradisional—yaitu, virusnya dikembangbiakkan, lalu dimatikan, kemudian dosis kecil virus yang telah dimatikan diberikan untuk memicu respons kekebalan dan menciptakan kekebalan. Vaksin Astra Zeneca mungkin akan tersedia dalam waktu dekat. Hasil penelitian tentang vaksin ini agak kurang jelas dalam hal efektivitasnya.

Hal penting mengenai vaksin-vaksin ini adalah bahwa keduanya dikembangkan pada sel janin HEK293, yang berasal dari bayi yang diaborsi.

Ada sejumlah vaksin lain yang masih agak jauh dari tahap tersedia, tetapi salah satunya dari Merck adalah vaksin non-mRNA yang juga diperoleh secara etis (tidak dikembangkan pada sel janin hasil aborsi). Lozier Institute memiliki laman web yang mencantumkan vaksin mana yang menggunakan galur sel janin dan mana yang tidak.5

Pertanyaan Lain

Ada sejumlah pertanyaan mengenai siapa yang berada di balik vaksin-vaksin ini dan beragam keprihatinan terkait pengembangannya. Bahkan ada yang berspekulasi bahwa perusahaan-perusahaan memasukkan “mikrocip” ke dalam vaksin.

Jarum yang digunakan untuk memberikan vaksin-vaksin ini berkaliber sangat kecil (21 gauge atau lebih kecil), sehingga kecil kemungkinannya mikrocip dapat dimasukkan melalui jarum semacam itu. Tampaknya, untuk memasukkan mikrocip, diperlukan jarum yang jauh lebih besar daripada yang dianjurkan (mikrocip yang biasanya digunakan pada hewan peliharaan kira-kira sebesar sebutir beras).

Mengambil Keputusan

Apakah ada gunanya menerima salah satu vaksin ini, dan, jika ya, vaksin yang mana?

Alasan terbesar untuk menerima vaksin COVID adalah untuk menghindari kemungkinan dampak jangka panjang infeksi COVID. Pada sebagian orang, COVID menyebabkan kelelahan kronis, batuk berkepanjangan, dan “kabut otak.” Menerima salah satu vaksin ini tentu akan membantu menghindari masalah-masalah akibat penyakit tersebut, serta kemungkinan bahwa COVID juga dapat menyebabkan kerusakan jantung.6

Bagaimana Jika Anda Sudah Pernah Terkena COVID?

Banyak orang di kalangan kita sudah pernah terkena COVID. Jika Anda tahu bahwa Anda pernah terkena COVID, mungkin yang terbaik adalah menunggu. Tidak ada alasan khusus untuk segera pergi dan divaksinasi, sebab kami percaya antibodi Anda seharusnya tetap aktif selama tiga hingga enam bulan. Dalam penelitian, antibodi memang tampak menurun seiring waktu, tetapi orang yang pernah terkena COVID seharusnya kebal setidaknya selama 3 bulan dan mungkin lebih lama.

Tampaknya paling masuk akal untuk menunggu dan melihat apakah salah satu vaksin terbukti lebih unggul daripada yang lain, baik dalam hal efektivitas maupun lebih sedikitnya efek samping.

Siapa yang Tidak Boleh Divaksinasi?

Saat ini, ada orang-orang tertentu yang tidak boleh menerima vaksin. Kelompok pertama adalah mereka yang tidak diikutsertakan dalam penelitian. Jadi, anak-anak di bawah usia 16 tahun, perempuan hamil, dan ibu menyusui sebaiknya menghindari vaksin COVID untuk sementara waktu. Vaksin ini mungkin aman bagi orang-orang dalam kelompok tersebut, tetapi karena mereka tidak diikutsertakan dalam pengujian, untuk saat ini mereka sebaiknya tidak menerimanya.

Kedua, jika Anda sedang mengalami COVID atau sedang menjalani isolasi karena terpapar COVID, Anda sebaiknya tidak menerima vaksin. Saya kira ini masuk akal karena biasanya kita tidak memberikan vaksinasi kepada orang yang sudah sakit.

Terakhir, Anda harus berhati-hati jika memiliki riwayat reaksi berat terhadap vaksin lain.

Orang Lainnya

Jika seseorang belum pernah mengalami infeksi COVID, saya tentu cenderung menganjurkan agar ia menerima vaksin. Secara pribadi, saya sudah mulai divaksinasi dengan vaksin Pfizer dan merasa nyaman dengan pilihan itu. Bagi mereka yang bekerja di bidang pelayanan kesehatan, saya cenderung menganjurkan agar mereka menerima salah satu vaksin. Bagi saya, persoalannya bukan risiko infeksi bagi diri saya, melainkan kekhawatiran saya sebagai dokter Kristen bahwa saya mungkin menularkan COVID kepada salah satu pasien saya.

Jika Anda merawat lansia dan belum pernah mengalami infeksi COVID, saya juga akan sungguh-sungguh mempertimbangkan vaksinasi. Sekali lagi, perhatian utama seharusnya bukan bagaimana Anda akan menghadapi infeksi tersebut, melainkan kepada siapa Anda mungkin menularkannya.

Kesimpulan

Saya memahami bahwa tingkat kenyamanan orang lain terhadap vaksin-vaksin baru ini mungkin lebih rendah, dan jika demikian, saya akan menunggu. Vaksin-vaksin ini diberikan kepada jutaan orang dan jika ada masalah, masalah itu akan segera tampak.

Terakhir, saya senang bahwa akan tersedia beberapa vaksin yang diperoleh secara etis bagi mereka yang menginginkannya.

I used to pray for sunshine,
No storms to mark the sky.
For cool breezes and flowers
To please and turn my eye.

I used to pray for happiness,
For smiles, joy, and peace.
That all things would be easy,
And all harsh things would cease.

I used to pray for someone,
To walk with in this life.
To love, laugh with, and cherish,
And dissipate all strife.

I used to pray that always
Life’s pathways would be clear.
That no unwanted circumstance
Would make existence drear.

But those prayers seemed to go unheeded,
For life didn’t flow that way.
The storms—they came uninvited,
Thick rains made many a dark day.

The flowers were not to be seen,
The wind did cut and slash.
No peace could be found about me;
Instead, the thunder did crash.

Not one was found to walk with me,
Alone, through rough ways I did roam.
Gone were the dreams of tranquility,
My soul cried with desire for a home.

Then, a rich voice spoke inside me,
“You’ve been seeking the things you can see.
The true prayers of your heart can be answered,
If you would only but look unto Me.

I have heard your needs and desires,
Your prayers did not fall unheard.
But I saw that your heart needed different
Than the way that ease had preferred.

You prayed for clear skies and sunshine,
For cool breezes and flowers to start.
But I saw that just these would not yield you
The real peace you sought in your heart.

I ordered the rough ways you have followed,
Not to disappoint, but to purge.
For I knew that true happiness begins only
In the heart that with Me does merge.”

So I fell at the feet of my Master
And yielded to His will and His plan.
No longer demanding my wants now,
But trusting He’d finish what He began.

Not long after, I found I was happy;
Not a cloud in my heart could prevail.
Even if my circumstances seemed weary,
No outer storm my inner Sunshine could pale.

The cool breezes of sweet rest in Him,
Did calm all my worries and fears.
And always the flowers of His promises,
Were visible when life brought me tears.

I found also, I no longer walked alone;
The Good Shepherd was there by my side!
With Him I could share my joys and sorrows,
And amidst any battle, in Him I could hide.

So now instead of praying
For things of earthly ease,
I thank the Lord for sending things
That brought me to my knees.

I pray instead for humility,
To lead me through the day.
For an eye to serve, and share the blessings,
That the Lord does send my way.

I pray that my heart would be yielded,
To the touch of the Master’s hand.
Allowing His will to change me,
Through everything He has planned.

For I’ve found that true happiness,
Is not in a smooth, perfect life.
But it’s found when in Christ we are rooted,
Not moved through fire or strife.

If He rules the inmost being,
Then nothing outside will disturb.
For He is the solid Foundation,
And the real source of True Life superb.

Förr bad jag om solsken,
om inga stormar på himlen.
Om svala vindar och blommor
som gladde och fäste min blick.

Förr bad jag om lycka,
om leenden, glädje och frid.
Om att allt skulle vara lätt,
och allt hårt ta slut.

Förr bad jag om någon
att vandra med genom livet.
Att älska, skratta med och hålla kär,
och skingra all strid.

Förr bad jag att livets stigar
alltid skulle ligga öppna.
Att ingen ovälkommen omständighet
skulle göra tillvaron dyster.

Men det verkade som om mina böner förblev obesvarade,
för livet tog inte den vägen.
Stormarna kom utan att vara inbjudna,
och ihållande regn gjorde många dagar mörka.

Blommorna syntes inte till,
vinden bet och slet.
Ingen frid stod att finna omkring mig;
i stället dundrade åskan.

Ingen fanns där att vandra med mig,
ensam strövade jag genom svåra stigar.
Drömmarna om lugn var borta,
min själ ropade av längtan efter ett hem.

Då talade en rik stämma inom mig:
”Du har sökt efter sådant som du kan se.
Ditt hjärtas innersta böner kan bli besvarade,
om du bara vill vända blicken till mig.

Jag har hört dina behov och önskningar,
dina böner var inte ohörda.
Men jag såg att ditt hjärta behövde något annat
än den lätthet det hade föredragit.

Du bad om klar himmel och solsken,
om svala vindar och blommor som slog ut.
Men jag såg att just detta inte skulle ge dig
den verkliga frid du sökte i ditt hjärta.

Jag ordnade de svåra vägar du har gått,
inte för att göra dig besviken, utan för att rena dig.
För jag visste att sann lycka börjar först
i hjärtat som förenas med mig.”

Då föll jag ner vid min Mästares fötter
och överlät mig åt hans vilja och plan.
Jag krävde inte längre det jag själv ville ha,
utan litade på att han skulle fullborda det han påbörjat.

Snart upptäckte jag att jag var lycklig;
inget moln kunde lägga sig över mitt hjärta.
Även om mina omständigheter verkade tunga,
kunde ingen yttre storm bleka mitt inre solsken.

De svala vindarna av ljuv vila i honom
stillade alla mina bekymmer och rädslor.
Och alltid var hans löftens blommor
synliga när livet fick mig att gråta.

Jag upptäckte också att jag inte längre vandrade ensam;
den gode herden fanns där vid min sida!
Med honom kunde jag dela mina glädjeämnen och sorger,
och mitt i varje strid kunde jag finna skydd i honom.

Så nu ber jag inte längre
om jordisk bekvämlighet,
utan tackar Herren för att han sänder sådant
som får mig på knä.

I stället ber jag om ödmjukhet,
så att den leder mig genom dagen.
Om en blick för att tjäna och dela de välsignelser
som Herren sänder i min väg.

Jag ber att mitt hjärta ska överlåtas
åt Mästaren och beröras av hans hand.
Att hans vilja får förändra mig
genom allt han har planerat.

För jag har upptäckt att sann lycka
inte finns i ett jämnt och perfekt liv.
Den finns när vi är rotade i Kristus,
och inte låter eld eller strid rubba oss.

Om han råder över mitt innersta,
kan inget utanför mig störa mig.
För han är den fasta grunden
och den verkliga källan till det underbara, sanna livet.
